faqs.question: Can I join BTech at Manipal University, Jaipur without JEE Mains?
faqs.answer: Yes, Manipal University conduct Manipal entrance test (MET) every year for admission in B.Tech and other UG courses. and it does not accept the score of JEE mains.You can also get admission through CUET-UG in various courses and direct entry is also available for some courses. Candidates must have to meet the eligibility criteria set by the institute for the BTech programme.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Manipal Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Manipal University Jaipur does not provide direct admission to all the courses. However it does provide direct admission to some of the courses such as BCA, BBA, BA, BCom. Admission to these courses takes place on the basis of class 12 exam and personal interview. For some of the courses candidates might have to take English Compregension tests. Primarily BTech and M.Tech admision takes place on the basis of JEE and GATE scores.

MUJ Rajasthan offers BTech specialisation in CSE, Biotechnology, Information Technology, Automobile Engineering, Data Science, Civil Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, etc. BTech students can work as Web Developer, Data Science Engineer, Mechanical Engineer, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: My experience and review at Manipal University Jaipur as a fresher of 2025.

review_content.Placements: Around 50% of students get jobs in my batch, according to experience. Recruiting companies are Infosys, Dell, Flipkart, Amazon, and Wipro. Project manager, web developer, database manager, and many more roles are offered. The highest is 10 LPA, the lowest is 2-3 LPA, and the average is 5.5 LPA. Around 60% of students get internships in companies like Tata, Infosys, Dell, and many more.
review_content.Infrastructure: It is the best college according to facilities and infrastructure in all of Rajasthan. Hostels feel like a 5-star residence colony. Everything is available in hostels, hospitals, cafes, shops, parks, gym, sports facilities, and indoor games, almost everything. No need to go out of the hostels for any legal matter. They have professional cooks for the mess, and every day is something different and tasty in the mess.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Good college, self-study is important.

review_content.Placements: The college provides many opportunities through clubs, internships, competitions, and placement training, but it also depends on students whether they can grab the opportunity. Students who stay focused, work hard, and do consistent study can get the most out of these opportunities and get top placement packages. Self-study is a must.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are above average, with decent rooms, food, and basic amenities, better than those at other colleges I have seen. However, the hostel fees are also on the higher side compared to many other colleges, so it is expensive for some students. You can also apply for a student loan. College is friendly with loan documentation.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It offers supportive faculty members and a good learning environment.

review_content.Placements: There is no package in architecture, and students themselves need to approach firms they are interested in or apply for higher education. Almost everyone tends to find an appropriate job or college for a master's. The initial roles offered are junior architects, draftsmen, and designers as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Manipal University, Jaipur, is top-notch and rewarded with many awards as well. The campus is Griha-rated, which is also a great achievement. Facilities at the hostel are also very good. They take care of students. Their priority is students' safety and health.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Quite a good university giving average placements, great infrastructure, and vibrant culture.

review_content.Placements: There have been companies like Deloitte, Dell, Amazon, and others for recruitment, with quite a good number of students being placed. Though you gotta put in your personal efforts if you want to get into any of the good roles. There has been an average package of around 8-10 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Great and vibrant infrastructure with lots of amenities and activities. You have different messes with food that are better compared to other universities that I have known and heard of, and many facilities like a gym, sports like TT, billiards, basketball, football, and many more.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Very good infrastructure and very good amenities.

review_content.Placements: 50 percent of students were placed last year in my course. The lowest package is 2.5 LPA, and the highest package is nearly 5 LPA. Top recruiter companies are AU Bank, SBI Bank and other finance-related companies. Almost 80 percent of students get internships. Roles are cashier, Managerial, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Every corner of our campus has Wi-Fi, and each course has its labs and a central library which has a seating capacity of nearly 500 students. The mess food is average, and the hostel amenities are good. The college has a small clinic for emergencies, and it has a ground for cricket, football, badminton, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: If you have money then only come to this college, else no need.

review_content.Placements: The placement scenario in MUJ is overall quite good. In my course, around 90–94 percent of students get placed. The highest package ranges from 80–84 LPA, and the average is 8–9 LPA. Some of the top recruiters that visited our campus include Amazon, Dell, and Deloitte.
review_content.Infrastructure: MUJ has a modern and well-planned campus. Classrooms are smart and spacious, labs are well-equipped, and the library is excellent. The hostels are clean with good facilities, and the campus has great sports grounds and a vibrant environment. Opt for hostels if you want access to more sports facilities.

review_summary.college_name: Manipal University Jaipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My experience and review at Manipal University Jaipur as a fresher of 2025.

content.Placements: Around 50% of students get jobs in my batch, according to experience. Recruiting companies are Infosys, Dell, Flipkart, Amazon, and Wipro. Project manager, web developer, database manager, and many more roles are offered. The highest is 10 LPA, the lowest is 2-3 LPA, and the average is 5.5 LPA. Around 60% of students get internships in companies like Tata, Infosys, Dell, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: It is the best college according to facilities and infrastructure in all of Rajasthan. Hostels feel like a 5-star residence colony. Everything is available in hostels, hospitals, cafes, shops, parks, gym, sports facilities, and indoor games, almost everything. No need to go out of the hostels for any legal matter. They have professional cooks for the mess, and every day is something different and tasty in the mess.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, self-study is important.

content.Placements: The college provides many opportunities through clubs, internships, competitions, and placement training, but it also depends on students whether they can grab the opportunity. Students who stay focused, work hard, and do consistent study can get the most out of these opportunities and get top placement packages. Self-study is a must.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are above average, with decent rooms, food, and basic amenities, better than those at other colleges I have seen. However, the hostel fees are also on the higher side compared to many other colleges, so it is expensive for some students. You can also apply for a student loan. College is friendly with loan documentation.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It offers supportive faculty members and a good learning environment.

content.Placements: There is no package in architecture, and students themselves need to approach firms they are interested in or apply for higher education. Almost everyone tends to find an appropriate job or college for a master's. The initial roles offered are junior architects, draftsmen, and designers as well.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Manipal University, Jaipur, is top-notch and rewarded with many awards as well. The campus is Griha-rated, which is also a great achievement. Facilities at the hostel are also very good. They take care of students. Their priority is students' safety and health.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Quite a good university giving average placements, great infrastructure, and vibrant culture.

content.Placements: There have been companies like Deloitte, Dell, Amazon, and others for recruitment, with quite a good number of students being placed. Though you gotta put in your personal efforts if you want to get into any of the good roles. There has been an average package of around 8-10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Great and vibrant infrastructure with lots of amenities and activities. You have different messes with food that are better compared to other universities that I have known and heard of, and many facilities like a gym, sports like TT, billiards, basketball, football, and many more.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Very good infrastructure and very good amenities.

content.Placements: 50 percent of students were placed last year in my course. The lowest package is 2.5 LPA, and the highest package is nearly 5 LPA. Top recruiter companies are AU Bank, SBI Bank and other finance-related companies. Almost 80 percent of students get internships. Roles are cashier, Managerial, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Every corner of our campus has Wi-Fi, and each course has its labs and a central library which has a seating capacity of nearly 500 students. The mess food is average, and the hostel amenities are good. The college has a small clinic for emergencies, and it has a ground for cricket, football, badminton, etc.

admission_overview.title: CUSAT Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: CUSAT admissions 2025 are both merit and entrance-based. The university conducts CUSAT CAT or Cochin University of Science and Technology Common Admission Test to shortlist candidates for some of the programme. Entrance exams are also conducted at university level for lateral entry to BTech courses. Apart from CUSAT CAT, Cochin University also accepts CAT, GATE, KMAT, etc. for admission to specific courses. CUSAT conducts Department Admission Test (DAT) for PhD, post-doctoral, and PG diploma programme admission. The university offers more than 50 courses at UG, PG, PhD, post-doctoral, and PG diploma levels in multiple streams like Science, Technology, Management, etc. BTech is the flagship course of CUSAT, admission to which is based on CUSAT CAT scores. Interested candidates can fill out the CUSAT application form online on the university's website.

Candidates have to register, appear for selection rounds and finally book their seats by paying the programme fee. Cochin University of Science and Technology conducts an entrance examination by itself for admissions into both UG and PG courses. However, candidates are also allowed to apply for examination based on scores obtained in any national or state level entrance exams. Below is step-wiseCUSAT admission process:

1: CUSAT Application Process 2025:Candidates can apply online for the course of their choice on the official website of CUSAT. Below is the application fee that aspirants need to pay to register for a course.

CUSAT shortlists candidates for most of the courses based onCUSAT CAT results. CUSAT CAT is a computer-based test which has a different syllabus for each course admission. Below is the admission criteria for the top courses:
CUSAT BTech Admission 2025:CUSAT offers admission to its flagship programme i.e. BTech based on CUSAT CAT scores of the candidates. The university also accepts admission for BTech (lateral entry).

CUSAT Integrated Law Admission 2025:The university offers five-year Integrated Law programmes-BA LLB (Hons), BCom LLB (Hons) and BSc LLB (Hons). The selection for these courses is based on CUSAT CAT scores of the candidates.
CUSAT PG Admission 2025:At the PG level, the university offers MSc, MTech, MBA and LLB programmes. The university accepts scores in GATE for MTech, KMAT, CAT and CMAT for MBA.
CUSAT PhD Admission 2025:The university shortlists candidates for PhD based on their score in DAT. The test has two parts: a written and an interview.

review_content.Placements: 80-85 percent of students are placed in the CSE department. The highest package is 55 LPA, which is off-campus. The average package of on-campus placement is 6 LPA. The lowest package offered is of 3 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, IBM, Cognizant, TCS (Tata Consultancy Services), and Infosys. 75 percent of students got internships from my course, they did internships in TCS, Wipro Technologies, and Infosys. The top roles offered are Software Engineer and Cyber Security Analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the CSE department is good. The hostels are average, but they are big in size and contain a ground in between. Wi-Fi is provided both in the department and the hostel. Classrooms are better and newly made with air conditioning. The library has a vast collection of books, but it's not 24/7. The mess food provided is average. The mess fees are Rs. 18,000 for six months, and the hostel fees are Rs. 30,000 per year. There is a medical facility, but they don't have many medicines. You must go outside for a better curve. There are nearly all sports.

review_content.Placements: Well, as I am in first year, I actually don't know much about placement. All I heard is that the highest package is somewhere about 54 LPA and it is off-campus placement. The campus is huge, with a sports ground, multiple departmental buildings, a library, Wi-Fi across the campus, and medical facilities.

review_summary.college_name: MMMUT Gorakhpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is a good and underrated college of UP, and it is the best college of UP with NIRF ranking of 60.

content.Placements: So many students pass and get placement from here. The highest package of all time is approximately 55 LPA, with an average package of 8 LPA. Many companies like Microsoft, Google, LinkedIn, Unilever, and many more higher companies come to recruit the students. Many students of the college get internships at Adobe, Microsoft, Google, and many more. From my knowledge, at least 70 to 80 percent of students participate in it. The top branches of the college are CS, IT, IoT, etc.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities and infrastructure are here a good Wi-Fi network, excellent labs, a good classroom, and one of the essential things, a good and big library. Food is best in my hostel mess. An ambulance and a doctor's facility are provided. All sports and game areas are there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Balanced academics and extracurricular opportunities.

content.Placements: Our 2025 batch at MMMUT had a pretty solid placement season. Close to 85% of the students who were set for placement got offers, which was encouraging for everyone. The highest package touched around 59 LPA, while the lowest stood around 3-4LPA, and the average package was near 7LPA. Top recruiters include Amazon, NPCL, Bharat Electronics Ltd. IBM, Cognizant, Myntra, Accenture, Apollo, TCS, ACKO, Aditya Birla group are offering diverse opportunities across both II and Core engineering sectors. Internships were also a strong point, with about 60-65% of the students gaining industrial exposure through top companies like Amazon, Tcs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Tier 3 college-wise, it is good and improving.

content.Placements: 80-85 percent of students are placed in the CSE department. The highest package is 55 LPA, which is off-campus. The average package of on-campus placement is 6 LPA. The lowest package offered is of 3 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, IBM, Cognizant, TCS (Tata Consultancy Services), and Infosys. 75 percent of students got internships from my course, they did internships in TCS, Wipro Technologies, and Infosys. The top roles offered are Software Engineer and Cyber Security Analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the CSE department is good. The hostels are average, but they are big in size and contain a ground in between. Wi-Fi is provided both in the department and the hostel. Classrooms are better and newly made with air conditioning. The library has a vast collection of books, but it's not 24/7. The mess food provided is average. The mess fees are Rs. 18,000 for six months, and the hostel fees are Rs. 30,000 per year. There is a medical facility, but they don't have many medicines. You must go outside for a better curve. There are nearly all sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Huge campus, rude faculty, average placements.

content.Placements: Well, as I am in first year, I actually don't know much about placement. All I heard is that the highest package is somewhere about 54 LPA and it is off-campus placement. From seniors, we have heard that placement rates are pretty average. If you are trying to join this college on the basis of only placement, I recommend you choose some other college.
content.Infrastructure: Well, in the starting phase, every first-year student lives under restrictions for three months, which means you cannot go outside on your own. Each student has to form a line, go to class, and return to the hostel after class, that’s all. It is very irritating. The food is pretty decent, so you can manage. We get a good variety with breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner. The campus is huge, with a sports ground, multiple departmental buildings, a library, Wi-Fi across the campus, and medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Not much dissatisfied but overall experience is okay. A good decent college.

content.Placements: Placement in 2021 is 100 percent. The companies that come for placement were Cummins Wheel India. Ltd Flipkart etc. The lowest package for placement is 1.6LPA. The highest role for the placement was Jr. Engineer. Some student got their dream job as they required.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostels are okay, but the mess food is average, as no one can compare it with home food. Wi-Fi is 24hrs classrooms are Centralized AC library is the 3rd the biggest in UP. Medical facilities are available, as a dispensary is there, and sports facilities are also available. Hostel rooms are about 4 persons in 1 room, plus bathrooms are clean, 4 times meal in a day. All includes under 18000 rupees in 6 months and hostel is 30000 for a year.

admission_overview.college_name: MMMUT Gorakhpur Course Admission 2025: Fees, Eligibility, CUET, Dates, Application & Selection Process

paragraphs: MMMUT Gorakhpur admission 2025 is entirely entrance-based.MMMUToffers various UG, PG and Doctoral programmes in the fields of Engineering, Technology, Management, etc. Candidates seeking MMMUT admissions must qualify for the national-level entrance exam for respective courses. For admission to popular courses such as BTech and MTech, candidates have to qualify for JEE Main and GATE, respectively. Whereas, as per the MMMUT admission process, valid CUET UG & CUET PG scores are required to get admission to UG & PG courses. Further, a common MMMUT counselling process is conducted in online mode for the final seat allotment. Read more about MMMUT admission in the following article.

MMMUT offers full-time UG & PG courses. For admission to any of the courses, it's mandatory to fulfil MMMUT eligibility criteria along with the selection criteria for the respective courses. Candidates can also apply for the second year of BTech and BPharm via valid CUET UG scores. Admission to all courses at MMMUT is done through scores of national-level entrance exams. Further, PhD course is offered in both full-time and part-time modes. The university conducts an in-house entrance exam to admit eligible candidates for PhD. Find below the course-wiseMadan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology courseadmissions 2025:

Note:A 5% relaxation in marks is given to the reserved category students.

MMMUT seats may vary for all UG & PG courses. The highest number of seats are available for BTech and the lowest number of seats are available for MBA and MCA. Further, the MMMUT fees include various components such as Tuition Fees, Registration Fees, Hostel Charges, Examination Fees, etc. Candidates can check out the courses-wise MMMUT fees and seats for all courses:
MMMUT admission process consists of multiple rounds, which is inclusive of applying for the course, appearing for the entrance exam, counselling registration and more. Candidates
Step 1: MMMUT Application Process 2025

For admission to MMMUT Gorakhpur, candidates must visit the official website of the respective entrance exams and apply for the same along with paying the application fee. Candidates can apply for their desired course and appear for the exam.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

MMMUT admissions are entirely entrance-based. Admission to all UG & PG courses, except BTech and MTech is done through a valid CUET UG & CUET PG entrance exam scores, respectively. Further, candidates seeking admission to BTech and MTech are done based on scores of JEE Main and GATE exams. The university conducts MET exam for the selection of eligible candidates for PhD courses.
Step 3: Counselling Registration

After the declaration of the final results of the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for on online counselling process on the MMMUT's official website. Aspirants have to submit their entrance exam scores, lock in their course choice and pay the registration amount of INR 2,500.
Step 4: Seat Allotment and Document Verification

The university will allocate seats to candidates through an online counselling process. If seats remain vacant, the university release conducts spot counselling to fill the remaining seats. At last, the selected candidates have to submit their documents online for verification.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good and underrated college of UP, and it is the best college of UP with NIRF ranking of 60.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities and infrastructure are here a good Wi-Fi network, excellent labs, a good classroom, and one of the essential things, a good and big library. Food is best in my hostel mess. An ambulance and a doctor's facility are provided. All sports and game areas are there.

reviews.review_heading: Balanced academics and extracurricular opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The course infrastructure includes Wi-Fi, a proper computer lab, an AI/ml lab, a Chemistry lab, a Physics research lab, spacious classrooms with a smart board, and a well-stocked library for study and research. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms, though the mess food quality varies. Medical support is available on campus, and sports grounds for cricket and football, volleyball, along with games keep student life active.

reviews.review_heading: Tier 3 college-wise, it is good and improving.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the CSE department is good. The hostels are average, but they are big in size and contain a ground in between. Wi-Fi is provided both in the department and the hostel. Classrooms are better and newly made with air conditioning. The library has a vast collection of books, but it's not 24/7. The mess food provided is average. The mess fees are Rs. 18,000 for six months, and the hostel fees are Rs. 30,000 per year. There is a medical facility, but they don't have many medicine...

reviews.review_heading: Huge campus, rude faculty, average placements.
reviews.review_text: Well, in the starting phase, every first-year student lives under restrictions for three months, which means you cannot go outside on your own. Each student has to form a line, go to class, and return to the hostel after class, that’s all. It is very irritating. The food is pretty decent, so you can manage. We get a good variety with breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner. The campus is huge, with a sports ground, multiple departmental buildings, a library, Wi-Fi across the campus, and medical fac...

reviews.review_heading: Not much dissatisfied but overall experience is okay. A good decent college.
reviews.review_text: Our hostels are okay, but the mess food is average, as no one can compare it with home food. Wi-Fi is 24hrs classrooms are Centralized AC library is the 3rd the biggest in UP. Medical facilities are available, as a dispensary is there, and sports facilities are also available. Hostel rooms are about 4 persons in 1 room, plus bathrooms are clean, 4 times meal in a day. All includes under 18000 rupees in 6 months and hostel is 30000 for a year.

reviews.review_heading: MMMUT Gorakhpur college review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were good. Wi-Fi facilities were available in the whole campus building. Modern classrooms with digital boards and projectors were available. Computer labs were also mostly working. A library was present in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms are comfortable, and the environment is good for studying. The mess food is average, some days good, and some days just manageable, but overall okay for students. The campus also has sports grounds, a gym, a health centre, and a decent canteen. The hostel area feels safe and has all the basic facilities like water, electricity backup, and common rooms. The campus and hostel experience is pretty good and student-friendly. The infrastructure for Civil Engineerin...

reviews.review_heading: MMMUT Information Technology review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is getting updated every year. There is Wi-Fi available in the whole campus, including the hostels. The labs are also updated. There are the best PC processors established in the ITCA lab. The hostel is also well & good. The mess is run by the students themselves. The hostel mess is also good. There are restrictions for first-year students. There is also a medical facility available in the college itself.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MMMUT Gorakhpur.
reviews.review_text: It is average, not the most luxurious and modern. Wi-Fi is available everywhere. The library is also good. Regarding the hostel facility, it is not so perfect. The mess food menu is decided by the student group itself. For games and sports, a proper student club is available that organizes events in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty and college life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available 24 hours. Classrooms are all smart and air-conditioned. The library is one of the top libraries. Hostel rooms are quite good. The mess is average, but the variety is more, and facilities are great. A canteen is also available 24 hours if you are craving food.

reviews.review_heading: Average placement in CSE.
reviews.review_text: College is old-fashioned with need of developed infrastructure. Provides Wi-Fi facility, 2 libraries & classrooms are air-conditioned. Few labs are working. Hostel needs renovation. Mess food is average. Medical facility is provided & sports facility too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Madan Mohan Malviya University of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very poor, only the main auditorium is well maintained. Otherwise main academic building and hostel all are not that much good.

reviews.review_heading: Quite a satisfactory college.
reviews.review_text: The college was established in 1962, and it needed renovation in some parts. The lecture halls for 1st year students are quite good and air-conditioned. College provides the facility of library and internet. Hostel provides good food and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: You will find very supportive seniors here who are ready to help you every step.
reviews.review_text: Talking about infrastructure, infrastructure is very average. If we talk about hostel, first year girls are very good compared to the other hostels. All other hostels including boys and girls have decent infrastructure. Wi-Fi facilities are available in every hostel.

reviews.review_heading: MMMUT electrical engineering review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this college is good. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. The labs are also updated. The classrooms have smart board now. This college has dedicated library with a lot of books and capacity. Many students are studying daily. Infrastructure is also developing day-by-day. The hostel is also now developed. The first year hostels have done renovation work recently. The food quality is also awesome. The hostel mess is handled by the students.

faqs.question: Q: How do I get a seat at PSGCT Coimbatore?

individual_reviews.course: M.E. in Embedded and Real Time Systems - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Overall best College for M.E. In the embedded and real time systems course.

content.Placements: Almost all students were placed in our courses. The highest salary is 12 LPA to 15 LPA, which was the minimum. 90% of students received their internships. The top recruiters were Intel, Qualcomm, Robert Bosch, Texas Instruments, etc. The top roles offered were Embedded Software Engineer, Firmware Engineer, and more.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi system was awesome. Classrooms were good. The campus was awesome and clean. The campus had specially designed sports courts for basketball, volleyball, etc. The college system here was amazing, as here things are amazing, which helps us a lot. The college ensures cleanliness, and students also ensure that they do not have any problems inside the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good placements, campus, people, and a better you.

content.Placements: Students above 95% can easily get into our department. The highest package is 12 LPA, the average package is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 2.4 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, and Zifo. Most of the students got their internships, around 50%, with companies like Biozeen, Biocon Ltd, AIIMS, and IGIB. The jobs are related to microbiologists, research scientists, quality control, and bioanalytical techniques.
content.Infrastructure: There is indeed a good Wi-Fi connection, library, and all, but the labs do not have advanced machines and tools. The classrooms are good enough. The hostel is good here. Based on our preference, they provide rooms with two sharing, six sharing, etc. Medical facilities are very good here. There are lots of sports and games activities available. The mess food is really good compared to any other hostels. They provide non-veg food three days a week.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Sc. in Data Science - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: The honest review of PSG College of Technology.

content.Placements: Almost 90 percent of our seniors are placed in good companies. The highest package is 27 LPA, the lowest package is 5 LPA, and the average package is 10 LPA to 12 LPA. The companies that visited our college, that is, TCS, Microsoft, Deloitte, Amazon, Wipro, Zomato, etc. Every student got an internship. There are 2-6 months of internship provided by the placement cell, which is very helpful.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is average in my college, but there is good equipment in the labs and the library. The hostel is also average compared to other colleges. They provide double-sharing rooms, triple-sharing rooms, and four-sharing rooms, but the food is average. I am from Andhra. I didn't like the food, but I came here to get placed in good company, so the students who are coming to place in good company and focusing on studies, I would strongly recommend students come here, and the sports are not as good as those at other colleges.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Production Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely 90% placement, a very good infrastructure, and facilities.

content.Placements: Minimum 50% and maximum 75% were placed. Highest salary is 13 LPA, and the lowest Salary is 4 LPA. Caterpillar and TCS are the top companies for our course. More than 60% students will get internships from our college. Production manager is the top role.
content.Infrastructure: We have a CAD CAM lab, and we have a separate block for our course. Food quality is expected as hostel food, not very good or less good. We have grounds, a football and a basketball court. In our hostel, we have clinic for 24 hours. Lots of sports are here, and a gym also.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Applied Mathematics - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of my college.

content.Placements: Placements in PSG are very good. The campus is visited by a variety of companies, from MNCs to local companies. The college first brings the MNC companies like Goldman Sachs, Intel, Amazon, Microsoft, eBay, etc. Then, the service-based companies like Cognizant, TCS, Wipro, etc., and the local companies are given a chance to recruit our students for those who wish to work in their hometown. During our final year, around 700 got placed in Cognizant, 60 in IBM, 28 in Wipro, 15 in Intel, 10 in eBay, and 8 in Amazon; all these are approximate values.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for M.E. In the embedded and real time systems course.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi system was awesome. Classrooms were good. The campus was awesome and clean. The campus had specially designed sports courts for basketball, volleyball, etc. The college system here was amazing, as here things are amazing, which helps us a lot. The college ensures cleanliness, and students also ensure that they do not have any problems inside the college.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, campus, people, and a better you.
reviews.review_text: There is indeed a good Wi-Fi connection, library, and all, but the labs do not have advanced machines and tools. The classrooms are good enough. The hostel is good here. Based on our preference, they provide rooms with two sharing, six sharing, etc. Medical facilities are very good here. There are lots of sports and games activities available. The mess food is really good compared to any other hostels. They provide non-veg food three days a week.

reviews.review_heading: The honest review of PSG College of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average in my college, but there is good equipment in the labs and the library. The hostel is also average compared to other colleges. They provide double-sharing rooms, triple-sharing rooms, and four-sharing rooms, but the food is average. I am from Andhra. I didn't like the food, but I came here to get placed in good company, so the students who are coming to place in good company and focusing on studies, I would strongly recommend students come here, and the sports are n...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely 90% placement, a very good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have a CAD CAM lab, and we have a separate block for our course. Food quality is expected as hostel food, not very good or less good. We have grounds, a football and a basketball court. In our hostel, we have clinic for 24 hours. Lots of sports are here, and a gym also.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The course curriculum provided in the college is on par with international standards. All the subjects are provided with an up-to-date curriculum review and are changed whenever a new and upcoming technology is dominating the market. Rooms are spacious; first-year students have to share the room, but from the second year onward, they are free to decide whether they want to continue or want a separate room. Rooms are plenty; there has never been any type of shortage. PGs' average rental at my tim...

reviews.review_heading: Good college for your future.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure. The hostel food is good. Medical facilities are quite nice. We can join sports. We need to pay for the canteen if we buy extra food, but the food is quite tasty. Lemon juice is most common in the canteen. Many games and guidance are available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the college, and it is well-known throughout Tamil Nadu.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and it is traditional, which was built 70 years ago. It is a continuously developing college because 65% of the income will be given to the importance of infrastructure, and it is continuously done by the principal, Prakasan Sir.

reviews.review_heading: On an overall, it is a worthwhile college for placements and the development of your skills.
reviews.review_text: There are a wide range of labs available in the college. The college gives more priority to placements and academics, and not to the infrastructure. However, the required facilities for academics and students are available. The library plays a major role. Three canteens are available, and hostel facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied and value my knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The food in the canteen is good. Libraries are available for 6 days and they will be very useful. Labs are well-built and have a good network connection. Hostel food will be good and timings are strictly followed for girls and boys. They are maintaining the hostel well like cleaning and washing, and machines washing cloths are available for free cost for girls. Sports activities are available and extra time will be provided for them.

reviews.review_heading: My college experience at PSG.
reviews.review_text: There are libraries for each department and Wi-Fi facility throughout the campus with varying internet speed. There are air-conditioners, seminar halls, and classrooms available. The quality of food is acceptable in mess and comparatively good in canteen. There is a clinic inside the hostel for medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good and we have chosen the best college. Placements are also good.
reviews.review_text: At PSG College of Technology, we have a fabulous infrastructure. Lab facilities are well and good. The quality of facilities in our hostel is good, and the food is clean and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the college life in PSG College of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The college is provided with free Wi-Fi in every nook and corner. The department has its own library and labs are provided with clean equipments in good working conditions. The hostel facilities are good. The management solve most of the problems we put forth and the food is also good both in mess and canteen.

reviews.review_heading: My experience as an aspiring production engineer.
reviews.review_text: We have specialized CAD/CAM labs. Library is there for our department. We have an open laboratory for experimenting with new ideas. There is Wi-Fi throughout the campus with varying internet speeds. The quality of food is moderate to good differing each day. The canteen food is absolutely good. There are clinics inside our hostel and sports complex inside our hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the faculty, syllabus, freedom, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: PSG College of Technology has a decent infrastructure. It has a common library for 4 floors which contains almost all books needed for students to prepare for semester exams. Books for competitive exams like GATE, CAT, etc., are also available. The entire college is provided with a Wi-Fi facility and labs have a wide range of instruments in good working conditions. PSG has a wide range of sports. The food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic and good in taste.

reviews.review_heading: My college life, unfiltered.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities are good. We have excellent and well-equipped lab facilities and a large library. Wi-Fi is there, but the signal is not good everywhere. Hostel facilities are moderate to good. Some blocks are very good, like Q Block, and it depends on personal preference. The food quality is moderate, and there aren’t many changes in the menu.

reviews_list.review_title: An absolutely amazing college, and better than taking a drop.

review_content.Placements: In Mechanical engineering, 120 out of 200 students got placed. Top recruiting companies are Bajaj, Ford, L&T, Tata Motors, and Goldman Sachs. Top roles are software engineer, data analyst, finance, and general manager. The highest package is 34 LPA, the average is 9.2 LPA, and the lowest is 5 LPA. Internship rate is 20 percent.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi in all hostels, labs, classrooms, etc. More than sufficient non-veg food is available, but veg food quality is debatable. Top medical facilities are available. Multiple ambulances are present 24/7. The college provides free bus transport across campus. All sports are played here, mainly football, basketball, badminton, and handball. Two large plain sandy grounds pending infrastructure, an upcoming indoor sports complex, obviously all these things will also be available after we leave this college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028

review_content.Placements: About 85% of students who participated in the placement drive were placed in the 2024-25 placement, with the lowest package of 5 LPA and the highest of 43 LPA, with an average of 13.8 LPA. Core placement was less for B.Tech ECE students, and most of it was for software companies. For internships, 22.7% of students who registered secured one for the year 2025.
review_content.Infrastructure: NIT Calicut has one of the greatest infrastructures compared to many other colleges. Every classroom has Wi-Fi, projectors, etc. The technical team is quickly available whenever there are any issues regarding these while taking classes. Food is also of good quality, maintaining diversity by providing foods from different parts of India. Sports teams and cultural clubs are also very active in NIT Calicut. I think NIT Calicut is the NIT with the most number of clubs, which include both technical and cultural.

overview_faqs.question: Is NIT Calicut worth all the hype?
overview_faqs.answer: National Institute of Technology, Calicut, also known as NIT Calicut, is one of the oldest NITs in India and has been ranked 2 under the 'Architecture and Planning' category and 21 under the 'Engineering' category by NIRF 2025. The college offers a wide range of programmes to students, mainly in the Engineering and Technology fields. Further, the college has a decent connection with top-notch companies such as Accenture, ADP, Amazon, Amdocs, Baja Auto, American Express, etc.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Calicut Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The highest package last year was 50.64 LPA.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed in our college is 80 percent. The highest package in our college is 50.64 LPA, and the average package in our college is 18.75 LPA. Many MNCs are coming to our college to hire students. The top role offered in our branch is a VLSI design engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Many facilities are also provided in our college, like a cricket ground, a football ground, and many others. Wi-Fi facility is also provided in our college. The mess food is also acceptable, and a health center is also available in our college, and many sports are also available in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The highest package in our college was 50.64 LPA in 2025.

content.Placements: Last year, our campus placement was 90 percent. The highest package was 50.64 LPA, and the average package was 12.17. Top roles offered in our branch were VLSI design engineer, and the internship percentage was 24.4 percent of students were interns, and PG students were 18.62 percent.
content.Infrastructure: We have separate buildings for class and labs. We also have a huge library where we can read many books, and a Wi-Fi facility is available in our hostels. Mess food is acceptable, a health center is also available in our college, and there are three canteens in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: An absolutely amazing college, and better than taking a drop.

content.Placements: In Mechanical engineering, 120 out of 200 students got placed. Top recruiting companies are Bajaj, Ford, L&T, Tata Motors, and Goldman Sachs. Top roles are software engineer, data analyst, finance, and general manager. The highest package is 34 LPA, the average is 9.2 LPA, and the lowest is 5 LPA. Internship rate is 20 percent.
content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi in all hostels, labs, classrooms, etc. More than sufficient non-veg food is available, but veg food quality is debatable. Top medical facilities are available. Multiple ambulances are present 24/7. The college provides free bus transport across campus. All sports are played here, mainly football, basketball, badminton, and handball. Two large plain sandy grounds pending infrastructure, an upcoming indoor sports complex, obviously all these things will also be available after we leave this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Strong curriculum and a good culture of extra activities.

content.Placements: About 85% of students who participated in the placement drive were placed in the 2024-25 placement, with the lowest package of 5 LPA and the highest of 43 LPA, with an average of 13.8 LPA. Core placement was less for B.Tech ECE students, and most of it was for software companies. For internships, 22.7% of students who registered secured one for the year 2025.
content.Infrastructure: NIT Calicut has one of the greatest infrastructures compared to many other colleges. Every classroom has Wi-Fi, projectors, etc. The technical team is quickly available whenever there are any issues regarding these while taking classes. Food is also of good quality, maintaining diversity by providing foods from different parts of India. Sports teams and cultural clubs are also very active in NIT Calicut. I think NIT Calicut is the NIT with the most number of clubs, which include both technical and cultural.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Last year many students got placed in our college.

content.Placements: 84.67 percent of our college students were placed last year. The highest package of our college is 50.64 LPA, and the average package is 13.28 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Samsung, Microsoft, and many more. 22 percent of students got internships in the summer, and the top role is a VLSI designer.
content.Infrastructure: Many facilities are available in our college for the ECE department. We have a library with many resources in it, and there is also a separate lab for the ECE department. The classrooms are also huge. There are Wi-Fi facilities in our hostels and a health center.

Admission to the National Institute of Technology, Calicut courses is done on an entrance basis. The admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. For admission to thefour-year Integrated Teacher Education (ITEP) programme, candidates can reach out to the admission office contact number. TheJEE Advanced 2025official website has launched with the new eligibility criteria. As per the official website, candidates can now attempt theJEE Advanced 2025 exama maximum of three times in three consecutive years.Below is the complete process forNIT Calicut admission:
NIT Calicut Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at NIT Calicut are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For admission to MBA, MA and PhD courses apply through NIT Clicut website.
Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Calicut admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats throughJoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Calicut MBA admissions are done through the CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Calicut cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.question: Is direct admission available for BTech at NIT Calicut?
faqs.answer: No, admission to NIT Calicut BTech course is entirely based on merit obtained in JEE Main entrance exam. The students who secure a score greater than or equal to the cutoff marks become eligible for participation in the JoSAA counselling, which is conducted for the final seat allotment. Futher, vacant seats are filled with CSAB Counselling process.

faqs.answer: Yes, the technology institute offersMScin Physics as a full-time course. Admission to the course is through IIT JAM followed by CCMN counselling. The seat intake for the course is 25. In addition, the total tuition fee is INR 30,000. However, the mentioned fee and seat intake is as per unofficial sources and thus may vary.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility requirement for admission to the NIT Calicut MSc course?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a BSc or equivalent UG degree with at least 60% aggregate or 6.5/10 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0/10 CGPA for SC/ST/PWD category) are eligible to apply for an MSc course of NIT Calicut. The aspirants must hold the UG mark sheets and pass certificates as proof of eligibility. The institute admits candidates only after document verification.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in NIT Calicut?
faqs.answer: No, NIT Calicut does not facilitate direct admission to any of the courses. Admission is entirely based on merit in the national-level exams, including JEE Main,  GATE,  IIT JAM,  CAT,  NIMCET,  UGC NET, etc. Candidates are further required to participate in other selection rounds, such as counselling, written exam, and interview as well, as per the applied course selection criteria.

faqs.question: What are the courses that NIT Calicut offers?
faqs.answer: The institute offers two undergraduate courses, five postgraduate courses, and one doctoral course. The offered courses by NIT Calicut are as namely BTech, BArch, MTech, MSc, MBA, MPlan, MCA, and PhD. These courses are available in multiple specialisations, including Chemistry,Computer Science and Engineering,Finance,Human Resources,Information Technology, etc.

description: NIT Calicut cutoff 2025 for BTech, MTech, and other courses are available on this page. Candidates preparing for the next academic session can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the NIT Calicut JEE Main cutoff 2025 along with other exams for different courses, rounds, and categories. Further exam-related updates are below:

In this section, candidates can view the last nine years of NIT Calicut JEE Main cutoff ranks for various courses and categories by clicking on the download now links provided below to understand the past years' trends.

NIT Calicut JEE Main cutoff 2025 for the first and last rounds are tabulated below for the General AI category students. In the last round, the NIT Calicut CSE cutoff 2025 was 5964 in the General category belonging to the AI quota. For other core branches, such as ECE and Mechanical, the JEE Main last round closing ranks for admission were 10820 and 23766, respectively for the General category. The cutoff ranks for core BTech branches are usually on the lower side, indicating competitive cutoff

For the General AI category students, the NIT Calicut B.E. / B.Tech cutoff 2025 ranged between 5964 and 41289 in the last round. Considering the lowest cutoff ranks of 5964 and 10820, B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering were the top two most competitive branches for admission among the students belonging to the General category.

JEE Main is the accepting exam for admission to the BTech and other UG courses. Qualified candidates are then eligible for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling process for final seat allocation. In this section, aspirants can find out all the important JEE Main 2026 dates to be eligible for admission.

JoSAA counselling 2025 is now over for admission to the Engineering courses offered at NIT Calicut. In 2025, the JoSAA counselling was conducted for up to six rounds. Further counselling rounds were conducted by CSAB to fill the vacant seats. Students who appeared for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling rounds can refer to the table below to view or download the round- and year-wise JEE Main cutoff lists for BTech admission at NIT Calicut to understand the cutoff trends.

Tabulated below are the BTech specialisations available for admission based on the last round closing ranks of JEE Main. This will help students to make an informed decision to get the right college and specialisation for admission. The options below are available for students belonging to the General AI quota and are in the range of the most competitive BTech specialisation of NIT Calicut. To refine their searches, students can also use the provided filters.

As per the GATE cutoff 2025, the top two most challenging M.E./M.Tech specialisations were M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Information Security) with last round cutoff scores of 656 and 624, respectively, for the General AI quota. In the table below, candidates can view the branch-wise first and last round cutoff scores.

Tabulated below are the GATE CCMT last round cutoff scores for 2025, 2024 and 2023 across different rounds, categories and quotas. For the General AI quota, the last round cutoff scores varied between 351 and 656. While for the OBC category students, the final round cutoff scores were concluded between the range of 306 and 618 in the AI quota.

Candidates can refer to the table below to view some of the important GATE 2026 dates to be eligible for admission to the ME/MTech course. GATE is the accepting exam, followed by the CCMT counselling process for admission.

Tabulated below are the GATE cutoff lists across different rounds and years for ME/MTech admission at NIT Calicut - National Institute of Technology. The consolidated cutoff list will help students understand the past years cutoff trends.

NIT Calicut CCMN cutoff 2025 concluded with the release of the final seat allotment result for MSc/MSc Tech courses. M.Sc. in Chemistry turned out to be the most competitive option with a lowest last round closing rank of 984 for the students belonging to the General AI quota. The easiest option for admission was M.Sc. in Physics, as the admission cutoff was comparatively more relaxed for the students. The last round cutoff for the same specialisation was 1148.

NIT Calicut M.Sc. cutoff 2025 was released up to 5 rounds across different categories of students belonging to AI quota. In 2025, the maximum cutoff rank required was 1148 for M.Sc. admission in the General AI category. Please note that cutoff rank for different specialisations, rounds and categories. Considering the last round cutoff, M.Sc. in Chemistry emerged as a top choice among the General category, with its cutoff rank settling at 984.

CCMN is the centralised platform for admissions to the MSc and MSc (Tech Programmes) at NITs, IIEST Shibpur, and some CFTI institutes that accept the IIT JAM scorecard. This year, CCMN counselling was conducted for three regular rounds and two special rounds for MSc admission across different participating institutes. Candidates preparing for NIT Calicut admission can refer to the table below to view or download the year- and round-wise CCMN cutoff list.

Along with the JEE Main ranks, NIT Calicut also accepts DASA UG scores for the BTech course. For NIT Calicut cutoff 2022, the closing rank for DASA UG for B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering was 724, followed by B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering at 298 and then B.Tech. in Engineering Physics at 190. Candidates seeking admission to BTech through DASA UG can check out the previous year round-wise and category-wise scores in the table below:

Considering the last round of NIT Calicut CCMT cutoff 2025, core M.E./M.Tech branches, including Computer Science and Engineering and Computer Science and Engineering (Information Security), witnessed higher cutoffs for admission, while branches such as Microelectronics and VLSI Design and Electronics Design and Technology had comparatively relaxed cutoff scores for admission in the General category under the AI quota.

reviews.review_text:

reviews.review_heading: About good campus life and hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good with changing room allotments by year. In the first year, rooms are shared by 3 students (earlier 4). Second and third years stay in the Mega hostel with 2 students per room. In the final year, students can choose the campus hostels or the Mega hostel, with a single room provided. Wi-Fi or LAN is provided to all the hostels. Mess food is better than that in many colleges, with multiple mess options available. There is a health center outside the main campus.

reviews.review_heading: I had a wonderful journey with NDIM.
reviews.review_text: The institute has a separate room for preparation, a mock PI ampitheatre, an Auditorium with 350+ accommodation, and a library with a lot of books. The college has fully Wi-Fi campus, great classroom atmosphere. There are staff who take care of all your requirements.

reviews.review_heading: My placement journey with NDIM.
reviews.review_text: We have an excellent infrastructure with ample amount of digital books available in the library, an auditorium with 250+ seating capacity, and an excellent incubation centre to help us with the resources. Our classrooms are teach-enabled and air conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Good place to do an MBA among Tier 3 colleges. The college provides great placements.
reviews.review_text: Labs have computers for large classrooms, Wi-Fi, a library, and classrooms are digital with ACs and now air purifiers. There are incubation centers for students. However, the hostel facility is really poor. The mess is average as it cannot accommodate a large crowd. The indoor games facility includes table tennis, pool, carrom, and chess, but there are no outdoor facilities.

reviews.review_heading: My wonderful journey at NDIM.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is good, like a huge library with an adequate amount of books and good digital e-books. A good amphitheater with a huge capacity of around 350 students, a huge auditorium where various events take place, and two buildings with multiple classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: I got placed in 13 months at Deloitte.
reviews.review_text: NDIM provides best-in-class infrastructure, a well-maintained library and computer labs, and a canteen. Facilities like an amphitheatre and auditorium are available. Classes are equipped with air purifiers, keeping in mind the safety and hygiene of students and staff.

reviews.review_heading: My amazing journey at NDIM.
reviews.review_text: Our classes are equipped with virtual boards. The entire campus has high-speed Wi-Fi. We have a large auditorium for corporate mentoring sessions, incubation centres, and a well-resourced library with daily newspapers for quick reading about day-to-day aspects. We also have an amphitheatre with a large seating arrangement.

reviews.review_heading: Journey at New Delhi Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: We have separate rooms available for mock interviews. Library is not just for study but serves you a whole place for extra co-curriculum and the tools that give me access to different grounds. Auditorium has a great space for accommodation for about 600 students. We have a play area as well, where we can make ourselves stress-free. The canteen serves good food and an environment that feels like home.

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics, supportive faculty, and practical learning.
reviews.review_text: NDIM offers very good infrastructure with classrooms. It features air purifiers and dedicated IT labs for data visualization courses. A rich library for research. A conference room is designed for group discussions and interviews. This creates a professional and comfortable learning environment.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful journey with NDIM.
reviews.review_text: We have 2 buildings, both of which have smart classes. There is a library where we have access to various course books and materials, magazines, and newspapers. We have CSD chambers wherein we are given rigorous training for placements, like mock, PIs, and GD.

reviews.review_heading: My journey from Ranchi to NDIM. It is pretty amazing.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure at the college are good. We have digital boards in all the classes and all the rooms are air-conditioned. We have multiple canteens around our campus area with good food. There's also a decent amount of greenery. We have 3 labs on the campus and multiple Wi-Fi networks. There is also a library with ample reading space. There's a medical room with all the requirements.

reviews.review_heading: Journey with New Delhi Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is great for Management students as it gives you the vibe and experience of the corporate world. We have a world-class library, computer lab, and classrooms. We have an auditorium with a capacity of 400 students at one time. Great place to start your professional journey.

reviews.review_heading: My 1.5 years of experiential learning at NDIM.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent, and air-conditioned classrooms are well-equipped with the latest technologies. The IT labs have all the latest software, such as UiPath. We have an amphitheater with soundproofing and an auditorium with a capacity of 300 students.

reviews.review_heading: NDIM is the best college for PGDM.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at NDIM is really good, as NDIM has smart classes that help students to learn through artificial intelligence. The library at NDIM helps students to prepare for the examinations. The mock Personal Interview rooms are specifically allocated so that students can have their interviews with the companies.

reviews.review_heading: Early placement in 12 months.
reviews.review_text: All classes are equipped with smart boards, sound systems, Wi-Fi, table tennis, and pool tables are available for all the students to use. There are multiple canteens to choose from. Medical facility is also provided. There are rooms for one session with faculty and aptitude tests.

reviews.review_heading: My wonderful journey at NDIM.
reviews.review_text: The campus features fully air-conditioned, ICT-enabled classrooms equipped with projectors, smart boards, creating an interactive learning environment. The library is fully computerized, facilitating efficient resource management and easy access to information.

overview_faqs.question: How is hostel fee charged for the candidates who join in the middle of the session at Jamia Hamdard?
overview_faqs.answer: At Jamia Hamdard, the hostel fee is charged for the whole academic year. If a student is allotted the hostel in the middle of the session, the hostel charges are then calculated quarterly as mentioned below:First quarter: July 1 to September 30Second quarter: October 1 to December 31Third quarter: January 1 to March 31Fourth Quarter: April 1 to June 30

overview_faqs.question: Is hostel fee refunded in case of admission cancellation at Jamia Hamdard?
overview_faqs.answer: In case a student does not join the hostel but informs the Provost Office within a week after payment of the hostel fee about the withdrawal, the hostel charges are then refunded after deduction of INR 1000. In case the student withdraws admission within one month of joining of hostel, the fee is refunded after a deduction of 25% of the hostel fee. In any other case, no fee except security deposit is refundable. It is refunded to the hosteller after he/she has paid all dues and vacated the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to relax and only degree, then go.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are enough, okay, but infrastructure needs construction, and some classes are not well organized. So Wi-Fi also does work proper. The hostel is good, but there is also a bad thing about wash room. Overall, there is no much facilities provide as other.

reviews.review_heading: Truly satisfied with the campus life and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Amazing infrastructure; they provide Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, a decent library, and they have around 4–5 canteens with good quality food. They conduct sports events and tournaments every few months, so overall a good experience. I don’t have any idea about hostel, but the rest everything is nice, and they also have a hospital on campus.

reviews.review_heading: I am not saying that the college is bad, but the students are.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. Labs are not good, systems don't work often. Only cricket is good, no other sport. Everything is taken lightly, and there are fights very often.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need ...

reviews.review_heading: Not the best but not the worst either.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi service is available, but it rarely works, and data services are negligible here. A lot of issues arise because of that. Classrooms are normal college classrooms with no AC and old fans. The library is functional with a huge number of books but most are outdated. The hostel facilities are great with good rooms, AC, and water supply. The curfew time is 9:30 PM, and the food is a bit hygienic, but not that bad. The sports facilities are great with a huge ground available, and other sports eq...

reviews.review_heading: Poor infrastructure, bad class management, no placements, but good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. Wi-Fi works only in specific places. Labs are okay, but water facilities and chemicals are missing, and equipment does not work. The hostel is good overall, and the food is good. Safety is a priority, and the hospital is nearby. There is a sports week, and the main focus is on sports and games too.

reviews.review_heading: It is a cute college with nice studies.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not that great. Food is also okay, not very good, and not very bad either. Hostels are clean. College has an AC lecture theatre, library, and computer labs. Washrooms are nice. The college is overall not very big, but it has a cozy vibe.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Hamdard University review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs are available for students, and a maximum of 60 students can be in a classroom. The library is also available to assist students. Safe and separate hostels with good hygienic food quality are available for boys and girls. Majeedia Hospital provides medical facilities, and sports grounds are available for games.

reviews.review_heading: Review by a CSE day scholar student.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classrooms are without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review by student living life on campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classes also have projectors but without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the evergreen Jamia Hamdard University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course is well-maintained. It has Wi-Fi, computer labs for doing editing on photoshops, Premiere Pro, Adobe software, and studios for news and radio. It provides a lot of hands-on workshops. The interior of the college where students sit is well-organised and has 99 names of Allah, where everyone feels peace alone at their free time.

reviews.review_heading: The college has supportive faculty, a room with solid placement, and is industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: Jamia Hamdard offers well-equipped laps, Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, a rich library diverse sports facilities, and so on. The campus has a hygienic mess and canteen, reliable medical services, and a sports complex for indoor and outdoor games ensuring holistic student development.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is so clean and green. It was not good in past 2010 but now it is so good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is provided on our campus like Wi-Fi and AC. Classrooms have desks and furniture. Especially every building has its own library. There are certain canteens also with good quality food. Boys and girls have separate hostels and hygiene is also good in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the campus is beautiful teachers are helpful and cooperative, and the placements are okay.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi does not work properly and the college campus has jammers so cell internet doesn't work. Classrooms are getting better in facilities. There are overpriced snacks and food like coffee around 150ml is for Rs. 40 which is very helpful in summer. The campus events can be good if the management is done properly.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the campus, really good teaching staff and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The buildings are old. Well-equipped Labs and Classroom. The central library is the famous building of our college. The campus is very large and vast.  It has a hostel facility for girls. There are so many Pgs nearby. The food is very tasty. More than 6 canteens are there. A very sports complex is there with a Gym, basketball court volleyball, football, badminton, and tennis court.

data.description: Hamdard University Delhi consists of experienced and highly qualified faculty members. Hamdard University also invites various popular guest faculty and frequently arranges conferences, and several workshops to provide training and for enhancing the knowledge of the students. faqs.question: What entrance exam scores does College of Engineering, Anna University accept for admission to B Tech?

faqs.answer: A:    CEG admits students to its BSc courses based on marks obtained on Higher Secondary Examination (Class 12) from recognised boards. Recognised boards include CBSE, ICSE, West Bengal and any other board subject to verification of the HSC certificate. Thus any candidate who has passed Class 12 and has obtained relevant HSC certificate is eligible to apply for BSc courses at CEG.Note: College of Engineering Guindy is affiliated with Anna university. faqs.answer: A:     Yes, the TNEA score is required to avail admission to the College of Engineering, Anna University. Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions is a state-level admission process conducted by Anna University for admission to various engineering institutions in Tamil Nadu. The eligibility criteria for the same require candidates to have passed 10+2 examinations from a recognised board with a minimum of 50% marks in  (PCM) Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. The TNEA counselling process includes registration, choice filling, allotment, payment of the fee and physical reporting to the allotted college. Admission to the college is granted based on class 12th or prerequisite scores.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of good placements and faculty members.

content.Placements: Mostly, 80 percent of the students in Anna University Chennai got placements in good companies. The highest package is around 30 LPA to 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA to 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are TCS, Wipro, Accenture, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Anna University Chennai is good, and laboratories and libraries are available. They provide separate hostels for both boys and girls with free Wi-Fi. Hostel food is not bad. Average in taste. They give importance to sports as well as studies.

individual_reviews.course: M.E. in Environmental Management - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I like hostel life more as college is strict.

content.Placements: The students from 3rd semester were eligible for placements. Companies like Toyota, EY, Micromax, Accenture, KPMG, Delliote, etc., will come to hire the freshers. The highest package offered was around 20 LPA, and the lowest package was around 4 LPA. The percentage of students getting placed was 70-80%. My plans after degree were to work for 5 years in an MNC.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus was good enough to accommodate 2500 students including two colleges as we had two colleges under the same campus. Blocks were different but common facilities were shared be it library, canteens, sports ground, or the perpetual seminar halls. We had plenty at our campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Industrial Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The pride in sharing the greatness of Asia's oldest college.

content.Placements: In our course last year, around 81% of students got placed. The remaining students opt for higher studies abroad. So the remaining students do not apply for placements. The students are being given an enormous number of opportunities for placements.
content.Infrastructure: It is the best infrastructure available among the government colleges. The standards and the fees that we pay are very different. Though the fee is low. The infrastructure is very good. The greenery of the trees within the campus gives a good feeling to stay.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Industrial Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My college is a 10 for those who prefer exposure rather than infrastructure.

content.Placements: 50% of students got placed in IT companies and manufacturing companies, mechanical sectors as well. Remaining students focused on building their own company, and some of them are getting into higher studies. The highest package known to me was 18LPA, and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Companies like TATA, Hyundai, Mahindra, CATERPILLAR, etc. Roles offered are mechanical, automobile, manufacturing, management, data analytics, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, but the maintenance is poor. Wi-Fi is available, but it lags sometimes. Medical facilities are good enough, and the food is also good. But there is no proper maintenance of restrooms and infrastructure. The canteen still doesn't have Epay, but it is still in development. Cleanliness is at its worst on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good college with nice campus and social life.

content.Placements: 26 LPA is the highest package and 5.6 LPA is the lowest, and 6 LPA is the average. Associate engineer is the position offered. Caterpillar recruits more freshers here 70% of students are placed/in internships. The exact numbers are not known off-campus students are like 10.
content.Infrastructure: The campus life is lot enjoyable. There are lot of space to spend time inside campus, like clubs. Architecture classes are quite good. You can have Wi-Fi access on laptops for free. A wide range of sports are available. Two canteens are available. Hostel and mess food is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of good placements and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Anna University Chennai is good, and laboratories and libraries are available. They provide separate hostels for both boys and girls with free Wi-Fi. Hostel food is not bad. Average in taste. They give importance to sports as well as studies.
