reviews.review_text: Our campus was good enough to accommodate 2500 students including two colleges as we had two colleges under the same campus. Blocks were different but common facilities were shared be it library, canteens, sports ground, or the perpetual seminar halls. We had plenty at our campus.

reviews.review_heading: The pride in sharing the greatness of Asia's oldest college.
reviews.review_text: It is the best infrastructure available among the government colleges. The standards and the fees that we pay are very different. Though the fee is low. The infrastructure is very good. The greenery of the trees within the campus gives a good feeling to stay.

reviews.review_heading: My college is a 10 for those who prefer exposure rather than infrastructure.

But there is no proper maintenance of restrooms and infrastructure. The canteen still doesn't have Epay, but it is still in development. Cleanliness is at its worst on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with nice campus and social life.

You can have Wi-Fi access on laptops for free. A wide range of sports are available. Two canteens are available. Hostel and mess food is decent.

reviews.review_heading: I highly recommend, it is good.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available for laptops, and the library is really good with sufficient books and infrastructure. Hostel infrastructure is good, but the taste of mess food is a con, especially lunch. It is really a good college for sports, PPL in ball badminton, hockey, and throw ball. Health facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Anna University College, Chennai for M.E course.
reviews.review_text: The best quality of infrastructure and hostel facilities are also available. College department and hostel facilities include classrooms, lab, fast internet, garden, gym, lift elevator, etc. Canteen food is also good and many varieties of food are available.

reviews.review_heading: My experience of M.Sc. electronic media at Anna University.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of Anna University is good. University is well-managed for students. Labs are advanced. Library has more than 1 lakhs books and journals and full campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostel is clean and well-managed. Mess has separate vegetarian and nonvegetarian food. So this is a better option for students who are vegetarian.

reviews.review_heading: Quality education with strong placements and affordable fees.
reviews.review_text: For my course, they provide good infrastructure with high-speed network in Wi-Fi and data. It provides well-organized labs and wonderful Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan library which has more than 40,000 books. The canteen provides food 3 times a day with good quality and good taste.

reviews.review_heading: Anna University is well satisfied with placements and exploration.
reviews.review_text: All the students of the college are provided with Anna Wi-Fi. The speed of the Wi-Fi is quite enough for academics. There is a health centre inside the campus, which is open to all students, faculty members, etc. There is a huge library inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Anna University, Chennai in the year 2025 admission in M.Tech course information.
reviews.review_text: This college provides the best facilities. They use high-quality infrastructure, products, and materials. This college provides facilities like classrooms, labs, benches, a library, fans, bathrooms, computers, etc. Facilities are available. This college has a canteen. Its food is very tasty and clean.

reviews.review_heading: Good exposure and campus.
reviews.review_text: The department has working labs and classrooms. There is a common library for all students within and outside the nearby campus. You cannot connect to data on your mobile within the department, but they will provide students with Wi-Fi that can be registered with your laptop. The quality of food is subpar in the international hostel. It is very repetitive. Housekeeping is prompt. The medical center closes by 5 pm, so in case of emergency, you have to visit Malar hospital nearby. Sports culture i...

reviews.review_heading: Vibrant Campus Life at CEG.
reviews.review_text: Even though our college is 200 years old, all the infrastructure is present and is very much available for students. But, we may not have a mobile network on the college campus. But there is Wi-Fi present all around the campus so it is very much helpful. Labs have very high facilities like the computers software required are very much pre-installed and ready to use. Hostels are affordable and manageable but still a bit of improvement is required.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, nothing negative as such.

The quality of the facilities that are provided to us in our hostel is really good, and the medical facilities are also really great.

The hostel rooms are spacious, and they provide all the necessary facilities.

reviews.review_text: The best thing about this college is Infrastructure, Located in the capital city of Gujarat I. e Gandhinagar popularly known as Green city. Good sports ground covering Football ground, cricket ground with a proper cement pitch, basketball court etc. Are well managed.

Hostel rooms are spacious with proper facilities. No infrastructure problems were faced except the chairs and Wi-Fi.

Hostel Rooms are also very much good which are having all the facilities which are required.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, infrastructure, events in the college and also good placement.

It helps to expand the opportunities for students as well as professionals to develop intellectual knowledge base with leadership skills.

The hostel rooms are spacious and well equipped.

The campus provides high-speed internet facilities. The library has been an integral part of SPM campus which has been a boon.

hostel.description:
JIMS Hostel is located within 4 kms of radius from the institute, the hostel for boys provides excellent facilities for dining and sports area and well connected through public transport. The girls' hostel has 32 double occupancy rooms and 3 single occupancy rooms. The allocation of rooms is done on the basis of seniority and academic performance of the students. Hostel facilities include boarding, lodging and mess services.
The institute provides well-furnished hostel facility exclusively for males and females. The aim of the hostel is to make it a home away from home. It has spacious rooms with windows opening into balcony, other facilities include common room and dining room, Apart from the infrastructural soundness, it provides sufficient scope for interaction and relationship-building. It provides a congenial atmosphere that gives the new students full scope to know their seniors, learn from them, leverage their knowledge and build lasting relations with them. It is also a common sight to find study groups and project groups working away into the night in the hostel rooms. These interactions play an especially important role in a student’s life during placements and examinations.
facilities: Conference Rooms - The conference rooms are there to provide the necessary space for interactive and also experiential learning. The students participate in a large variety of activities that are designed specifically to enhance their skill sets

Auditorium - The college has 2 auditoriums on the campus. A large no. of activities can be hosted here. The auditorium provides a collaborative space for various students to interact with and also to get inspired by the visiting guests
Amphitheater - The amphitheater is a space for various student activities, fostering collaboration and creativity

Hostel and cafeteria - The college provides comfortable hotel facilities for male and female students. The hostels have spacious and well-ventilated rooms with a window and also a balcony. The college provides healthy and also fulfilling meals for students to ensure students are always fit and also energetic.

library.description: JIMS has two well stacked and fully equipped libraries separately for management and information technology programmes. The institute subscribes to a large number of national and international magazines, periodicals, journals and research paper of repute. The libraries also have reputed software packages of several journals. As a matter of policy, the institute pays special attention not only to strengthening the library with additional books and journals, but also to ensure that they are utilized well by the students both for their courses as well as to extend the frontiers of their general knoweldge. Audio and multimedia versions of some course modules are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with this college. The college has good placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In this college, the infrastructure is not too good, not too bad. Overall, it is normal, and students can enjoy the infrastructure. They conduct many events in their college, and overall, students can enjoy their infrastructure. They also provide a library and Wi-Fi to their students.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good; its infrastructure and faculty are all good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is average, not too good, but their classes and library are good. The only problem with the infrastructure is that their buildings are very small. There is a canteen which is also very small. Labs, classrooms, and the library are good, but the buildings are very small.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jagan Institute of Management Studies, Rohini.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very average. The campus is small. All the other facilities like the number of floors, and canteen have a very small space. There is no ground for sports for the students. The crowd is quite high during events which leads to overcrowding.

reviews.review_heading: PGDM in retail management at JIMS Rohini.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is compact but it has all the facilities. There are retail labs, where we learn how retail operations work. We have smart classrooms and two libraries with many books related to retail management. Wi-Fi all around the campus. We also have Nescafe and canteen to hang out with friends.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jagan Institute of Management Studies, Rohini.
reviews.review_text: They have a third party hostel not their own. Courses are up to date according to recent industry needs. Courses help with industry needs and requirements. They have good labs and classrooms with a fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus. The campus is engaging neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: A complete review of JIMS Rohini.
reviews.review_text: The campus size is a big downside of this college. It is small. It has no cricket ground. However, the computer labs are good, sufficient, and helpful. The college also has a huge library with a large collection of books, which would be helpful for you.

reviews.review_heading: College review of JIMS, Rohini.
reviews.review_text: Campus is overall good but campus size is small. But the environment is quite well on campus. There are many sustainable features attached to the building. Playing ground is limited. They have underground indoor games like table tennis and treadmills.

reviews.review_heading: An absolute fun learning journey to be in.
reviews.review_text: All facilities one can expect are already there including Wi-Fi, labs, and digital classrooms. The hostel needs improvement in the mess, sports, and games. There is a gym but with very little to no equipment and no games present as such. The college is good but the only problem is non-residential hostels as it would be great if we only get a residential hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with college. A good option to boost your career.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure provided by college is good. It has a big library with a huge collection of books based on various subjects. Library also has laptops through which we can access the internet. The college also has a good computer lab.

reviews.review_heading: A good decision to take admission for PGDM in JIMS Rohini Sector 5 .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very limited; the campus is very small compared to other JIM's colleges, but all the facilities are there. Wi-Fi for students, labs, smartboards, a 2-floor library, a well-maintained park, 1 small basketball court, 1 fairly big indoor carrom and table tennis court, and 3 canteens. The hostel provided by the college is good, and the quality of food they offer is also good. If you don't like any meal, you can share the feedback, and they will listen to that feedback and improve a...

reviews.review_heading: I absolutely recommend this college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very nice. We have smart classrooms, a very nice library, labs, canteens with good quality food, medical facilities, Wi-Fi, etc. We have all the facilities required. The campus is clean, and we have little space for sports as well, but we usually have our sports events organized outside the college.

reviews.review_heading: Unexpectedly excellent faculty, decent ROI, regular extracurriculars, and good college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really well maintained. The library, labs, and classrooms are nice, as are the food court and canteen provided, which are also really good and have an ambiance to them. Hostel facilities are really excellent, and staff as well as the boys hostel warden is really friendly and helpful, except the location of the hostel; everything else is perfect. In sports, indoor facilities are nice, but outdoor games are limited.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money and great placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well-equipped. We have two libraries with tons of resources. There are modern classrooms. The canteen is great to catch up with friends and relax during break. Overall, the infrastructure makes campus life enjoyable. The college organizes an annual sports event which is an enriching experience. Hostels are off campus. The quality of food in the mess is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: I personally like that JIMS Rohini offers excellent resources and support.
reviews.review_text: JIMS has a well round infrastructure that supports both academics and student life. There 2 well - stocked libraries and 2 auditorium for events and seminars. The campus also have cafeteria and food stops which is perfect for relaxing between classes. There is also a hostel for both girls and boys.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best college in terms of return on investment.
reviews.review_text:
All facilities are available for studying but there is no more exposure to extracurricular activities.
Hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls. If I talk about hostel amenities, food is good, but the building of the hostel is away from the college; besides, the college provides bus service to pick up and drop off students.

paragraphs: The admission process for Rajagiri Business School involves application, selection, and admission confirmation. All the rounds of the selection process must be cleared to get into this institute. The admission process can be completed either online or offline depending on the student's preference. Find below the step-by-stepRajagiri Business School admission process:
1: RBS Application Process

Rajagiri Business School application process is done online as well as offline. Candidates can fill the application form on the official website of the institute or get the application form by going to the admission office of the institute in person. The application fee to apply for courses is INR 1,000.
3: Document Verification

Verification based on academic and other records will be completed prior to the day of GD-PI. Once GDPI is scheduled, submit the scanned copy of certificates, marksheets and other documents (as mentioned in GDPI call letter) to the email ID mentioned.
2: Selection Rounds

The institute shortlists candidates based on scores of entrance exams such as CAT, MAT, XAT, KMAT, etc. Admission to the FPM course is done through a valid score of UGC/ CSIR JRF or RRAT. The shortlisted candidates are called for GD and PI rounds, followed by a written test conducted by RBS. Previous academic performance of the candidates, relevant work experience, non-academic achievements and other similar inputs will also be considered in shortlisting candidates.
3: Publication of Rank List
Based on candidates' past academic records, scores obtained in the entrance exams and performance in GDPI rounds, the institute will publish a rank list of the top qualifiers and selected candidates.
4: Final Admission
Candidates whose names appeared in the rank list have to confirm their seats by paying a certain amount of course fee.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Please don't consider this.

content.Placements: If you’re coming to this college, then please don’t expect placement. Its the least possible thing college is concerned about. Almost every student here is either for Masters or has a family business, here for just a degree. Barely any student gets placed.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are just natural saunas. Just walk 5 minutes you’ll complete the campus tour. The labs and library are decent. Sports facilities are barely accessible. Never saw a medical facility here, so don’t know. Hostels are really small but decent. Don’t get food from that canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is top-notch choice if you want a balance of everything in life.

content.Placements: 89 percent of students were placed. The highest on-campus package is 21 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ZS and Infosys. 80 percent got internships. Top roles were SDE and analyst. There were well-recognized companies that visited our campus, and the placements were fine.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well maintained, with a few having AC. Hostels are top-notch with all facilities and no restrictions. Hostel staff is also very good. The hostels are well maintained. There are too many hostels, and students have the choice to choose according to their needs.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A practical and student-friendly college.

content.Placements: The placements for the B.Com batch were decent, and the requirements were good communication skills with basic domain knowledge. Around 25% of the batch sat for the placements, and most of them got placed. The highest package offered was around 4 LPA, whereas the average was around 2.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The college has very good infrastructure and is one of the bigger colleges under Panjab University. The classrooms are big and have blackboards as well as smartboards for good audio-visual aids. There is also a library that has a wide range of books available. Hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls with decent facilities. Medical facilities are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Political Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college and students are too good. The environment of the college is positive.

content.Placements: The college provides many opportunities to improve our skills and potential. Many companies come to our college for placements of students. There are many opportunities in our college. Faculty members give knowledge about placements.
content.Infrastructure: There are 3 computer labs in the college. It provides a good network connection. The mess in the hostel is okay. The canteen provides food at an affordable price. It has Nescafé, Verka, and juice corners in the college for students and teachers. There are sports rooms with different games.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My college feels average to me.

content.Placements: I am studying B.Sc. Chemistry. There are 24 students in the department. It is a government college, so most students receive financial support through scholarships. Company placements are not discussed. IMAT is the final stage of the course, so internships are conducted during this period. The top roles offered include food safety department roles, forensic science, chemist positions, etc.
content.Infrastructure: As I am studying B.Sc. Chemistry, we need labs, which are only about 50% okay, with limited equipment. Wi-Fi is available only on the ground floor. The classrooms are spacious, but the library is poor, as it is usually closed even though it is a single room. Food availability is good. Currently, there is no hostel facility, and medical facilities are poor. Sports and games are also not very engaged in our college.

overview_faqs.answer: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management (ABV IIITM) Gwalior offers students and staff extensive infrastructure. review_summary.college_name: IIITM Gwalior Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, strong academics, and decent placements at IIIT, Gwalior.

content.Placements: More than 90% batch is placed. The highest package is 80 LPA from LinkedIn, and the lowest goes till 6-7 LPA. Top recruiters are DeShaw, Google, Uber, Media.net, and many more. Around 30% batch gets intern, intern, season, and top roles are SDE and business analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, a library, and campus-wide Wi-Fi. Hostels are decent with basic facilities, food quality is average, medical care is available, and sports facilities support indoor and outdoor games and others.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Information Technology + MBA - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the facilities provided, and the placement is really good and improving every year.

content.Placements: The placement is nice. There are a lot of opportunities provided by the college to get placed. The placement record is good, too. The only thing is that many off-campus offers are included. Overall, the Training and Placement Cell (TPC) here has experienced staff who have pretty solid connections, hence bringing ample offers to the college.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels for first-year students are more recently built, hence are better than any college compared. The hostels that are allotted for the later-year students are old. There are lots of things which don't meet the expectations, like the old fan connections and all. The mess is pretty decent for all hostels. Wi-Fi and LAN connections sometimes have a few little fluctuations, like any other college, but overall, they are nice.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Information Technology + MBA - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: First established the IIIT under the MOE.

content.Placements: Almost 95% of the students were placed by the placement cell. The on-campus placements were almost 67%, and the remaining were off-campus. According to the RTI, we got to know that the minimum package was 7 LPA, which was received by a 2-year MBA student, and the highest package received was 65 LPA in every branch, and the average package was around 28 LPA. Internships were given by many top-level companies such as Google, DE Shaw, and many more. The most prominent roles offered were related to SDE.
content.Infrastructure: We have a library with AC equipped in it, and we also have a Wi-Fi-enabled campus reaching 50 Mbps in the worst areas. Labs are very well-equipped, and the computer lab is the best of all, having the best configuration of systems and almost more than 200 PCs of that configuration that are very easily accessible.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and placements.

content.Placements: 98.21% of students passed out this year from our college. Highest package is 67 LPA, the lowest package is 10 LPA, and the average is 24 LPA. Top recruiting companies from our campus are Google, Grow, Microsoft, and Meesho. Google also hires students for internships.
content.Infrastructure: Library is very good. All kinds of books are available there, and you can also issue books for yourself. Wi-Fi routers are provided, and internet speed is also quite good. Classrooms are air-conditioned. Labs are also maintained properly. Food is not as good as it should be, and in mess after sometimes quality degrades. There are 3 canteens where you can eat. Medical facilities are available. There is a doctor present at his time, and you can consult him in case of small injuries.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Large campus area, top-notch placements, hostels and mess food can be improved.

content.Placements: Due to less number of branches, placements are excellent. In this year (2025), 97.76% of students got placed. 38 students got above 50+ LPA. The highest salary is 67.5LPA, and average salary is 28 LPA. Top recruiters are Google, Cisco, etc. Almost 80-85% of students got internships. Top role offered is SDE.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, but the boys hostels are not so good because the hostels require renovation as they get older. All the necessary facilities are available for living in hostels, like Wi-Fi (sometimes there may be some problem but mostly good with upto 80-90 Mbps speed), classrooms are fully air-conditioned with proper sitting arrangements, and library is also there, which is also fully air-conditioned. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available, whenever required. All the sports grounds are available on the campus like basketball court, lawn tennis court, cricket ground, kabaddi ground, etc.

Find below the IIITM admission process 2025:
1. IIITM Application process
Candidates must register themselves on the official website of IIITM Gwalior. They must first register and then fill out the online application form.
2. IIITM Shortlisting
Applicants are shortlisted as per the fulfillment of the eligibility criteria and scores obtained in the entrance exams. JEE Main, GATE, and CAT are the exams accepted by IIITM Gwalior
3. IIITM Selection Process
The shortlisted candidates have to participate in the selection phase, which consists of face-to-face and group interviews. The selection process is conducted offline.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, strong academics, and decent placements at IIIT, Gwalior.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, a library, and campus-wide Wi-Fi. Hostels are decent with basic facilities, food quality is average, medical care is available, and sports facilities support indoor and outdoor games and others.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the facilities provided, and the placement is really good and improving every year.
reviews.review_text: The hostels for first-year students are more recently built, hence are better than any college compared. The hostels that are allotted for the later-year students are old. There are lots of things which don't meet the expectations, like the old fan connections and all. The mess is pretty decent for all hostels. Wi-Fi and LAN connections sometimes have a few little fluctuations, like any other college, but overall, they are nice.

reviews.review_heading: First established the IIIT under the MOE.
reviews.review_text: We have a library with AC equipped in it, and we also have a Wi-Fi-enabled campus reaching 50 Mbps in the worst areas. Labs are very well-equipped, and the computer lab is the best of all, having the best configuration of systems and almost more than 200 PCs of that configuration that are very easily accessible.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Library is very good. All kinds of books are available there, and you can also issue books for yourself. Wi-Fi routers are provided, and internet speed is also quite good. We also have Wi-Fi in hostels and in the academic block, where all the departments and lecture halls are present. We have various types of classrooms of differing capacities, ranging from 60 to 200, some of which have plug points at each seat. Each classroom is enabled by Wi-Fi. The first-year hostel is very good, and the hostels from the 2nd year onwards are average. The mess quality keeps varying, but it is mostly good. The...

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics and good placements, but infrastructure and campus life need improvement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not very good, but as this is the oldest IIIT, it has the infrastructure of 1997, so it’s pretty old. New hostels are definitely good and well-equipped, while the old ones are okay. There are also some hostels in progress, which seem pretty good. The library is very good, and the classrooms have AC installed.

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Gwalior - A perfect college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good; a new hostel is also under construction and is expected to be completed by 2026. A new hospital is also being built. We have a huge college divided into two parts: Pockets A and Pockets B, connected with an underpass. The infrastructure is very cool. In the hostel, we get 24/7 internet, also wireless, so you are always connected to the internet. Coolers are allowed, and we have fully air-conditioned lecture halls, classrooms, and a library.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, as it provides good campus life, lovely fests, active clubs, excellent placements, etc.
reviews.review_text: I would say the infrastructure is old. The obvious reason is this is the oldest IT, so the buildings are pretty old. But the interior of the academic buildings is good. Also, the library is very nice here. With its infrastructure and vast variety of books, this library has everything you need. Hostels are a little on the low side. For first-year students, hostels are pretty good, but after the first year, you get either single or double sharing rooms. The rooms are okay, not so good I would say,...

reviews.review_heading: Average plus a good college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available are Wi-Fi, labs, air-conditioned classrooms, and a big library named LRC. Mess food is average. There is a big sports complex, a cricket ground, a swimming pool, and many clubs.

reviews.review_heading: Don't expect much; you will be disappointed and good in terms of placement.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and library are good. Many useful books are available in the library. Labs are okay, average. Hostel is not much good but adjustable. No Wi-Fi is good here, and the mess food is bad; it's below average. The sports club is good, and it's okay for playing sports. Canteens are available to eat your favourite food. Canteens are also not the best but average.

reviews.review_heading: Really happy to take the course. Also happy to see the placements of this year.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well maintained. All the rooms and labs are air conditioned. We have WiFi at our hostels and classes. We have full access to them. Sometimes the internet is not stable. Overall, it works fine. The food quality totally depends upon the mess committee. Sometimes responses are taken late. There are also cases of food poisoning as well.

reviews.review_heading: Good college but sometimes regret choosing this college because of a few circumstances.
reviews.review_text: The buildings are a bit old. Well, there are a total of 5 hostels for boys and one hostel for girls. Among the five hostels there are two for the first years of B.Tech and the remaining three are for the second, fourth, and fifth years and M.Tech and Ph.D. students.

reviews.review_heading: The institute has a peaceful vibe and is quite big compared to other IIITs.
reviews.review_text: First-year students got a separate hostel called SATPURA, which is situated just outside the main campus. It's a 3-seater hostel. Wi-Fi, particularly in hostels, is very poor; we get very low internet speed. The library building is quite big but has books only related to the courses available, as it has much space to accommodate more books. Classrooms and labs are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements. Average in mess and Wi-Fi.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not so good. It lags too much, labs are well-equipped and have all the things that are required for doing any experiments. Colleges have several canteens that provide both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food to students at a minimal cost. Medical facilities are good, they have all types of medicines. paragraphs: 1: IMI Bhubaneswar Application form

Candidates willing to apply to any courses from IMI Bhubaneswar must visit the IMI Bhubaneswar's official site to apply. Candidates must submit documents during the application. The application form is online & available on the official site of IMI Bhubaneswar. Candidates must go through the application form thoroughly & fill out the form. The application fee is INR 2,250.
2: IMI Bhubaneswar Selection Process

IMI Bhubaneswar considers CAT/XAT/CMAT/GMAT and Academic Record for the selection process for its PGDM programme. Further, the selection is based on the evaluation of the academic qualification & work profile of the candidate followed by an interview. Finally, for the certificate course candidates must meet the eligibility criteria. Candidates who qualify for the PGDM selection process are invited for the final stage of the selection process – the Individual Assessment which is the Personal Interview.
3: IMI Bhubaneswar Admission Offer

Admission offers will be based on the successful completion of the application & selection process. The result will be announced through an Admission Portal & will be notified on the IMI Bhubaneswar site. Applicants are advised to check the updates on the site at regular intervals.
4: IMI Bhubaneswar Fee payment

After completing the selection round the candidate will receive the selection result through mail. The candidates will be required to pay the first instalment of the fee within 2 weeks of the date of the offer to confirm their seat in the Institution. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification & pay theIMI Bhubaneswar feeto confirm their seats at the university.

faqs.question: What accreditations and rankings does the PGDM programme at IMI Bhubaneswar have?
faqs.answer: PGDM program at IMI Bhubaneswar is one of the top ranked and accredited course. The institution is approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA). faqs.question: Is FPM available at IMI Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: Yes, FPM course is available at IMI Bhubaneswar. The FPM course is offered in various specialisations. Candidate must meet the eligibility criteria to enrol for FPM course admission set by the college. Aspirants must pass master degree. IMI Bhubaneswar's admission process is entrance-based.

faqs.question: What is the total tuition fee for FPM at IMI Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: Total fee for FPM program at IMI Bhubaneswar is INR 6 Lakhs. It includes tuition, materials, IT, welfare, examination and other charges. This fee is paid over installments. The fee structure can also change, hence students are advised to keep checking official website for latest updates.

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility requirement at IMI Bhubaneswar for FPM?
faqs.answer: The basic qualification necessity for the Fellow Program in Management (FPM) programme at the IMI Bhubaneswar is a post-graduate degree or equivalent with at least 60% total marks. Another choice is to have some other expert capability like CA, ICWA, or CS with no less than 60% total marks. students in the last year of their post-graduation or Science certificate may likewise apply.

faqs.question: Can I join IMI Bhubaneswar without XAT?
faqs.answer: Admission to IMI Bhubaneswar is not possible without XAT as it is mandatory. Students can also apply through their CAT or GMAT scores. Apart from entrance exam, candidates also have graduation degree of 3 years duration or more with a minimum of 60% marks. Final year degree candidates can also apply and foreign nationals are only eligible through GMAT scores.

faqs.question: Does IMI Bhubaneswar accept CMAT score?
faqs.answer: IMI Bhubaneswar considers many factors for admission including CAT/XAT/CMAT/GMAT scores, academic record and other criteria. Shortlisted candidates undergo further evaluation through essay writing, personal interview, and potentially IMI Bhubaneswar Research Aptitude Test. CMAT scores are considered, they are part of holistic assessment process alongside other qualifications.

faqs.question: What is the admission process of IMI Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: For Indian students candidates are required to clear either CAT or XAT exams else they can also present their GMAT scores. After examination results are out, an online application process must be done by submitting their CAT / XAT / GMAT scores to IMI Bhubaneswar. The institute will also prepare shortlist of candidates on basis of education background, work experience and other details filled in the application form. The remaining candidates will call for next step of admission process.

Besides promoting group study and learning outside the classroom, the residential accommodation also enables the students to optimally utilize IMI resources like the library and computing facilities with internet and intranet available in the hostel. reviews.review_heading: Everything is good in our college .

reviews.review_heading: Decently satisfied with the college.

reviews.review_heading: It has brilliant faculty, good infrastructure and good placement opportunities.

Our college provides outdoor as well as indoor playing areas, table tennis, tennis lawn and ground for playing cricket as well as football. The hostel is situated inside the campus boundaries. The hostel is a little bit expensive, and it's quite far from the main town.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college to kick start your career in management.

I found it amazing. Facilities like ultra-speed LAN (up to 250 Mbps) and Wi-Fi in every room of the hostel, AC and Wi-Fi enabled classrooms with laptop/mobile charging sockets in every desk, HD projectors, etc., are available. reviews.review_heading: One of the top college of Bhubaneswar.
reviews.review_text: As it's a newly build college, it's having all the modern facilities, well structured and designed classrooms with well-equipped labs. High-speed Wi-Fi and Library is huge. Also the quality of mess food is decent, and hostel rooms are neat and clean. Medical facilities are also offered.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IMI Bhubaneswar - International Management Institute.
reviews.review_text: It is a newly built college with modern facilities and well-maintained campus. Hostels are very good as compared to other colleges. Mess food is hygienic. Our college has well-equipped labs for students, and there is a great connection of Wi-Fi on the whole campus.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful Journey in IMI.
reviews.review_text: Helpful and friendly faculty, campus life is really great. Its a lush green 16 acres campus with lot of facilities like Gymnasium, centrally air conditioned library, playing ground, football ground, volleyball ground, basketball ground etc. Staying in IMI was really memorable.

reviews.review_heading: IMI is one of the best places to pursue MBA.
reviews.review_text: IMI lies in the heart of the 22-acre lush green campus. There are various facilities like gymnasium, swimming pool, digital library, sports space, etc. Hostel facilities are provided on a single or double occupancy basis. The food served in the mess is good. Wi-Fi facility is available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IMI Bhubaneswar - International Management Institute.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available on the campus are quite impressing. There are centralised air-conditioned classrooms, labs, library, etc. The college provides Wi-Fi 24x7 in both classrooms and hostels. Sometimes, we find problems getting Wi-Fi connection inside the classes, but it is available everywhere apart from classrooms. Hostel rooms are small, yet neat and clean. review_summary.college_name: BIM Trichy Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely love the campus.

content.Placements: 100% of students got placed out of 120 students. The highest salary is 20 LPA. The lowest salary is 10 LPA. The median salary is 12 LPA. Top recruiters are Asian Paints, Godrej, Infosys, CRISIL, Accenture, Century Ply, start-ups also offering good placements, etc. Roles offered mostly are AM, RM, data analytics, sales and marketing, SCM, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Clean, homely vibes, good water, food Wi-Fi connectivity, and mess committee are doing wonders here. The quality of food is nice compared to other colleges. Classrooms are well infrastructure and have 12 bloomberg terminals with well-known experienced faculty members.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: All facilities are good here except for placements.

content.Placements: BIM would promote themselves using placements, which they currently are not capable of and after we join the institute, they would tell us that there are no placement agencies. Many students left the institute without any offers. BIM would promote saying they have good placements and after we join, they would say we are not a placement agency to get us all placed. They would say that if we do not get placed it is not going to affect us, and we did not seek placements through the institute. Many companies with a package of less than 6 LPA are brought for the placements. Most companies come only to add it to their brochure, and these companies would just collect the resume and leave. Only 4 finance companies came and only 6 students got placed in the finance domain. The promotional page contains recruiters from 10 years ago. The list of recruiters includes RBI, which they sent the link to apply for the RBI exam and NaBFID. Organsition. Institution feels that their reputation would be lost if they ask help from alumni, so many students left the institute jobless. The unplaced students are threatened not to ask alumni for help.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: This college provides a big platform to learn.

content.Placements: The placement rate is 95%. The most common package is 36 LPA, with a minimum of 10 LPA and a maximum of 18 LPA. Deshaw, Amazon, google , Infosys. eBay, Play Games and Mastercard are the major companies. The groups in question are data scientist, data engineer, analyst, business owner, consultant and analytics consultant. Approximately 90% of students received internships in key leadership, leadership and support roles.
content.Infrastructure: The college offers many facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The laboratories are also neat and tidy. The classrooms are very spacious and can comfortably accommodate every student. The library is also very large, with all sorts of books. My hostel has a variety of good food. The food is all very good in the mix and the food is prepared cleanly. Sports and games are also held in the college. The college offers various games and sports like cricket, badminton, indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The faculty of BIM is not only experienced but also uses modern technology.

content.Placements: The college has decent placement, with around 90 percent of students getting placed every year. The companies that visit the campus are Infosys, Ernst and Young, Cognizant, HDFC Bank, HDFC Life, Zoho, ThoughtWorks, TAFE, Tech Mahindra, Vedanta, and a few more. The internship happens through companies visiting the campus and conducting interviews for the students. The average stipend is INR 25,000. The prominent companies for the internship are EY, HUL, TAFE, Asian Paints, 100Plus, Vdart, Vedanta, and a few more.
content.Infrastructure: It is allotted automatically before the academic session begins, and the rooms allotted are fixed for 2 years. It is an old BHEL quarter, with each 2 BHK quarter housing 4 students. There is a parking facility available, and the distance between the hostel and the main campus is around 1 km.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: College reviews by students .

content.Placements: Above 80% of students placed in our course The highest package is INR 25000, and INR 15000 is the lowest offered in our college. Above 85% of students got internships from our course and at the top companies. There are three roles offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Many other facilities and infrastructure for our department. For example: (1) Lab: so much advanced equipment (2) Classrooms are peaceful and relaxable places, and wi-fi connections are available in the department. (3) Library: All books are available in our department library. There are so many facilities in my hostel. Good and healthy foods are available in our college canteen. Medical services are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Students relationships and extracurricular time are spent on sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely love the campus.
reviews.review_text: Clean, homely vibes, good water, food Wi-Fi connectivity, and mess committee are doing wonders here. The quality of food is nice compared to other colleges. Classrooms are well infrastructure and have 12 bloomberg terminals with well-known experienced faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: This college provides a big platform to learn.
reviews.review_text: The college offers many facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The laboratories are also neat and tidy. The classrooms are very spacious and can comfortably accommodate every student. The library is also very large, with all sorts of books. My hostel has a variety of good food. The food is all very good in the mix and the food is prepared cleanly. Sports and games are also held in the college. The college offers various games and sports li...

reviews.review_heading: The faculty of BIM is not only experienced but also uses modern technology.
reviews.review_text: It is allotted automatically before the academic session begins, and the rooms allotted are fixed for 2 years. It is an old BHEL quarter, with each 2 BHK quarter housing 4 students. There is a parking facility available, and the distance between the hostel and the main campus is around 1 km.

reviews.review_heading: College reviews by students .
reviews.review_text: Many other facilities and infrastructure for our department. For example: (1) Lab: so much advanced equipment (2) Classrooms are peaceful and relaxable places, and wi-fi connections are available in the department. (3) Library: All books are available in our department library. There are so many facilities in my hostel. Good and healthy foods are available in our college canteen. Medical services are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Students relationships and extracurricular time are...

reviews.review_heading: Best place to discover oneself personally and professionally.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are BHEL quarters and can't expect a modern living in it. All other facilities are good, right from playgrounds to Wi-Fi. Food menu is managed by students of the mess committee and it totally depends on the interested of the students. The mess staff are very considerate in all aspects.

reviews.review_heading: BIM, you instilled confidence to meet the world!
reviews.review_text: BIM is situated within BHEL campus. It has got a students hostel which is typically a 2 BHK house. 2 students per room and 4 students per house. The premises is filled with lush green and robust trees. There are around 6 classrooms for the seniors and juniors. There is also a library (which is my favourite) and a computer centre. The ground comprises of a badminton court and TT court and students mess. All of the above mentioned places are Wi-Fi enabled and classrooms are Air conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: It provides an enriching and amazing MBA experience, which makes us a thorough professional.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms are air-conditioned. The college has a well-equipped library. The best food is provided in the canteen, and it is run by students. There are 2BHK apartments for 4 people. Sports facilities like badminton, table tennis, basketball, volleyball and football ground are available. We have good access to Multi Speciality BHEL Hospital.

reviews.review_heading: A place to learn and grow with 35 years of legacy.
reviews.review_text: The college provides all the basic amenities required to conduct events, hosting seminars and social gathering. However, the students do find that the infrastructure can be improved. On the same note, the current batch has requested for a basketball court, putting up the screen in the ground. Still, the college lacks the commonplace for students to do collective projects or assignments. A/C facilities are to be provided considering the climate of Trichy.

reviews.review_heading: Curriculum of the college is really good and give students full freedom to choose subjects of choice
reviews.review_text: The campus is equipped with 24X7 Wi-Fi connectivity and computer labs are well-equipped with required tools. Classrooms are fully aired conditioned and have all the amenities. Being house in BHEL campus, the college has tied up with BHEL in-house Government hospital to provide all general and emergency medical facilities. Also, a doctor visits the hostel regularly. The college has all kind of sports facilities and the infrastructure to support it. Canteen is FSSAI approved and managed by student...

reviews.review_heading: BIM is continuing the legacy of creating business leaders to scale corporate peaks.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good with a library containing more than 16000 volumes of books, up to date software systems, and smart classrooms with an enhanced learning experience. There are separate gents and ladies hostels, and all the amenities are provided. There is a huge playing ground, and all equipment for cricket, football, badminton and table tennis are provided by the sports committee as and when necessary.

reviews.review_heading: BIM- The place to be in and which is worth the money.
reviews.review_text: It is an average one. Inside BHEL, there is a place allocated to build a new one. Once completed, it will be a state of the art building. At present, it's not up to the mark of a highly placed B-school, which is why BIM ranks low in many rankings. Whoever joins BIM, will fall in love with its food.

reviews.review_heading: Holistic learning and a heart-warming culture.
reviews.review_text: BIM is like any other standard B-school having all the basic infrastructure like WiFi and a library at its disposal. One feature that makes it stand out from other B-Schools is that it is located inside the BHEL premises, 20 km from Trichy. Therefore, a peaceful atmosphere in addition to in-house industrial exposure is present. The food catering is managed by the students themselves. In one word, it is homely.

reviews.review_heading: A good institution with good students where both can strive to be the best.
reviews.review_text: Though the college does not have a swanky modern campus, it does have all the basic infrastructure required for a business school today, which includes Wi-Fi enabled classrooms, hostel rooms, a good library with books covering all important fields of management, and magazines and newspapers of all leading business publications in the country, a playground for football and cricket, a volleyball court, a badminton court and facilities for indoor games like table tennis, carom and chess, a modest g...

reviews.review_heading: The college provides all-round experience along with fun and learning.
reviews.review_text: BIM is an academy that would be grounded in strong theoretical inputs. It has a proactive partnership with a reputed organisation. They provide students with a real-world learning environment. With this vision in mind, a partnership was signed with BHEL to create the country's first ever management institute that would be housed inside an industrial giant. Thus, Bharathidasan Institute of Management is a school of excellence.

faqs.answer: The technology institute admits candidates to BTech courses based on merit in the JEE Main exam. There is no other provision for admission. Candidates shortlisted based on exam scores must also participate in the JoSAA counselling round for seat allotment. In case the seats are left vacant after JoSAA counselling, then those are filled through CSAB counselling. This is the only criteria for admission. Candidates can contact the BIT Mesra admission office to check for direct admissions.
faqs.question: Q: Can I apply for BTech at BIT Mesra without JEE Main score?

faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA

content.Placements: In my course at BIT Mesra, about 65–70 percent students get placed consistently, but from the past few years it has dropped slightly. The highest package is 19 LPA and the lowest is 3 LPA, and an average of 7.5–8 LPA is common. There are many top companies like Google, Microsoft, and a lot of core companies which visit the campus consistently. 60 percent of students get internships in core companies and tech companies. Roles include site engineer, design engineer, quantity surveyor, trainee engineer, and roles in structural, geotechnical, transportation, and environmental engineering.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Civil maatt lo CSE, mech, ECE, EEE are good options.

content.Placements: The students were placed, but the LPA was not worth it. We have a 4 LPA average in our branch, but according to the price, it is not worth it at all. On top of that, you have to pay such a hefty amount. Go for this branch only if you are interested in government exams or if you want a good NIRF ranking college.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. The campus is big and full of greenery, and it has good vibes in terms of nature. The buildings are also good, but the hostels and their Wi-Fi are not good, as Wi-Fi is down most of the time, due to which I recommend that you take a backup plan for Wi-Fi for yourself.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 75% of students were placed in Civil this year. The highest package was around 16 LPA, the median package was around 8 LPA, and the lowest package was around 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies include IOCL, Deloitte, Accenture, Hindalco, TATA, etc. Top roles include structural engineer, project manager, and urban planner.
content.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.

content.Placements: The highest package last year, 2024, was 1.45 crores, and the average package was almost 11.5 LPA. Almost every company has different roles offered here at the college. The placements record of this year has not come out as per true strength, but it is expected that the placements are more or less the same as the previous year.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.

content.Placements: Nearly 60-80 percent of my courses were placed last year. The highest is 50 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average is around 15 LPA. Oracle, Infosys, Texas Instruments, Intel, Microsoft, Google, Goldman Sachs, Atlassian, etc. The roles offered are SDE, hardware engineer, network engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

hostel.description: Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra is completely residential with eleven hostels for boys and three separate ones for girls. All student lodging houses are spacious and beautifully laid out amidst a lot greenery. Each male-student is provided with well-furnished single-accommodation while girls share their accommodation in spacious and adequately furnished rooms. Individual rooms are constructed in a row with a wide veranda for common use running along the length of passage. Common facilities at the hostel include dining halls and common rooms with provision for several indoor games. The reading room in each hostel subscribes to a large number of magazines, periodicals and newspapers. The entertainment hall in each hostel has a color television set. Each hostel has an independent mess, completely run and managed by the students themselves. The hostels are a hub of leisure activities. Students are encouraged to pursue a wide range of extra curricular activities and hobbies in their free time and events both entertaining and competitive are arranged quite frequently. Inter-hostel tournaments of indoor and outdoor games, quizzes, competitions and adventure trips are very popular at BIT Mesra. The 'Hostel Night' organized by resident students is a memorable yearly event where students interact with the faculty members amidst cultural programmes and a lot of fun in a shared mood of festivity.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA
reviews.review_text: Many equipment in the labs are damaged but still being used. The Wi-Fi connection is very good, giving a high-speed network of up to 100 Mbps. The library is quite disappointing as books are in bad condition and there are not enough facilities, and there is no AC in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Civil maatt lo CSE, mech, ECE, EEE are good options.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. The campus is big and full of greenery, and it has good vibes in terms of nature. The buildings are also good, but the hostels and their Wi-Fi are not good, as Wi-Fi is down most of the time, due to which I recommend that you take a backup plan for Wi-Fi for yourself.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

reviews.review_heading: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, but only recommend for branches like CSE and AIML.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but there are some restrictions, like the game website is blocked, and the mess food is average, like in a week they give 4-5 good meals. The hostel room is quite small, not for 2 people. The classroom is good with proper projectors. Free medical facilities are also available sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good Wi-Fi connection inside the campus, like in the hostel, classrooms, and labs. The classrooms are very clean, with AC, projectors, and well-ventilated. The labs are also good. We have a lab for every course. The hostels are neat and clean. Every day, the hostels are cleaned and the washrooms also, but the hostel rooms are to be cleaned by the students after that particular room.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with above average placement for both circuit and non-circuit branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi inside the campus is good, high-speed, but it fluctuates a lot, sometimes it gives 150 mbps and other times it goes down to kbps, so it's unpredictable. Labs have all the required equipment available, some equipment does need changes, and it is either broken or old, but overall, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members in CSE are good, but for ECE, they are the worst. Good coding culture in college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are very small. In the first year, hostel rooms are still big, but from the second year, their size is very small. In a room, 2 students are present, which is something that I don't like about this college. There are also some three-sharing rooms in the hostel, and they are pretty good, but only a few students get them. Wi-Fi is average, like those students whose rooms are in the corners of the hostel didn't get much access to Wi-Fi. Classrooms are 10/10, like they are very good. La...

reviews.review_heading: A very good college but you have to spend 10 lakhs in 2 years.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, it is having large number of books. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Boys hostel is 4 to 5 km away from the college. Mess food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are as follows: 5G Wi-Fi available 24/7, classroom projectors with centralized air conditioning, a very large library with all types of books available, hostel mess food above average, and night canteen available in each hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I will recommend Birla Institute of Technology Mesra.
reviews.review_text: The food menu is decided by the student body living in that. Home-like food in some hostels, like H5, is great. Any problem, we have Dean sir, for student affairs. If anyone is behaving rudely, you can talk to sir, and you do not need any other proof.

reviews.review_heading: Placement varies every year. Infrastructure and environment are good. Faculty depends on the course.
reviews.review_text: Management is questionable but the infrastructure is quite good. Hostel rooms are kind of small for two students but you will get used to them in no time. The Wi-Fi is available all around the campus so its a plus point. Sports facilities are decent. Dispensary provide free medicine.

reviews.review_heading: I am neither dissatisfied nor satisfied, but happy with what I got.
reviews.review_text: The campus is big, but it has great potential to be one of the greatest campuses in India. Many places on the campus are only trees, and all that's good because the AQI is good on the campus. Still, there are places where much infrastructure can be built.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for circuit courses in B.Tech and for mechanical engineering only.
reviews.review_text: The library, playgrounds, and classrooms are good with AC and smartboards. Hostels aren't that good, with quite small rooms, but we would adjust. Food in the mess is okay, and Wi-Fi is decent. Labs are all well-equipped, and we won't face any problem regarding that. Apart from that, the campus is very beautiful and pollution-free with a lot of trees.

course_faqs.answer: Candidates with a BE, BTech, BS, or BDes degree and a GATE or GPAT qualification are eligible for financial aid worth INR 12,400 per month. Even if they do not pass the GATE exam, IIT BTech graduates with a CGPA of 8 or higher are eligible for assistantships. Sponsored category students cannot get an IITJ assistantship, nevertheless. This data is as per past years' records and hence may vary.

review_summary.college_name: IIT Jodhpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of IIT Jodhpur in the physics department.

content.Placements: In my batch, we are offered jobs like research associate, lab technician, quality control analyst, and microbiologist. Companies that came to hire are mostly research labs, pharmaceutical companies, and diagnostic centers. The average salary package offered is 2 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels provide basic facilities like Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. Classrooms are air-conditioned, and the main library is set up well for borrowing books. The mess food is just okay, but luckily, there are three canteens that sell delicious fast food. It also has a small sports area for games like volleyball, football, and cricket.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the course.

content.Placements: Approximately 70 percent of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 80 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. Google, Microsoft, and Amazon are top recruitment companies. Approximately 50 percent of students got internships in FAANG, MAANG, TCS, and Rubix. Software engineer and data scientist are roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good enough, but the range is less than expected. Classrooms are very good and large enough to accommodate all students. The library is also decent, and there is a wide variety of books in it. Good sports complex, but one bad thing, which is not appealing to me, is that there is a sudden thunderstorm that happens in the spring season.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur.

content.Placements: Almost everyone gets placed, both circuital and non-circuital guys. The highest package, I guess, was 60 LPA (in hand). All renowned companies come here for placements. I don't have data about internships, but 5-6 people get internships at Google every year (3rd year students) and GSoC as well. SDE, SSE, AIML engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi can be a bit slow, but it's fine, sometimes very bad. The Physics and Chemistry lab is good and spacious. Classrooms are air-conditioned with appropriate lighting. The library is not sufficient for the number of students that exist on the campus, but its air conditioning and books are available, as well as computers if needed, and switchboards are available as well. Food in the mess differs, sometimes it's fabulous, sometimes it's very bad. The canteen is good and affordable. There is a PHC on campus, pretty far from hostels, but you can call an ambulance during emergencies, free service, free meds and blood tests.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: They create a system that avoids heatwaves from entering the campus, which I like very much.

content.Placements: I think almost 100% placements are there. If you work hard, you can get placed. Last year top placement was 53 LPA and hired by Google. Median package is 15 LPA - 17 LPA. Top companies here are Google, HPCL, and Goldman Sachs. So, top companies come here, and you can get placed easily.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has very good infrastructure. It has 5G+ Wi-Fis. There is 100 MB speed. Canteen food is excellent, and they include some Jodhpur stuff there, and that's fantastic. Sports facility is good. Library is okay. Sports facility is good, and they encourage every student to play some stuff.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: My wonderful journey in an amazing college.

content.Placements: Above 30% of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 62 LPA, and the lowest package is 13 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are Tata Motors, Mahindra, Google, and Microsoft. Maybe 67% of students got internships in Unlox and other companies. Machine learning is the top role offered in my course.
content.Infrastructure: The college has Wi-Fi for every student with an unlimited network. The Wi-Fi works anywhere on the whole campus. The labs are pretty hygienic, and safety protocols are followed by management. The classrooms are very spacious and ideal for students. The library is also very huge and here we can get many types of books and magazines. The quality of food is very good and healthy. There is also a primary health centre available for all students for medical issues. All types of sports games and grounds are here for students, including indoor games.

admission_overview.college_name: IIT Jodhpur Admission 2025: Cutoff, Fees, Eligibility & Selection

paragraphs: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Jodhpur course admissions are open for all courses over 11 departments.IIT Jodhpur admissionis entrance and merit-based. The institute offers UG, PG, PhD, and PG diploma programmes in various disciplines. The selection is based on performance in national-level entrance exams likeJEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, etc. Candidates applying for courses, including BTech, MSc, and MTech, must also appear for the counselling rounds conducted by the respective bodies. To seek admission toIIT Jodhpur, aspirants can visit the official website of the entrance exam, and fill out and submit the applications. Read on to know more aboutIIT Jodhpur admissions 2025:
IIT Jodhpur Admission 2025: Highlights

IIT Jodhpur course admission begins with the application process of the accepted entrance exams. Admission to most of the offered courses is entrance-based. Candidates can check out the below table for some key highlights:

Admission to courses offered by IIT Jodhpur is entrance-based. Candidates are shortlisted based on performance in the national-level examinations and interview rounds (if valid). IIT Jodhpur Fees & Seats 2025

IIT Jodhpur fees for all UG & PG include components such as tuition fees, hostel fees and one-time fee payments. The lowest tuition fee for IITJodhpur courses is INR 40,000, whereas the highest fees goes up to INR 2.90 lakh. IIT Jodhpur admission process consists of multiple steps. The admission procedure involves registration, entrance exam, shortlisting, release of merit list, counselling, and admission confirmation. The complete IIT Jodhpur admission process is explained below:
Step 1: IIT Jodhpur Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Jodhpur are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed. However, for MBA admission, candidates have to fill an online application form on the official website of IIT Jodhpur.
Step 2: IIT Jodhpur Selection Criteria 2025

After filling the application form, students are required to take the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After which, counselling rounds are carried out for some of the programmess for the seat allotment process.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Candidates selected after all the selection rounds can confirm their admission/seat by paying the required amount of fee.

faqs.question: How can I get into IIT Jodhpur for BTech?

faqs.question: Is any financial assistance given to M.Tech programme students at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a BE, BTech, BS, or BDes degree and a GATE or GPAT qualification are eligible for financial aid worth INR 12,400 per month. This data is as per past years' records and hence may vary.

Aspirants shall complete theGATE application process(gate.iitk.ac.in) within the due date to be eligible for admission as there is no other provision for admission. With a valid COAP score, students may have to apply on IITJ website as well.

faqs.question: Is it necessary to participate in COAP counselling for M.Tech at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: The Common Offer Acceptance Portal (COAP) is a registration portal. Candidates who pass GATE exam are required to apply on COAP portal for counselling. Only the students who register successfully on the portal become eligible for admission in an M.Tech course of IIT Jodhpur.

Food in mess and canteen is decent, and they also provide medical facilities. Besides, this campus area is very large and supports all sports.

reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are honestly good. Wi-Fi is present on the campus. Library is available with huge collection of quality reference books. Labs are well-equipped with instruments and equipment. Multiple sports complex is present.

paragraphs: LU admission processincludes the application process, Entrance Test, announcement or merit list and fee payment. Candidates seeking admission to LU must visit the official website of the University. The step-wise admission process is given below:
1. Lucknow University Application Process 2026

The application process is carried out in online mode. Aspirants must fill in all the details in theLucknow University admission form 2026-26carefully. To apply successfully, candidates have to pay an application fee ofINR 800.
2. Appear for the Entrance Test

Once the registration has been completed successfully, Lucknow University will announce the schedule of the entrance test in the UG and in the PG programs.To get admission at LU, registered applicants will be required to take the entrance test.Applicants are required to download Lucknow University admit card to appear in the university-level entrances.

LU will publish the course-wise tentative merit lists based on the performance of the candidates in the entrance test.A list of candidates whose name has been included in the merit list would then attend the centralised counselling round.

After the counselling round, the University will release the seat allocation list for final admission. Candidates selected must pay the tuition fees to confirm admission.

placements.overview:
Amity University Kolkata started functioning in the year 2014. It is private university, formed when the West Bengal Act of 2014 passed. The exact place of the university is Kadampukur, Kolkata, and Amity University Kolkata is the 10th university campus formed through the Amity Foundation, which is a non-profit organisation.The University has 70+ departments, and 150+ institutions and centers through which it offers 300+ programmes.

Amity University Kolkata courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. The university offers various courses to students such as BTech, BSc, BBA, BCA, BCom, MTech, MPhil, MCom, MEd, MBA, etc. Kolkata Amity University has various research collaborations under its name, while it has sanctioned 30 funded projects and submitted 301+ funded projects so far.

Amity University Kolkata offers a variety of programmes. These courses are offreed at the graduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. For example, the School of Engineering offers Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.
