faqs.answer: A:    The total tuition fee for BBA at Amity University Kolkata is INR 6 lakh. The institute accepts three exam scores for admission to the BBA program:CUETWBCHSECBSE 12thThe minimum eligibility criteria for getting admission in BBA at Amity University Kolkata is that the student must have a minimum of 50% in Class 12, and the selection is merit-based. The university extends this three-year UG programme at the Amity Business School (ranked 2nd for BBA at the All India level). Students seeking admission to this programme can apply online. Admission 2023 is open for BBA. Students can apply online on the Amity Kolkata official website.
faqs.question: What is the BBA fee at Amity University Kolkata?

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates who have passed Class 12 with a minimum of 55% aggregate in PCB or PCM are eligible to take admission. In addition, the students with 80% and above aggregate in Class 12 (CBSE/ISC/State-Boards) are exempted from the selection process. Further, depending upon the BTech specialisation, the candidate should have studied particular subjects in class 12, such as Physics, Chemistry, and Maths (PCM) or Biology (PCB). Read more about Amity Kolkata BTech course admission here.
faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BTech admission in Amity University Kolkata?

paragraphs: Amity University Kolkata admission processstarts with checking academic qualifications and entrance test scores followed by submission of required documents. Students can begin with the registration process followed by selection rounds. Check the step-by-step Amity Kolkata admission process:
Amity University Kolkata Application

Students meet the eligibility requirement can apply online on the official website of the university. Contenders need to pay a non-refundable application fee of INR 1,500. Once the payment is done, students can download their forms for future reference.
Selection Rounds
Students selection are done on the basis of national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, CUET-UG, CAT, MAT, etc. for specific courses. Admission is based on merit in the last qualifying exam.
Admission Confirmation

After completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted students have to come for document verification. The seat allotment is done based on the performance of the candidates in the selection rounds. Students need to confirm their seat by paying the course fee.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Amity Kolkata?
faqs.answer: Yes, Amity University Kolkata offers direct admission to its various courses. Direct admission implies that the candidates will not be required to attend entrance tests or Personal Interviews for admission. Scores obtained in the last qualifying exam will be considered for the selection process. Courses like BCA/BCA (Hons), BBA< BBA LLB (Hons) and MA are merit-based. Direct admission eligibility is a score of a minimum of 80% in Class 12. The minimum eligibility to apply for the UG courses is Class 12 if a minimum of 50% and for PG courses is Graduation.

faqs.question: Is CUET compulsory for Amity University Kolkata?
faqs.answer: Amity University, Kolkata bases its admission into its various courses based on merit and nationally accepted entrance exams. The university welcomes candidates to apply for specific courses using national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, CAT, CUET, and others. Each course offered by the university requires a different entrance exam score. Some of the courses like BCA/BCA (Hons), BBA, and BBA LLB (Hons) offer admission based on merit/CUET-UG exam conducted by the NTA along with a minimum score of 50% in Class 12. The university also conducts its entrance exam in addition to a Personal Interview for admissions.

hostel_campus.college_name: Amity University Kolkata Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Professional teachers with good skills.
reviews.review_text: College events like promotions, cultural, and technical fests are conducted twice or thrice a month. A specific set of penalties and punishments is assigned for all the wrong behavior of us. Hostel premises are liberal, but accurate records are maintained. The usage of mobile phones within specified hours is allowed.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Amity University Kolkata is really positive.
reviews.review_text: Campus of the university is not that huge. It has spread over 15 acres of land. There are two academic blocks such as A and E blocks. The campus is located in the outer area of Kolkata. Classrooms are good. The campus is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi enabled. Campus has a library consists of more than 10,000 books. Different types of labs such as Matlab, seminar halls, etc., are available. There are two canteens present on the campus that serve good quality food to the students.

reviews.review_heading: Amity Law School is one of the best private law schools in West Bengal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is on point, and the best that money can buy. Library is huge, and an entire spare building is allotted for it. You will find all the books you can imagine. College also provides an online e-library that gives you a subscription to SCC online and manupatra.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good but academics are not good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Our college had world class infrastructure. It provided Wi-Fi campus, big classroom, very furnished labs, and library with lots of books. Quality of hostel was also good. Limited sports facility was available. It had basic medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of campus and academics, good placement for B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, functional labs, spacious classrooms, centralized library, and canteen are available. Other high-quality facilities include hostel, ATM, cafe coffee day, water coolers, elevator, centralized air conditioning, clinic, sports complex including gym and swimming pool, basketball court, cricket pitch, football field, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Great college life, average placement. Enjoyed 2 years of fests - Amity hosts the best in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is easily accessible throughout the Amity campus. The labs and classrooms are very good, and I can say the library is the best I have seen compared to other colleges. The facilities in our hostel are of high quality. The food in the canteen is much better than that in other college canteens, and the prices are affordable for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: I did a master's from Amity University, Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Amity University, Kolkata, has a huge campus and provides a lot of facilities. There are gallery classrooms, AC, Wi-Fi, a library, and labs. In total, there are 3 canteens on campus. There is also an infirmary on the campus with a nurse and a doctor present. Amity has a yearly sports fest called Sangathan.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, and helpful faculties, but needs a bit of transparent placement process.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel and college is absolutely amazing. It has top-notch facilities, with good Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, and a huge library with all kinds of books needed for courses. There are three canteens, all serving hygienic and vegetarian food. There are also many shops outside the college that serve non-vegetarian food, which can be brought into the college canteens to sit and eat.

reviews.review_heading: Everything about Amity Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, in fact, one of the best I've seen in Kolkata. Wi-Fi is provided, there are good labs and desktops, and a peaceful library, though it has fewer informative books. Medical facilities include AC rooms. The sports ground is very small, but it is encouraged through several programs such as Sangathan, which is a department-wise sports competition.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure were on point in every aspect or department like multiple A/C or Wi-Fi available, all kinds of labs and classrooms high-quality sports equipment, and facilities with skilled coaches. There was a theatre and also a cafeteria. The hostel was the best in the town with ample facilities and luxury. The food in the cafeteria was good and the most important the medical facilities were 24-hour and we got a separate infirmary.

reviews.review_heading: Eventful college life will make you fall in love with the university.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities provided by the university. The lab, Wi-Fi, classroom, library, and canteen are top-anotch. There are 3-4 canteen and all have good food with reasonable price. The library is very well maintained. You have a quiet and personal space for each student.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University is home away from home.
reviews.review_text: There is full Wi-Fi connection on campus. The infrastructure of our college is beautiful. The college is full of greenery. Classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. The whole college is equipped with air-conditioners. The food quality  is good and tasty and they maintain hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: Students can join this college without any hesitation.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are very well-maintained. The library is very big and peaceful. It has a sports complex and other activities. There is a basketball ground and a badminton court in the college. But we do not have any cricket ground but there we can play football in a small area.

reviews.review_heading: There are really good infrastructure and faculty members in the college.
reviews.review_text: Amity University has a library with comfortable and silent surroundings. This university has 5 blocks. The examination block is separate from other blocks and 4 blocks are for classes for different courses. The university has a sports complex with different games.

reviews.review_heading: An honest review of Amity University Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great starting from the Wi-Fi connection, all the items you need for labs. Classrooms are nice. The library is also well-maintained. You would get every book that you would need for your course. Hostel facilities are also awesome. The quality of the mess and canteen is also above average. There are proper medical facilities available and sports and games are given equal attention.

paragraphs: Amity University Gurgaon admission is a multi-step process. Candidates seeking for getting admission to various courses of the university must apply at the official website. To admit the right candidates, the university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling out the application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and paying for the Amity University Gurugram fees at the time of final admission.
Step 1: Amity University Gurgaon Application Process 2025

Students must fill out an application form on the official admission website of Amity University Gurugram (https://portal.amity.edu/NewOnlineForm/Candidate/SignUp). With candidates needing to fill out a separate form in case of multiple course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,100for each form. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill out an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity University Gurgaon.
Step 2: Amity University Gurgaon Selection Process

Amity University Gurgaon admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For most of the UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round as per course requirements. The students are selected based on Amity PhD Entrance Test +Interview by Faculty Member or All India National Level Competitive Examination or NET (viz. UGC / CSIR -NET in Category 1,2 or 3, ICMR- JRF/SRF, ICAR-AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD),GATE, GPAT, DST – INSPIRE, DBT-JRF etc.
Step 3: Final Offer Letter

The final results are declared after the completion of all previous rounds. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay a certain amount as per theAmity University Gurugram feesstructure to secure their seats.

paragraphs: During the Amity Gurugram placement drive 2025, in 422 companies visited in total. There were 147 fortune-500 companies and 275 national companies . The placement season 2025 welcomed 280 new recruiters .

As per the Amity Gurugram placement report, 430 recruiters participated and offered various job roles to the batch 2024 across sectors, such as E­-Commerce, BFSI, Consulting, Research , etc. Of all the total recruiters who participated in Amity University Gurgaon placements in 2024, 285 were new and 145 were repeated recruiters. The top recruiters of Amity University Gurgaon placements in 2024 included Amazon, Capgemini, Coforge, UNO Minda, PlanetSpark, etc. Further, according to Amity University Gurgaon Engineering NIRF report 2024, the median package offered to the BTech batch 2023 stood at INR 4.81 LPA.

hostel_campus.college_name: Amity University Gurugram Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description:
Amity University provides air-conditioned apartment-style accommodation facility for 2100 students. The rooms are well-lit and well-ventilated, with geysers in every bathroom and TV set in the common room for entertainment.

The separate facilities for boys and girls, caring wardens and a tight security ensure a pleasant stay allowing students to focus on their academics. The air-conditioned residential apartment suites consist of 3 single rooms with an attached bathroom and sitting lounge equipped necessary furniture.

library.description:
Amity University library is an integrated knowledge resource centre that is stocked with approx 50,000 books, 20,000 journals and 2,500 publications. 

Amity students have access to Ebsco Host, UGC-Infonet, INDEST-AICTE, IS1 and Delnet. All Amity students are members of Amizone - Amity Intranet Zone which allows them easy access to these journals and papers.

These Libraries consist of Reference Sections, Circulation Sections, Audio-visual Sections, Periodical Sections and Digital Libraries.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Course curriculum is pretty appropriate, especially for students belonging to an IT background. First two semesters covered the basics of languages like C, C+. Later we learned about some advanced languages like Java, HTML, etc. There re a lot of guest lectures and workshops which are frequently organized for knowledge. Hostel facility is available and also PGs are available near the college. The room offering is good with single as well as double sharing, and the price of separate rooms is high...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Gurugram.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are in very good condition. Very good facilities and infrastructure are available for your course and department; for example, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library are all very good. The quality of the facilities in hostels is very good. The quality of food is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: It is great. The hostel is very comfortable with a friendly atmosphere everywhere. Students taking the AC hostel are given separate rooms with an almirah. For a non-AC hostel, the same things are given, but instead of separate rooms for students. They are given 3 sharing and 2 sharing rooms. The food quality is really good in the mess. The campus has many food outlets, which leaves no doubt in getting good food for hostellers and day scholars as well.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University Gurgaon B.Tech CSE review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at Amity is good with very calm environment. There are many active clubs and societies you and become part of those and explore yourself. You can also make a good connection here. There are only few places where you can get Wi-Fi. Library is one of them and college classrooms are air-conditioned. Hostel is overall good with good facilities for hostel mess. There are 2 messes at Amity and many other outlets for food. Amity has a very big sports complex timing is 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM o...

reviews.review_heading: Amity University is considered as a good university for studies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and all are available. Infrastructure is very good. Facilities in hostel and course are good including food of the best quality. Medical facilities are available with doctors and nurses. We have good sports ground and different games.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing procedures and life-size equipments to get a thorough knowledge of nursing.
reviews.review_text: We have atleast 4-5 different labs catering to each department and having human size models, dummies, and equipments. All the procedures and equipments to perform and practice for the future. Our hostel is a very safe and secure place having sets of 2 beds in each room, 6 students in each suite. For food, we have at least 7 different places with amazing food and a way to connect to people. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Sports events and cultural fests happen twice a year.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure is good and canteen food is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, classroom is ventilated, and AC is available. Number of options and variety are available. Classrooms and corridors are always clean. Washrooms are clean and hygienic. Air-conditioned classrooms are available. It provides proper uniforms for clinicals. It also provides laboratory facilities and training.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty members. There are 99% placements and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college and hostel is amazing. It has availability of Wi-Fi. Hostel provides clean and quiet environment. Hostel also has medical facilities. We also have labs, library, and classroom. Quality of food is like home and great mess is there.

reviews.review_heading: Studying here always feels like learning something new every day.
reviews.review_text: The environment of the college is very well. They provide good care to the students. Faculty members are very helpful to the students. The canteens are good and only veg and hygiene food is served. Library is also good and all new books are available.

reviews.review_heading: I feel proud as a student of Amity University Haryana.
reviews.review_text: Amity University Haryana has one of the best infrastructure, which is well-maintained in terms of lab classes, library facilities, and the list goes on. AC, non-AC rooms, water cooler, lift, study table, medical facilities, sports complex, playground, and mess food. These are some facilities which are provided to hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University provided what students needed the most.
reviews.review_text: The facility and the infrastructure are amazing. Classrooms, water facility, library, labs, and Wi-Fi facility are amazing and have all the equipment and books that are needed in the course, and every necessary thing required for the course. Hostel, if we talk about hostel, food is the first thing we have in our mind, and here the food is amazing, including other facilities too, good food quality, and medical facilities, everything is good here.

reviews.review_heading: "Great infrastructure and facilities with diverse student amenities."
reviews.review_text: The ASH department offers excellent infrastructure, including Wi-Fi-enabled campuses and modern classrooms. Hostels are comfortable, but sometimes the food isn't good, while sports facilities enhance the overall student experience, and the medical facilities are also not good in the university.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend others take admission here, especially if they are looking for hotel management.
reviews.review_text: Students who are interested in sports will find a decent sports complex at this university, and tournaments are held at specific times of the year. Hostels are also decent, with food quality being good and offering variations. Hostels also have recreational rooms.

reviews.review_heading: A balanced college with good opportunities and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is actually better than many universities. We have a front office lab, restaurant, kitchen, bakery lab, Wi-Fi, and a library everything. There are approximately 5-6 canteens, and they are very clean. The food is also very good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The best private university in Haryana.
reviews.review_text: Clean and tidy classrooms with state-of-the-art infrastructure provide a smooth learning experience. The library is a very comfortable place to study. There are multiple cafeterias on the campus to chose from, offering a variety of meal options. A big sports complex includes sports such as tennis, basketball, badminton, football, volleyball, etc. A medical room is available in the hostel.

paragraphs: Amity Patna admissionis a multi-step process. The university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling the application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and payingAmity University Patna feesat the time of final admission.
1: Amity University Patna Application Process

The Amity University admission process begins by filling an application form on the official website of Amity University Patna. If candidates wish to apply for more than one programme, they need to fill out a separate form for each course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,500each. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity Patna.
2: Amity University Patna Selection Process

Amity Patna admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For most of the UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round, which is mandatory to qualify for admission to every course. Candidates have to qualify for exams such as CAT, MAT,GMAT, Amity- Joint Entrance Examination etc.
3: The Final Offer Letter

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay for a certain amount as per theAmity Patna fees structureto secure their seat.

IMED Pune applications 2026 are conducted in an online mode. Candidates must apply online on the institute's website to apply for the respective entrance exam. Along with that, they must pay an application fee ofINR 2,000 and INR 1,500for BMAT and BUMAT, respectively.

reviews.review_heading: IMED is deemed college which fall under Bharati Vidyapeeth.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. Wi-Fi is there. Quality is good for food. Mess and canteen are great. The sports section is good as it offers various competitions.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, good teaching staff. Student-oriented programme.
reviews.review_text: Library is really good. It has a collection of books in different domains. It also has a digital library. Wi-Fi is available on every floor. Classroom has digital screens and a presentation facility. Facilities and infrastructure available are good.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: I was a day scholar, so I would not be able to comment on the hostel facilities, but the hostel was on the same campus as the college, so hostelites were definitely at an advantage in terms of being on time for lectures. The food was pretty much okay, and Sundays used to be their fest day.

reviews.review_heading: IMED, Bharati Vidyapeeth, a blend of world-class infrastructure and a holistic learning environment.
reviews.review_text: IMED offers spacious, well-ventilated classrooms equipped with modern amenities such as LCD projectors, computers and Wi-Fi connectivity. Some classrooms feature a lecture capture facility enabling the recording and online dissemination of lectures. The institute houses state of the art labs that are well equipped with the latest software and systems. IMED's Knowledge Resource Center has a collection of books along with national and international journals and publications. The library offers dig...

reviews.review_heading: You will have a good college life.
reviews.review_text: Although the college is little small but it provides all the facilities like Wi-Fi, lab, big classrooms, etc. We have a smart board in every classroom. For food, I give it a 7/10. Medical facilities are good. Sports and games are fun and frequent rooms are also big.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest students take admission to this college to get a good education.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi. The library is good and classrooms are okay. The hostel is not good, and the environment is pretty good. Overall, my experience was a little bad. I hope the college takes my review into consideration and make improvements.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very clean and technological. Classrooms are very spacious, clean, and well-ventilated. The library and labs are very well-equipped with various facilities and technologies. The food quality provided in the canteen of the campus is very good and hygiene is also taken care of very particularly. There are various courts and playgrounds for the students to even excel in extracurricular activities and sports. Various inter-college competitions are also held.

reviews.review_heading: A comprehensive review of IMED - its infrastructure, academics, and student life.
reviews.review_text: It has good infrastructure, classrooms, and hygienic facilities. There is great food and staying facilities in the hostel with safety concerns. It provides facilities like good accommodation, dining and mess, sanitation, internet and connectivity, common areas, sports, medical, transport, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for placements and studies.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities and hostel culture are good. They provide tasty food. Various events and social gatherings are arranged by hostel students and staff. It has a very good culture. The hostel infrastructure is good. The hostel facility is near to college campus and thus is best for students.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with so many opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good as they have all the necessary things, like Wi-Fi, labs, good classrooms, sports rooms, etc. The hostel food is good, and the rooms are also okay as I have only stayed there for 1 year. For the first year, this will be an experience.

reviews.review_heading: It has great placements and practical learning. The campus life is vibrant.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs are well-equipped with modern infrastructure. The digital learning facilities are excellent. The library is well-stocked with a wide range of books. The hostel accommodation is very good, with a strong emphasis on cleanliness and maintenance.

reviews.review_heading: My educational journey in this college is MBA batch 2023-25.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities and infrastructure are also very good, they provide a clean and peaceful environment for study and full security, so students feel fully secure and focused on the curriculum. The facilities and infrastructure provided for our courses and department are good. Classrooms are spacious and have basic amenities like whiteboards and projectors. Labs have the tools and technology we need, and the library is well-stocked with a variety of books.

reviews.review_heading: Where knowledge meets opportunity, IMED Pune shines.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides excellent facilities and infrastructure. The campus has high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped computer labs, and modern teaching aids. Hostels are well-maintained and clean. The mess and canteen provide nutritious and hygienic food. Medical facilities include a medical room. Sports facilities include a playground, indoor games, as well as outdoor games. Overall, the college provides a conducive environment for learning and growth.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus and supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. But there are no ACs in all classrooms. The library has a large collection of books, and the library coordinators are very supportive. There is no canteen facility available on campus. There must be a canteen inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: IMED is always a full of opportunities for students.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility and hostel culture are good and provide tasty food. Various events and social gatherings are arranged by hostel students and staff. It has a very good culture. Hostel infrastructure is good. Hostel facility is near to college campus and thus is best for students.

highlights.summary: Founded in 2007, Chandigarh Business School of Administration is a private institute. It is located in Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab. Chandigarh Business School of Administration provides UG and PG courses in Full Time mode. It provides 9 courses across specialisations such as Chemistry and Physics. Some of the courses offered at this institute include MBA/PGDM, B.Sc., M.Sc., MCA and B.Com. Chandigarh Business School of Administration fees ranges between INR 46,000 to 1,37,350. The student intake for these courses is 1992. Chandigarh Business School of Administration offers these course across fields such as Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce, Humanities & Social Sciences and Science. Chandigarh Business School of Administration offers all the campus facilities to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Totally satisfied with the opportunities provided by this college to students.

review_content.Placements: More than 9,000 students have been placed through this college. The highest salary package offered is 70 LPA. The average salary package offered is about 4 LPA. Students are placed in big companies like Wipro, Microsoft, Google, etc. Students are also placed in foreign companies from our college at high salary packages.
review_content.Infrastructure: For B.Com in our college, we have 2 sections with 60 students each. Each classroom has free Wi-Fi which can be accessed by only students by filling in details (username, roll number). We also have our own library where only books related to our course are available.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good college must visit with good infra and so much fun activities nd very very good food courts

review_content.Placements: Total job offered is 6617. Highest CTC is 35 LPA. Average CTC is 5.5 LPA. Placement rate is 80%. The median package offered during CGC Landran placements is Rs 5 LPA in year 2023. Moreover, the highest package offered during CGC Landran placements is Rs 45.5 LPA in year 2023.
review_content.Infrastructure: Rooms are quiet good but can be more better if they provide Ac. CGC Landran offers modern infrastructure, including well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, a comprehensive library, on-campus hostels, sports facilities, and dedicated spaces for extracurricular activities, providing a conducive environment for learning and growth.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Research well before taking admission here.

review_content.Placements: Only 50 or 60% of the students are placed in my course. The highest package is 15 LPA. The lowest is 4-5 LPA. Deloitte, KPMG, and many more are the top recruiters. Roles for marketing and technical skills are offered. Actually, I am studying here currently and I face a lot of problems with attendance. I cannot give an exam just because of that. This is a bad college and I cannot see my future by studying here .
review_content.Infrastructure: Sometimes there are a lot of problems faced by students for attending classes on a regular basis due to some technical issues related to that in the classrooms, the benches are small and not suitable for regular attending classes and the Wi-Fi does not work properly. Sometimes the projector also doesn't work .

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Best college for the placements.

review_content.Placements: Our college has a great placements records. Every year around 70-80% students gets placements. From the 7th semester students become eligible for the placements. The average package is 7-8lpa. Companies like Accenture, JP Morgan, Deloitte etc. Visits the campus for the recruitments.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is vibrate. College has big classrooms and all are air conditioned. College has labs for the research works. College library has all the necessary stuff. College has hostel for boys and girls. Hostel has facilities like Wi-Fi, ground, gym etc. The food in hostel mess is tasty.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Faculty in my college is really good and helpful. We have friendly environment.

review_content.Placements: I have so many friends who were placed wid many good companies having great packages. They were really happy and satisfied with these college placements. The percentage of internships is low as we didn't get any internships during the course. Overall this is a good college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is okay as mobile signals are weak in classrooms and also there are no air conditions in the classroom. Computer labs do have Wi-Fi available but sometimes it doesn't work due to bad signals. Hostellers often complain about the bad quality of food provided to them.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: I would recommend joining here after 12th as college life here is full of adventures.

review_content.Placements: Almost 60 to 70% of the students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies of our college are TCS and other private banks like Axis bank. Moreover, our college also has a training and placement cell which majorly focuses on placements. Even in the last year, we have a regular class of TPP for placements, which includes quantitative, aptitude, GK, debates, GDs and all things related to the placements. Even my elder sister from BBA here got placed in top tier company.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is very good, and even our department has a lift. There is a computer lab with a capacity of around 70 students. Moreover, internet connection is also available here for virtual meetups or for virtual interviews. The hostel is amazing with decent food facility and 24x7 light availability.

GLA University Mathura UP popular programmes are BTech and MBA. BTech and MBA students are placed in various companies such as Adani Group, Wipro, Accenture, Microsoft, Capgemini, and others. placements.overview:
The GLA University Mathura full form stands for Ganeshi Lal Agrawal University and was founded in 2010 as a private university. It has been accredited by NAAC with an grade A+ and recognised by the UGC and AICTE. Located in Mathura, GLA Mathura, through 14 departments and 9 institutes, offers 250+ courses at the UG, PG, Doctoral and Diploma levels to students. These courses are provided for Engineering, Chemistry, and various others. Moroever, it also offers distance education to students through the Centre for Distance and Online Education.

GLA University Mathura UP popular programmes are BTech and MBA. BTech and MBA students are placed in various companies such as Adani Group, Wipro, Accenture, Microsoft, Capgemini, and others. BTech students can work as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Civil Engineers, and Electronics Engineers, or can take up various job opportunities relevant to their field.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Genuine review from GLA University.

review_content.Placements: In my batch, the placement rate is average, it's about 70 percent. The highest package is around 18 LPA. The average package is around 4 LPA. Generally, recruiting companies are mass recruiters like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, etc. Internship is about 70 percent.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are smart and modern. There is world-class infrastructure in our college. Hostel, food, and rest are all average to decent category. Medical facility is available in the college. Sports and games activity is available on the campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Forensic) in academic collaboration with IBM - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the staff and management.

review_content.Placements: 97% of students are placed by the college itself only. The highest package offered is 60 LPA in Microsoft, and the average ranges from 5 to 9 LPA, while the lowest is 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, Accenture, Cognizant, HCL, Hiresure, etc. Roles offered are sales, QA, SDE, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Overall, the infrastructure of the college is very good. All labs are equipped with separate Wi-Fi and a firewall to prevent misuse of Wi-Fi. The speed of Wi-Fi is very good. Facilities in the hostel are also very good. The food is given properly, and the health of students is taken care of very responsibly.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Analytics) in academic collaboration with IBM - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Review of GLA University.

review_content.Placements: Around 50-60% student get placed by the end of the year. The top companies are Wipro, Accenture, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, TCS, and some product-based companies. The highest package goes up to 10-12 LPA. The average package goes to 4-6 LPA, and the lowest package goes up to 3 LPA. Common roles are Software Developer and Associate Engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Mess food quality is manageable but repetitive, and hygiene is mostly maintained. A medical facility is also available. The central library is well-maintained with a large number of books, journals and digital resources. Hostel facilities are average to good, with clean rooms and basic needs.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIML) in partnership with Microsoft - Batch of 0
reviews_list.review_title: Good learning experience with an active campus.

review_content.Placements: I am from the 2024-2028 batch at GLA University. Based on seniors' records, around 70-80% of students from my course get placed. The highest package goes up to around 10-12 LPA, the average is 4-5 LPA, and the lowest is around 3 LPA. Companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Capgemini, and Cognizant visit the campus. Around 60-70% of students get internships with good faculty support. Common roles include Software Developer, Engineer, Trainee, and Analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities for my course are good. Classrooms are clean and comfortable. Labs are useful for practical work and help us understand subjects better. Wi-Fi is available on campus, and the library has enough books and study material for students. Hostel facilities are okay and suitable for students. Rooms are decent and livable. Mess food is average but clean, and the canteen has different food items. Medical help is available on campus when needed. The college also has good sports facilities for games like cricket, volleyball, basketball, badminton, and indoor games. Overall, the facilities support both studies and student life well.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Block Chain Technology) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: GLA University Mathura is a private university. It has many courses, like engineering.

review_content.Placements: Placement percentage is around 50-70 percent. From the last batch, it is 60 LPA from the CSE department. The top recruiting company is Capgemini. Common roles offered are Software Developer, Data Analyst, Testing Engineer, Business Analyst, Sales Executive, and HR roles. Placements are good for hardworking and skilled students.
review_content.Infrastructure: GLA University Mathura has good infrastructure with campus Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a spacious library. Hostels are decent and clean, the mess food is average while medical and sports facilities are easily available and well-maintained.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cloud Computing and Virtualization) in academic collaboration with IBM - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the faculty, good placements, good infrastructure, and not-so-good facilities.

review_content.Placements: The highest package is 55 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Infosys, TCS, Global Logic, Microsoft, etc., but a large part also depends on one's hard work. The top roles offered in my course are software developer, tester, frontend developer, backend developer, full-stack developer, etc. A few of my seniors got internships in Amazon, Microsoft, and JP Morgan, and some got PPO too later on because of their hard work and dedication.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are fairly good. Every department has its own Wi-Fi, and classrooms are also really well made. Each class has projectors and enough space. The library is also really well made and a nice place to study quietly and peacefully. Talking about the hostel, it also depends on one's adjustment qualities. But the food in the mess is good and sometimes not good too. Canteen food is better tasting than the mess hall food. Medical facilities are average. There is room for improvement. A lot of options and events for sports and games.

GLA University Mathura admissions 2025 are both merit and entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed process around GLA admissions 2025:
Step 1: GLA University Mathura Application Process 2025

GLA University Mathura admission process 2025 starts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at GLA University Mathura. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the PG courses at GLA University Mathura is entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such as GLAET for the selection of respective courses. Furthermore, the university offers UG courses through its affiliated colleges. Admissions to UG courses are based on merit scores obtained in the last qualifying exam.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates have to appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount ofGLA University Mathura feeto secure their seat.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Business Analytics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Something creepy about my university.

content.Placements: I don't know the exact placement percentage. But the average package is 7-8 LPA. I think for freshers it's okay. I think that most placements are in Tata company, as I myself, in my 1st semester, got a chance of an industry visit in Tata company. So it's good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has a good environment and security.

content.Placements: 80% of students were placed, and roles are basically for software designers, developers or artificial intelligence students who are studying at this university. Many companies like TCS and other companies are willing to enter and take the students from the college.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and quality of food are quite good. Wi-Fi is available in every room of the hostel, and the medical staff is quite helpful. Various types of sports and games are available for hostel students, and anybody can play at any time. The library is quite big.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The college is totally awesome.

content.Placements: As I study in this college, I have seen many of my seniors who have passed out and are working happily at various places. Therefore, there are no problems regarding placements. This is a guarantee that you will get placed somewhere. It is a reliable institution.
content.Infrastructure: As I study in this college right now. The infrastructure is totally awesome and can't be matched by many nearby colleges, hence no one can doubt that there are different blocks for each core branch, and several labs are there that are totally dedicated.

individual_reviews.course: BCA with Industry Oriented Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and best campus facilities. Skill-focused college with supportive teachers.

content.Placements: My college has good placements. Mostly, students who have good skills get 100% placement, and even those who put in a little hard work are easily able to get placed. The highest package 1.5 crores and the lowest package is 5-6 LPA. Mostly, students are placed in non-teaching companies. The top recruiting companies are Amazon and Deloitte.
content.Infrastructure: My course department has good infrastructure. We have Wi-Fi labs, classrooms, and a library, and everything works fine. The hostel facilities are overall okay. The mess food is not bad, but the taste of the food is decent. All the basic medical facilities are available. And we have proper grounds for both outdoor and indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Dual Specialization - Batch of 2026

individual_reviews.title: Best experience I ever had.

content.Placements: I joined GITAM in 2024 (BBA). In my course, 70% of the total students would have applied for the placements, and out of that, 40% would have got placement. The highest package is around 9 LPA, and the average package is around 4 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies are Deloitte, etc. 70% of the students got internships. Top roles offered in the course are the head of the student life and the student council committee.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities provided by the college are very good. The infrastructure, too, is very good. We have Wi-Fi facilities everywhere in the college, and every block has a library. Also, we have one library block to study. The hostel rooms are also very good, and the food in the mess is also nice. Medical facilities are provided whenever needed, and regular sports meets are conducted.

paragraphs: Registration

Check the site of GITAM Business School, Visakhapatnam.Choose the section that says that there are admissions or apply now. Register and give your name, email ID, phone number among other minimal details.
Pay the application fee as described in the notification of admission.
Application Screening and Shortlisting.

Later onwards the submission of the application, the admissions committee will screen and shortlist the candidates according to the eligibility rules. Academic qualifications and entrance exam scores may also be set as the criteria of eligibility.
Group Discussion, Personal Interview (GDPI).
Shortlisted after the first round of screening, the shortlisted candidates will be invited to take part in a Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI).
Confirmation of Admission.

GITAM Business School will send email or other notifications to selected candidates. The candidates will be expected to provide the first instalment of the course fee within the required time period to ascertain their admission.

reviews.review_heading: My personal review of GITAM School of Business, Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: All facilities provided in the course/department were very good and helpful. We got hi-fi technology in the classrooms with digitalized teaching. The environment was very clean and hygienic, including the canteen and washrooms. Even the hostel facilities were very good and hygienic. We got good food in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities were quick and efficient, and regular sports meets were conducted for various sports. Wi-Fi was available throughout the college.

reviews.review_heading: I am very happy with the college and college life.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities provided in the course/department are very good and cool, and very helpful. We get hi-fi technology in the classroom with digitalised teaching. We have a very clean and hygienic environment, canteen, washrooms, etc. Even the hostel facilities are very good and hygienic. And we get very good food in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities are very quick and good, and regular sports meets are conducted for various sports. Wi-Fi is available everywhere in college.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college with great overall campus life.
reviews.review_text: We do have good facilities and infrastructure in our college, like everywhere you go, we have separate Wi-Fi for each floor in each block, spacious classrooms with digital projectors for interaction with students, and a big library, and we do have active clubs, activities, and interactive sessions with professionals and experts.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best College for the MBA Course.
reviews.review_text: In terms of facilities, my college is the best. Labs are fully equipped, and someone is there to help you learn how to use the machines. The whole institution area is Wi-Fi equipped, and the hostels have Wi-Fi in the common area. Now they are trying to install Wi-Fi routers on every floor. Mess food is not so good, but canteen food is good. The hostel rooms have been maintained and are in great condition for your stay.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GITAM School of Business, Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are one of a kind, and the food menu is very frequently changed based on the reviews given by the students. For a hostel in the beginning, you need to pay around Rs. 50,000 for pre-booking, of which you would be paid back. 10,000 at the end. Every month, you would be getting a bill that includes mess charges, hostel rent, power, maintenance, etc, which would vary from Rs. 7000- Rs. 10,000/month.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GITAM School of Business, Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: Gitam is really trying to upgrade its infrastructure. The classrooms are air-conditioned, we have a great library, and the best thing about Gitam is its infrastructure. There are plenty of canteens available on campus. There is a badminton court, a kabaddi court, a gym, etc., on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Visakhapatnam and nature campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is the best. Classrooms and the Wi-Fi facilities are too good than other colleges. Hostel facilities and the quality of food in the mess are too good. Medical facilities are super. The sports and games facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has its own cafeteria and Wi-Fi facility. It has more than 3 computer labs and has its library. All hostel rooms are neatly cleaned and sanitized, and the food provided is also safe and healthy. College also has a gym which is well-maintained and has proper ventilation and infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: GJUST Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Facilities are average, like infrastructure, campus life, crowd, teachers, and hostel.

content.Placements: The highest package from CSE is 6 LPA, and the average package is around 3 LPA. 5-10 students are generally placed till now (mid placement season). Most of the students try to find internships off campus by building their skills on their own, and mostly get their placements off campus.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library are good. There are all the facilities for a studious student who genuinely wants to study. But the hostel provided for B.Tech students is very bad. No space in the room, no separate almirah, table, chair, or even bed. The food is also very bad at this hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the infrastructure. The faculty is supportive and caring.

content.Placements: No placements are available in my course at my college. But it gives placements in internships, which are very few. They are given to about 2-3 students in a full batch only, which is a very bad thing. I am absolutely dissatisfied with it, and it should give placements for jobs also.
content.Infrastructure: Benches in classrooms are bad and broken. Fans are not working properly. Hostels are average, and the food is average. The good thing about the college is that it has a very large sports complex, which has many indoor game courts and outdoor sports as well. There is a good library which is very large, and seats are available in very good condition.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Computer Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review from 2nd sem B.Tech E&C student.

content.Placements: The placements are even less than what we call decent here. You cant expect more from the on campus placements from this college. They roam around 3 to 4 LPA as the average package. Of course, it depends on the crowd as well, but still, there are very few packages offered here.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels of the university are in a way like, like you get a hostel in just 1st year, after that, there will be no hostels facility for students and still the hostels are not that good. 4 to5 students live in a single room and it becomes impossible for someone to study.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: GJU, Hisar, college life review.

content.Placements: In our university, almost 50 percent of the students are placed on the campus. The average package is 4 LPA, and the highest package is 23 LPA. Some of the companies that are enrolled in our university are Wipro, Infosys, TVS, etc. Data scientist, data analytics, and AI engineering are the top courses seen in placement and internship.
content.Infrastructure: There is very good infrastructure that helps us to learn easily. Very good classrooms and smart classes with Wi-Fi for each student are provided in the hostel. The food quality is not very good, but it has good medical facilities and a good sports ground.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Packaging Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A great place for practical learning in printing & packaging.

content.Placements: Placements in the printing & packaging technology course are decent but still improving. Around 60-70% students get placed every year. Top recruiting companies include ITC, Parksons Packaging, Zircon, TCPL, and Natraj. The highest package goes around 7-8 LPA, the average is around 3-4 LPA, and the lowest can be 2-2.5 LPA. Many students also get internships in corrugation, label printing and flexible packaging companies, which helps in gaining industry exposure. More core printing companies are expected to come in future.
content.Infrastructure: The university has a large campus with greenery and well-maintained buildings. The printing department is equipped with modern labs, offset and flexographic printing machines, computer labs, and a good library. Wi-Fi is available, and classrooms are clean and spacious. Hostel facilities are good, rooms are maintained properly, and the mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities, medical centre, canteen and stationery shops are available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities are average, like infrastructure, campus life, crowd, teachers, and hostel.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library are good. There are all the facilities for a studious student who genuinely wants to study. But the hostel provided for B.Tech students is very bad. No space in the room, no separate almirah, table, chair, or even bed. The food is also very bad at this hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the infrastructure. The faculty is supportive and caring.
reviews.review_text: Benches in classrooms are bad and broken. Fans are not working properly. Hostels are average, and the food is average. The good thing about the college is that it has a very large sports complex, which has many indoor game courts and outdoor sports as well. There is a good library which is very large, and seats are available in very good condition.

reviews.review_heading: Review from 2nd sem B.Tech E&C student.
reviews.review_text: The hostels of the university are in a way like, like you get a hostel in just 1st year, after that, there will be no hostels facility for students and still the hostels are not that good. 4 to5 students live in a single room and it becomes impossible for someone to study.

reviews.review_heading: GJU, Hisar, college life review.
reviews.review_text: There is very good infrastructure that helps us to learn easily. Very good classrooms and smart classes with Wi-Fi for each student are provided in the hostel. The food quality is not very good, but it has good medical facilities and a good sports ground.

reviews.review_heading: A great place for practical learning in printing & packaging.
reviews.review_text: The university has a large campus with greenery and well-maintained buildings. The printing department is equipped with modern labs, offset and flexographic printing machines, computer labs, and a good library. Wi-Fi is available, and classrooms are clean and spacious. Hostel facilities are good, rooms are maintained properly, and the mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities, medical centre, canteen and stationery shops are available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Guru Jambheshwar University of Science and Technology is an overall good university.
reviews.review_text: Basically, there are 4 hostels. Each hostel has Wi-Fi, a canteen, a mess, and TV rooms. There are grounds for playing as well. There are study rooms that are as good as libraries. Medical facilities are also available, as the health center is not far from the hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Our campus is very good in every field, with lots of greenery and best studies.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good on our campus, including fully AC labs for new ideas, coding practice, Chemistry lab, AutoCAD lab, and more. Hostels have luxurious rooms and clean washrooms. Mess food is average in hostels, and there are four hostels for girls and four hostels for boys.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is so well. Placement and crowd need to improve if a student is serious about them.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is decent like we get separate Wi-Fi and pass so like you can do your basic work easily. Labs are well-equipped and fully running condition. Library is also AC equipped and fully running well cleaned and big. Quality of students is fine only, like for the first student who got the new hostel, else they will get the old wing that is just average. Quality of food varies to change our meals according to taste. Canteen is available. Medical facility is top notch but...

reviews.review_heading: GJU lifestyle of students.
reviews.review_text: Very neat and clean rooms. I like to spend time with my friends in these classrooms. We talk for hours sitting here, and we always miss this time when we all together sit here and talk to each other and make each other laugh. Sitting in canteen etc. I like it.

reviews.review_heading: Good institute of the city.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities on the campus. And all the services provided by the college are the best. The college department is very gentle. There are many facilities like Wi-Fi, Science lab, computer lab, playground, NCC, classroom, off-course, and a big library.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Haryana
reviews.review_text: My college facilities and infrastructure are very good, and the department is very neat and clean. The classroom is very big and the air facilities are very good. My college hostel facilities and infrastructure are very good, and the food quality is very good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Dayanand CollegeReviewed on 14 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College is moderate with decent campus.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi at all. It is only available in computer labs and library. Labs are well furnished and equipped with all the required equipments and materials. Hostel facility is not available for boys but available for girls. There is only a first aid kit in medical facility terms. Sports and games are encouraged. We have dedicated ground and field for specific sports like cricket, football, tennis, handball, etc.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by CRM Jat CollegeReviewed on 9 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best college in Haryana.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities and infrastructure are good and the best. The department is very neat and clean. The rooms, labs, library, and classrooms and the hostel facilities are very good, and the food quality is very good. The mess, canteen, medical, and sports facilities are also very good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by CRM Jat CollegeReviewed on 12 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best college in Punjab and Haryana.
reviews.review_text: My college facility and infrastructure are very good and the best. Class, library, and labs are very great and air-free rooms, all rooms are neat and clean. My college hostel facilities are very good, and the food quality is very good. My college hostel mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports and games facilities are the best.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of placement and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in this college is very good, but it is only the infrastructure, not the study or courses. There is no space in hostels for students, and there is no generator to support electricity after a cut. No one is interested in listening to your problems. You have to buy your light for the room.

admission_process.title: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: HITS admission is mainly based on the university’s in-house entrance exam, i.e., HITSEEE & HITSCAT.Hindustan Universityconducts HITSEEE to provide admission to BTech courses. HITSCAT is the new entrance test conducted by the institute for admission to BDes, Law, Management, and some other courses. Additionally, some national entrance exams are also accepted for admission. These include UGC NET, CLAT, and GATE. Apart from this, the university also has a Centre for Open and Digital Education where six courses are taught online including both UG and PG level courses. Hindustan University courses offered include UG, PG, Doctoral, and Integrated courses in popular streams. These are BCom, BBA, BCA, MA, MBA, and MCA.

The institute offers more than 11 courses across various specialisations and aspirants need to apply for courses through the official website. Candidates can read the table below to learn more on Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science admission highlights 2025:

HITS offers a diverse range of undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral, and integrated programs in popular fields. Thes include courses from Science, Engineering, Management, Humanities, and Medicine. Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS) has a multi-step admission process that students need to follow to get into the university. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the entrance exam followed by selection rounds and lastly confirmation of admission. After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website of the university. Interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission. Additionally, Admission to all the programmes is based on the entrance exam. Check below the complete HITS admission process:
1 - HITS Application 2025
The mode of application is online. Candidates must register online and then fill out the online application form.
2 - HITS Admission Selection rounds
Appear for the university-based entrance exam i.e., HITSEEE & HITSCAT. The selection will be based on entrance exam score and GDPI and then wait for the release of their merit list.
3 - HITS Document Verification
Once the selection rounds are done, the shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: What is the fees of Hindustan University for BTech?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the BTech course ranges between INR 1.8 Lakhs to INR 13 lakhs. Apart from this, the candidate also has to pay hostel and one-time fee to pursue BTech course at Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science commonly known as Hindustan University.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for MBA at HITS Chennai?
faqs.answer: The total fee for HITS Chennai MBA courses is cumulative of multiple components, such as security deposit, tuition fee, hostel fee, and more. Selected candidates have to pay admission fee amount after selection for seat confirmation. Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science MBA tuition fee range from INR 1.2 Lacs to INR 4.3 lakh . Additionally, the one-time fee is INR 8,500 and the hostel charges range from INR 1.48 Lacs to INR 1.64 lakh . It must be noted that the mentioned fee is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is still subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the course fee for LLB at Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for LLB courses at Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science is INR 5 lakh. Candidates also have to pay tutition fee and hostel fee. Note: This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

The hostels have well-furnished air-conditioned and regular rooms with attached restrooms providing the right ambience for the students. There are five residential halls for boys and three for girls on campus

paragraphs: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science offers both need-based and merit-based scholarships to the eligible students. Also, Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science has instituted Hindustan Teaching Research Fellowships (HTRF) for eligible candidates.
Below are the major highlights of Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science scholarships:

Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science provides a total of 7 scholarships to eligible students. Below mentioned are the detailed information regarding Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science scholarships:
DRDO Scholarship Scheme for Girls

This scholarship is for Girls / Women students studying in first year of Under Graduate (BE/B.TECH: full time four year degree) and Post Graduate (M.TECH/ME: two year full time degree course) under “DRDO Scholarship Scheme for Girls in Aerospace Engg / Aeronautical Engg / Space Engg & Rocketry / Avionics / Aircraft Engg”.
Covid Martyrs Scholarships

This scholarship is for wards of COVID Martyrs, who have lost their lives protecting our countrymen during the COVID Pandemic will be given complete Tuition Fee waiver in the discipline of their choice, having met the basic laid down norms, such as marks in qualifying exams etc. Also all the expenses of the student which include traveling, boarding and lodging will be taken care of by HITS. Also, a monthly stipend is provided during the period of the course.
Covid Frontline Warrior Scholarship

This scholarship is for the wards of Doctors, Healthcare professionals, Government and Service personnel those who have participated in protecting our countrymen during the COVID Pandemic. The scholarship is for a period of two years across all courses to those who meet the basic scholarship criteria.
Dr KCG Verghese Merit Cum Means Scholarship

This scholarship is offered to the top scorers in Class 12 from any School, Boards, Subjects, Centum Scorers, Class Toppers at HITS, Batch Toppers, and UG Rank Holders and Proficiency Prize holders are awarded scholarship to pursue their higher studies at HITS. Scholarships are also awarded to the meritorious students who are financially weak to meet their educational needs at HITS.
Dr Elizabeth Verghese Founder Chancellor Scholarship

This scholarship is offered to the girls with academic potential to pursue higher education and who are from lower income families and are interested in pursuing higher education at HITS are eligible for this scholarship.
Hindusthan Loyality Scholarship
This scholarship is subject to norms and the scrutiny of the Scholarship Committee. It is offered to:
Sports Scholarship

Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science offers this scholarship to the students who excel in sports. The student who has performed and achieved at the National, State and Inter-University Levels in the following sports are eligible.

review_content.Placements: The college has witnessed 100% placement since inception, and it is getting better year by year. Organisations lying in the nexus of agribusiness and allied sectors are frequent visitors to our academy. The speciality of our academy lies in academic rigour and competitive spirit as a result of which we participate and perform well in national level B-Fest. individual_reviews.title: Best campus life, food and infrastructure facilities and 100% placements.

content.Placements: The academy offers 100% placement in the leading companies of agribusiness sector, not just for final placements but also for the summer internship programme as well. The alumni network is well spread across the leading firms and the academy has achieved these milestone just in 13 years since it's inception.
content.Infrastructure: Be it food or the greenery around the campus or the academics, everything has its own charm. Especially the congeniality and the ambiance that the NAARMIAN'S have created. Life at NAARM is a blissful experience and I am glad that I am a part of this venerated academy.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Agriculture Business - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: ICAR-NAARM in terms of placements, infrastructure and academics is good.

content.Placements: 100% of students are getting placed in various agribusiness sectors since the year of inception of PGDM-ABM. All the sectors of agriculture like the Agri Input sector, FMCG and Retail, Banking and Microfinance, Consultancy, Development, etc. are covered in terms of placement. Erudition, lectures given by industrial specialists, are conducted which help the students to get an idea and updates of all the agribusiness sectors. Average package for 2020-22 batch was Rs. 9.6LPA and the highest was Rs.13LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The academy has well-equipped classrooms, auditoriums, and conference halls. It has a sports complex with modern indoor and outdoor facilities. The academy has a gym and emphasizes lifestyle management. There is a well-equipped health centre that provides health services to the faculty, staff members, and students free of cost. The NAARM wall is the centre of attraction in the academy. The hostels are too good with all the facilities and good management. The library at ICAR-NAARM has nearly 30,000 books. The mess in HOR is spacious and serves healthy and delicious food with all types of food items.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Technology Management in Agriculture - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in terms of ROI, culture, learning environment and diversity.

content.Placements: The college has witnessed 100% placement since inception, and it is getting better year by year. Organisations lying in the nexus of agribusiness and allied sectors are frequent visitors to our academy. The speciality of our academy lies in academic rigour and competitive spirit as a result of which we participate and perform well in national level B-Fest. Our college students have won in various events like B-fests in IIM-Ahmedabad, IIM-Raipur, Agrimach by FICCI, SIBM-h, etc. The average salary package offered ranges between 7.5-8 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 6.5 LPA. Students undergo summer as well as winter internships, and they also work on live projects. We have technology business incubator as well. So, one interested in startups can be associated with them and learn, work with them. Within a short span, our college has established its name in the industry. Major recruiters are from Agri input, commodities, banking, NBFC, consultancy, supply chain management and development sector.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Agriculture Business - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I am happy with admission to this college. Placements are 100% here.

content.Placements: Placements are almost 100% every year since its inception. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA, the lowest salary package offered is 6. 5 LPA, the average salary package offered is 7.5 LPA. Companies like UPL, Coramandel Int. Ltd, Rasi Seeds, Seed Works, Nerl, ITC, Bayer Crop Science, Sulphur Mills Ltd, Sammunati Finance, Adama, Delta Agri Genetics, Techno Serve, etc., visited our campus for placements. The business manager is the top role offered to students. Almost 100% of the students get a summer internship in many companies every year in companies mentioned above.

individual_reviews.title: The PGDMA at ICAR-NAARM provides you good faculty, infrasture, 100% placement.

faqs.question: Q: What is the admission process of IIHMR University?

faqs.answer: For IIHMR Jaipur MBA admission, the final score is calculated based on few components that include 35% weightage for the score in CAT, XAT, NMAT, MAT, CMAT, ATMA, GPAT, or IIHMR-U MAT; 30% for graduation marks; 15% for Group Discussion performance and 20% for the Personal Interview. The total score is 100, and the students need to get above the minimum percentile cut off in the entrance exam, or else they can go for the IIHMR-U MAT if the marks are less than 50 percentile.
faqs.question: Q: How is the final score calculated for MBA admission at IIHMR Jaipur?

faqs.answer: The final selection of the candidate is based on his or her performance in the qualifying examination with proportional score in CAT, XAT, NMAT, MAT, CMAT, ATMA GMAT, IIHMR U MAT, the Group Discussion (GD), and Personal Interview (PI). GPAT score is accepted for admission to MBA Pharmaceutical Management. The weightage given is as follow - - CAT / XAT / MAT/ IIHMR U MAT/ NMAT/ CMAT / GMAT/ GPAT 35 - graduation marks 30 - Group discussion 15 - Personal Interview 20 A merit list is prepared on the basis of these parameters. There is no predefined cutoff but a score of 60 percentile or above is good to have.

admission_overview.college_name: IIHMR University Admission 2025: Application, Process, Courses, Fees

paragraphs: IIHMR Jaipur admission 2025is open for various courses. The prestigious institution offering quality education and research in the Health Management, Pharma and Development sectors. It currently offers postgraduate and doctoral programmes, executive education, research, and consultancy in Healthcare and related fields. All the courses are offered by the university under its three schools and institutes. The mode of application is online. Admission to all the courses is entrance-based. Additionally,IIHMR Universityconducts IIHMRU-MAT for those who have not appeared for any of the national-level aptitude tests. The university also offers a range of scholarships to students based the merit.

TheIIHMR Jaipur eligibilityfor all the courses at IIHMR Jaipur is merit in the last qualifying examination. However, the selection of candidates is entrance-based. They should have secured a minimum of 50% aggregate in any of the national entrance exams acceptable by the university. Additionally, IIHMR University conducts IIHMRU-MAT for those who have not appeared for any of the national-level aptitude tests. The table below mentions the eligibility and selection ofIIHMR courses:
