Candidates aspiring to apply for admission to the IIHMR Jaipur can fill out the application form online through its official website. Admissions remain open for all the programmes. However, the Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds. IIHMR Jaipur admission process is explained in brief below:
Step 1: IIHMR Jaipur Application Process 2025

Candidates who meet the MBA eligibility criteria can apply for admission to IIHMR. The IIHMR Jaipur application process is conducted online. Candidates can fill out and submit the admission form through the institute's official website. Applicants need to pay an application fee of INR 1,000.
Step 2: IIHMR Jaipur Selection rounds 2025

The IIHMR University shortlists at the admission stage based on the scores secured by students in any of the national-level aptitude tests held like MAT, CAT, CMAT, ATMA, XAT, GMAT, IRAT, UGC NET, etc. However, if a student does not attempt the above entrance exams, the IIHMR University itself conducts its IIHMRU-MAT. Following shortlisting, the candidates shortlisted are called for rounds of GDPI.
Step 3: IIHMR Jaipur Final Admission offer
The final selection is made based on the performance of the candidate in the GDPI round. Selected candidates need to pay the admissionconfirmation feeto secure their admission.

courses_data.description: IIHMR Jaipur offers a full-time Master of Public Health (MPH) programme of two-year duration. It combines Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health's excellence in the education sector and IIHMR's Health Management and Research in Southeast Asia. Important details of the MPH programme are given in the table below: Feature Details Eligibility -Bachelor’s degree/ Master’s degree/ PhD in a relevant discipline -English proficiency at TOEFL/ IELTS level -Verbal skills through GRE/ MCAT/ LSAT/ GMAT -Work experience (full-time) of two years or more (waived off in case of Master’s degree & PhD) Selection Criteria Prescreening process along with validTOEFL/IELTSandGRE/MCAT/LSAT/ GMAT scores Disclaimer:In the absence of the seat intake on the official website, the information has been sourced from non-official websites. faqs.question: What documents are required for applying to the JHSPH-IIHMR MPH programme at IIHMR University?
faqs.answer: Candidates must submit a CV, personal statement, recommendation letters, English proficiency scores, and (optional) standardized test scores. For international applicants, foreign transcripts must be evaluated by WES or ECE and submitted through SOPHAS to meet IIHMR University’s application requirements.

faqs.question: What is the admission process of IIHMR University?
faqs.answer: An online application form has to be filled up, along with submitting valid scores of CAT, XAT, NMAT, MAT, CMAT, ATMA, GMAT, GPAT, or IIHMRU-MAT for admission to IIHMR University. Candidates shortlisted for the process are invited for group discussions and personal interviews. Selection is based on the performance in academics, entrance test scores, GD, and PI. Admission finally gets confirmed once the document verification and payment of the fee are done.

faqs.question: How many students can do MPH at IIHMR University?
faqs.answer: Approximately 90 students can do an MPH at IIHMR UNIVERSITY. The university is placed 11th among private universities in the Education World Ranking and is well-known for its proficiency in health management research. The program integrates IIHMR's knowledge of health management research in South Asia with the caliber of the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. The selection is done based on prescreening along with TOEFL/ IELTS and GRE/ MCAT/ LSAT/ GMAT scores.

Computer labs with internet connectivity & printing facility, physical & digital library for students are available. Wi-Fi in full campus including hostel, single and double rooms are available with AC, free laundry service,  24*7 water and pre-paid electricity, attached mess and canteen facility. Food quality is good here, taste wish...

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIHMR University.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very beautiful and amazing. The walls of the college are made of stones. There is a peacock garden where peacocks can be seen during morning time. The college is spread in 14 acres. There are 14 classrooms, and the library has a good collection of books, journals, research papers etc.  The college has 3 computer labs with approximately 180 PCs. The food served in the mess fluctuates. Sometimes it's good and sometimes bad. The cafeteria has good delicious fast foods. A medical room ...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, along with good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi service, computer labs, classrooms, library, auditoriums are available in the college. The facilities provided in the hostel are satisfactory, along with the quality of mess food provided and other services. There is a medical room in the campus where one doctor sits 1-2 days a week in the evenings.

reviews.review_heading: I am extremely satisfied although, waiting for placement window.
reviews.review_text: In my university, there is free unlimited Wi-Fi, a library with online portal also available. Classrooms have projectors, white and blackboard. Mess food is available for hostlers and students who wish to eat food when hungry, but the taste is not like all other hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with all facilities and placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure gives you a feel of harvard. Hostel and food was good too. Library was amazing and complete blend of online and offline resources. Classrooms were amazing specially old auditorium. Beauty about shared network- we had a online shared folder where you could get collection of movies and online series.

reviews.review_heading: Our college gives versatile opportunities to grow.
reviews.review_text: Library is huge and has air-conditioned classrooms that make things more convenient. Campus is away from city life. Hostel is nice with good campus life.

The lush green and peaceful environment will not let you go back. The hostel facilities are more than what I expected. I am sure that you will get everything you require. Mess food quality is hygienic and delicious. The only disadvantage is for non-vegetarians, as only pure vegetarian dishes are served inside the mess. But...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best B-School among MAT based colleges.

Medical and sports facilities are available inside the campus only so that students do not have to go out of campus for any needs. There is a centralised library with the latest editions of books, which help students to grow and learn in a better way.

reviews.review_heading: I think it is the best college in Indore.
reviews.review_text: It is a residential campus, and it has a gym, common room, basketball court, mini-library etc. The campus is safe for students. The hostels are just like 3-star hotels with proper sanitation facilities as well.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life is really good here, and the placement team is very hard working.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with the college and would recommended joining it.

paragraphs: LBSIM admits students in different courses. Admission is done on-line and off-line. Applicants should enroll to the institute through filling out the application form. Moreover, they may have to attend an entrance examination in order to enroll in the course of their choice. A step-by-step analysis of the LBSIM admission process is as below:
The registration process of LBSIM 2026.

Those who wish to apply have to become members of the institute. This is the initial step in admission process. All the courses have application forms which can be resolved online on the official web of the institute. In case, a candidate desires to apply offline he or she may get in touch with the admission office. The candidate should take time to fill out the application form before the final date.
Step 2- LBSIM Selection Criteria 2026.

The successful candidates are supposed to take an entrance examination after they have registered with the institute. XAT, CAT, GMAT etc. are the entrance tests that LBSIM accepts, and the applicants have to have the required aggregate and attend the counselling process to gain admission. Also, PI/GD round is taken.
Step 3- Admission call and confirmation of seat.

After the exams are administered, results are announced and counselling process is done, candidates are chosen according to their performance in the exam. In case they pass all the requirements, they are chosen and contacted either through email or phone. In order to confirm the seat, however, the candidates are required to pay the tuition fee or some amount.

reviews.review_heading: Curriculum is updated and follows industry standards.
reviews.review_text: In general, it is a hectic course. The initial few months are spent just trying to fit into the new environment with the number of assignments, daily reading before class, and preparing for exams. There is the hustle of preparing presentations for every subject and sleepless nights, giving 2 to 3 exams in a day. The campus is small, but the infrastructure is really good. There are around 14 clubs, along with a management body, alumni cell, and placement cell. The library has all the required boo...

reviews.review_heading: The course curriculum is vast.
reviews.review_text:
Managed by third parties. Dual-sharing rooms are provided. The menu is decided mutually by management and students. It's vegetarian with an egg-only menu. Nonveg meals are not provided. The hostel is mandatory for students outside the NCR region. But NCR students can opt for it too.
Hostel Fee: INR 180000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: LBSIM - a career path for management students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college and the hostel is very nice, neat, and clean. The Wi-Fi in the college is very fast and does not disconnect wherever you move. The classrooms are modern and well-maintained. The library has an aesthetic design and is a quiet space for studying. Discipline in the college is properly maintained, and there is a clear code of conduct. The mess in the hostel and the canteen in the college provide neat, clean, and healthy food.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied and happy with my college.
reviews.review_text: College life is average, the college campus is small, and there are few sports amenities. Also, the canteen food is not good. We have classroom, girls common room, boys common room, AV room, washrooms, medical room, and a boomerang lab, all of which are in college. The college library has more than 10,000 books, journals, magazines, and reference books. The college hostel is not on campus; it is nearly 2 km away from campus. In the hostel, we have Wi-Fi and laundry. The food served is not best b...

reviews.review_heading: Best college providing freedom, toughness and strength.
reviews.review_text: Tatva is the college annual fest which takes place in February of every year. The library has a huge collection of physical and e-books with journals. All the classrooms are equipped with AC, projectors, whiteboards, and speakers. For sports, Zenith is the sports club which organizes spots tournaments. The hostel is not in the campus (2-3 km away) and is managed by third party. Dual sharing rooms are provided and the menu is decided by the management. Vegetarian food and eggs are a part of the m...

reviews.review_heading: Good Placements and good faculty members with state of the art classrooms!
reviews.review_text:
Facilities include 24 hour access to high-speed Wi-Fi, Bloomberg Labs for Financial Data, and State of the Art Classrooms. 
Library with plenty of books to read that you will get tired but the stock will not end.
Hostel are decent, Food available in canteen is also decent (Don't expect much).
Medical facilities include both doctors (one for body and other for mind).
Sports club Zenith is there to help you in sports related activities!

reviews.review_heading: Review of Lal Bahadur Shastri Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. There are sufficient books in the library. Bloomberg lab is available for students. Mess serves food four times a day. Food is good but not healthy. Sports facilities are average and a badminton court is available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LBSIM - Lal Bahadur Shastri Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. The library has a separate room for reading. All classrooms are fully air-conditioned. The canteen is also quite huge. There are some games and sports facilities like table tennis. A gym is also available here.

reviews.review_heading: It has highly qualified teachers.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility is average, and you can face some problems in connecting initially. If the Wi-Fi facility is connected once, then it is totally good. Classrooms are cleaned properly and good. The best thing is the library, and you will find everything you need, and there is also a study room. The sports room is very small here.

reviews.review_heading: It has a really good infrastructure. Management of events like Tatva and many others is really good.
reviews.review_text: There is a Bloomberg terminal lab for research and a good library with a lot of resources. The quality of food available in the library is decent, and you really get a nice cafeteria to enjoy your day, along with your studies. reviews.review_heading: This institute provides a big platform to learn.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities at this university for this course were good. The university students have access to laboratories, a library, spacious lecture halls, a cafeteria, a dormitory, a sports facility, and other amenities. Wi-Fi was available to students on campus. The food in the canteen and dining room was of high quality and reasonably priced.

reviews.review_heading: Factors that made me choose this college are the good environment and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is awesome. It has good building and other amenities like academic blocks and a library. In our college, the library is well-stocked with a lot of books. The whole campus is under CCTV surveillance. Our college provides a hostel. We have a separate hostel for both boys and girls. The food provided to hostellers is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Life-changing experience - Exposure, learnings, and peer group.
reviews.review_text: This is an old campus as the college started in 1969 with the objective of providing training to all Indian (and foreign) bank executives as well as consultancy and training. So, the college campus is quiet but with major investment, being put in to cater to the growing demand for PGDM students. College premises are no less than resort experience with lush green surroundings. A lively tight-knit batch of students that one would not feel the loneliness of being away from home.

reviews.review_heading: Mecca of banking and finance.
reviews.review_text: 24-hour open lecture halls. Well spacious dining mess. Laundry services are available. Sports facilities such as cricket ground, futsal, tennis, basketball court, indoor badminton and table tennis. Green ambiance with usual sightings of plethora of flora and fauna. All bank ATMs within proximity.

reviews.review_heading: A premium institute for banking and finance with excellent placements and college life.
reviews.review_text: Course offers a 2-year presidential programme for the students. Classes are well-equipped with modern teaching aids. We have very good library covering all the books from core banking and finance domain. Hostel and campus are pretty old. But we have a lush green campus of more than 60 acres. Students are very close to nature. We have cricket ground, Lawn tennis court, Basketball and badminton court as well.

reviews.review_heading: Best exposure for banking and financial services.
reviews.review_text: NIBM is heritage campus with lush green campus. Our campus is plastic-free. NIBM with its unique architecture and various flora and fauna makes our stay on campus memorable. At NIBM we have badminton, table tennis, lawn tennis, and basketball court. NIBM is equipped with Gym, library (Asia's largest library for finance), open space to hang out with friends.

reviews.review_heading: Great institute for finance.
reviews.review_text: Every facility offered is good. The campus is full of nature. It has very good sports facilities. There are dedicated finance and computer labs. There is a mess for students. There is a doctor and clinic on campus for student welfare. There is a dedicated basketball ground, lawn tennis, badminton, and an auditorium for multiple activities.

reviews.review_heading: College offers the best placements and facilities to its students.
reviews.review_text: A well-maintained and developed infrastructure is available at the National Institute of Bank Management for our course. All kinds of necessary facilities are available on the college campus for students. Facilities such as labs, libraries, canteens, Wi-Fi, sports, etc. are given to the students. College management provides the best-quality modern facilities to the students for their interactive learning. A hostel facility was also available for the students. The food in the mess was of good tas...

reviews.review_heading: Best institute of banking aspirants.
reviews.review_text: The campus was full of greenery full of flora and fauna. You can easily find peacocks and other animals on campus. The college had the largest library when compared with other colleagues, and in online mode, the college couriers library books to students. The college had the availability of a specific auditorium, modern IT enabled classrooms, a high-tech teaching computer, and sports facilities. Sports facilities like badminton and tennis courts, a football field, and a gymnasium are also availa...

reviews.review_heading: Great college for banking & finance. The faculty is supportive & gives proper guidance when needed.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well maintained. There are proper classes with all the required facilities. The library is well maintained with all the requirements of the students. The Labs and Wi-Fi facilities are well kept in order. The food in mess, as well as the canteen, is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied and happy with the college, great campus and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has 60 acres campus. It has 8 lecture halls, mess and auditorium. All the hostels and classes are Wi-Fi enabled. The library is best in the country if someone wants to go know about banking sector. We have in-campus doctor available 24 hrs. We have lawn tennis, badminton and volleyball court.

reviews.review_heading: NIBM the awesome colleges.
reviews.review_text: We have great infrastructure the campus is spread over 60 acre plot of with minimum of pollution we have self contained campus with complete residential and educational facilities. The classroom are air conditioned and equipped with projector laptops etc. College has separate hostel facility for boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: NIBM is a place to be if you want to build a career in the banking sector.
reviews.review_text: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are well-equipped. Our college provides many facilities like medical facilities, multi-purpose hall, etc. The college has a library that boasts of a unique collection of books and journals related to the banking and finance industry. The hostels have both single and double occupancy rooms. The hostels are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: The Mecca of Banking and Finance.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in the college is very good which acts as an add on in the quality of training that we get. The Wi-Fi and labs facilitates in making projects and researches. There are various facilities like library, medical, sports and gaming area.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college because the return on investment is great.
reviews.review_text: The campus is lush green with individual bungalows accommodating a set of five students. It has sports and recreational facilities available, and there are three playgrounds too. The hostel rooms are pretty good with all basic stuff available. There is a cafeteria which is open from 8 AM to 11 PM form catering to the dining needs of the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with my college.

content.Placements: Top roles offered in my courses include freshers getting a decent package of 10 LPA-12 LPA. The lowest package is 3 LPA-5 LPA. Recruiting companies are Jindal Steel, SAW, Jindal Panther, Mahindra, etc. Internships are offered in the 2nd to 3rd year and are primarily designed for core branches.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in both the hostel and the college. Classrooms are well-designed. The library is sufficient for your curriculum and other materials. All other competitive exam books are also shelved here. Food is fine with decent medical facilities. Sports equipment and needs are completely taken care of. Hostel facilities given here are quite comfortable with assistance from our wardens who are always ready to help us in every possible way.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good placements every year.

content.Placements: There should be a 6.5 CGPA is eligible for placements. The highest package is 33 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. My course fee is 12 LPA. The college provides good placement training and supports students for placement.
content.Infrastructure: The food taste is average. The staff is friendly and helpful in all sports. They train well in football, badminton, cricket, volleyball, and kabaddi. There is a free gym for all students. The campus and hostel are clean, and hostel rooms are cleaned every day. Every student can use the digital libraries. Smart classrooms and digital libraries are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college for B.Tech and management students. We will enjoy the best hostel life here.

content.Placements: The highest package is 33 LPA by Amazon and the lowest package is 5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: It has nice classrooms. Labs are very good they use i9 processors. The whole college is connected with Wi-Fi and it provides very fast internet. The library is big and fully air-conditioned. The ground is there for sports. It has a nice hostel with AC and non-AC rooms. Mess is also very good.
content.Faculty: Our college has good faculty members. They all got good degrees from NIT and IIT. They are highly educated. Their lectures are very good and very helpful. Semester exams are not so tough to pass. It is a nice place to study and complete our graduation. I suggest students come and experience the best part of their life.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Data Science and Analytics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: "O. P. Jindal University: empowering minds, transforming future".

content.Placements: Currently, I am in 2nd year so the placement will take place in the final year. In other courses, the highest package is 8 LPA and the lowest is 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Digilant Power, Tercel, Indus Towers, Jindal steel, JSW, Vedanta, Mahindra, Tata Consultancy, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a robust infrastructure. It has various departments. Our college has more than 10 computer labs. They have computers over 500 and it has a good Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are well-designed, blackboard, green board, and smart board all are present. The library has books of more than 1000 with prominent authors. There also have digital library. In the girl's hostel, the facilities are pretty good. The food available is hygienic and according to the requirements of the season, but only vegetarian food is served. The medical facility is available 24 hours in the hostel. Sports and games have a different department for it.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Overall, experience of this college is good.

content.Placements: We had a batch of 30 students in which 75% of the students were placed. Top recruiting companies were JSP, JPL, Teach Mahindra, and Schenck Process. The highest salary package offered was 3.5 LPA and the minimum salary package offered was 2 LPA. Almost every student gets an internship during course provided by college.
content.Infrastructure: College has a very decent infrastructure and is well-equipped. You will find electrical labs with various machines to work on and have a decent classroom. Hostels are very beautiful with a 24/7 Wi-Fi facility and a laundry facility, indoor and outdoor games, and a gym. Food of mess varies, sometimes it's exceptionally tasty.

admission_process.title: OPJU - OP Jindal University, Raigarh Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: OP Jindal University Raigarh admission 2025is open. The University offers merit-based admission. Further, for BTech and MBA university accepts various entrance exam scores.OP Jindal University Raigarhoffers UG, PG, diploma and doctoral courses in various specialisations. Students interested in admission to OP Jindal University Raigarh must appear for entrance exams and fill out the eligibility criteria to apply for admission. Want to know more about the OP Jindal University Raigarh admission process 2025 read below:

OP Jindal University Raigarh admission to all the courses is merit-based. However, for admission to BTech and MBA university accepts various national levels exams such as JEE/admission CGPET/CAT/MAT and others. Admission to all UG, PG, diploma and PhD courses is open. Candidates who meet the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective course. Additionaly, candidates must appear for the entrance exam for admission to BTech and MBA courses. The table below lists courses offered at OP Jindal University Raigarh courses eligibility along with their accepted entrance exams, & selection process:

OP Jindal University Raigarh admission procedure has a multi-step process, which has to be fulfilled by all the students to get admission. It starts with the application, students are required to apply and appear for the respective entrance exam and counselling for their desired course. Find below the OP Jindal University Raigarh admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

Students seeking admission to OP Jindal University Raigarh must apply for the entrance exam accepted by OP Jindal University Raigarh for admission to BTech and MBA courses. Additionaly, students are also required to register themselves by visiting the official website.
Step 2: OP Jindal University Raigarh Selection Criteria

After applying for the entrance exam accepted by the university for admission to BTech and MBA, students are required to appear for the same to fill out the selection criteria for admission. Additionally, for other courses, students must fill out the basic eligibility criteria which include that UG candidates must pass Class 12 with 50% aggregate and PG candidates must have a graduation degree with 50% aggregate.
Step 3: Counselling
For admission to all the courses, it is mandatory to appear for the counselling round conducted by the university for the allocation of seats.
Step 4: Admission Confirmation

After the final round, the university releases the merit list based on the counselling round. The students get shortlisted in the counselling round, they are required to submit theOP Jindal University Raigarh feeto lock in the final seat. If the candidate doesn’t pay the full fee by the stipulated date, the admission will be deemed cancelled and the seat will become vacant for the next round of counselling.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in both the hostel and the college. Classrooms are well-designed. The library is sufficient for your curriculum and other materials. All other competitive exam books are also shelved here. Food is fine with decent medical facilities. Sports equipment and needs are completely taken care of. Hostel facilities given here are quite comfortable with assistance from our wardens who are always ready to help us in every possible way.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements every year.
reviews.review_text: The food taste is average. The staff is friendly and helpful in all sports. They train well in football, badminton, cricket, volleyball, and kabaddi. There is a free gym for all students. The campus and hostel are clean, and hostel rooms are cleaned every day. Every student can use the digital libraries. Smart classrooms and digital libraries are available.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for B.Tech and management students. We will enjoy the best hostel life here.
reviews.review_text: It has nice classrooms. Labs are very good they use i9 processors. The whole college is connected with Wi-Fi and it provides very fast internet. The library is big and fully air-conditioned. The ground is there for sports. It has a nice hostel with AC and non-AC rooms. Mess is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: "O. P. Jindal University: empowering minds, transforming future".
reviews.review_text: Our college has a robust infrastructure. It has various departments. Our college has more than 10 computer labs. They have computers over 500 and it has a good Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are well-designed, blackboard, green board, and smart board all are present. The library has books of more than 1000 with prominent authors. There also have digital library. In the girl's hostel, the facilities are pretty good. The food available is hygienic and according to the requirements of the season, but...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, experience of this college is good.
reviews.review_text: College has a very decent infrastructure and is well-equipped. You will find electrical labs with various machines to work on and have a decent classroom. Hostels are very beautiful with a 24/7 Wi-Fi facility and a laundry facility, indoor and outdoor games, and a gym. Food of mess varies, sometimes it's exceptionally tasty.

reviews.review_heading: OP Jindal is OP in everything.
reviews.review_text: There are a lot of clubs like operations, finance and marketing, they arrange many events and extra curricular activities. There is no issue related to politics and gender. Ragging is prohibited in the campus. The college campus is well maintained. We have our own hostel where all the facilities like food, washing machines, laundry, water, etc. are available. But sometimes electrical problems are faced in the hostels. For sports, we have a  playground in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Really nice infrastructure .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructural facilities include modern classrooms, modern laboratories, and a big library with a vast collection of books—both academic and non-academic—like self-help books, fiction, biographies, journals, newspapers, etc. The sports facilities are also well developed.

reviews.review_heading: It is a top college in Chhattisgarh.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is excellent. We have IT labs, a library, classrooms with smart boards, Wi-Fi, a health center, a cafe, a canteen, a hostel for boys and girls, a mess, 24X7 security, cameras, a playground, etc. Our college provides facilities for sports like basketball, cricket, volleyball, and football.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good and well-facilitated. It provides good hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities. The infrastructure of our college is suitable for our department. Wi-Fi is available 24X7 in our college. All classrooms are well-facilitated. The hostel facilities are very good in this college. The food served in the hostel is very hygienic and classy. Medical facilities are available in our college. We can enroll in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Get satisfied with this college education and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided by our college is best and take huge sections of infrastructure in engineering Branch. The quality of food is best in mess and provide the best facilities in hostel my batch mates are literally get satisfied with their hospitality .

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the education facilities. Amazing infrastructure, well maintained and green.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our university is excellent. It has workshops which include operating machines worth crores. It includes mechanical labs such as Heat mass transfer lab, robotics, welding technology, etc. Our campus is surrounded by high-speed wifi 24×7. Books of all kinds are available in our library plus it has a virtual library too. The hostel has its mess with an occupancy of 500 students at a time. Indoor games such as table tennis, and snooker are in the building itself which creates ...

reviews.review_heading: OP Jindal University is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infra of the college is good with all the necessary facilities. The university is fully equipped with Wi-Fi of good speed, and the labs have good equipment and are quite modern. The classrooms are staircase type. The library has well-stocked books for the students. The hostel is hygienic and has an indoor sports facility like a badminton hall, table tennis hall, pool table, carrom and study room, etc.,

reviews.review_heading: Pathetic college in terms of learning, crowd, placement, and exposure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure wise college is good at par with any private college. The classrooms are decent, the hostel is good, the playground is there and the indoor badminton court is there. The gymnasium is decent. Labs are good though and so does the amphitheater. The library is decent with a decent book collection.

reviews.review_heading: OPJU is the best college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and everything here are fine. There are separate hostel facilities for boys and girls. It is about 5 lacs for a hosteler, but the food and other requirements offered by the hostel are good. The hostel offers a very calm atmosphere to learn and grow. The quality of the facilities in the hostel, the quality of food available in the mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games, everything is the best.

reviews.review_heading: An amazing college for topper students as they get very high scholarships and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The university has a very good and well-maintained infrastructure. There is 24/7 electricity, water, Wi-Fi, etc. As it is looked after by Jindal, all the facilities available are very nice compared to any other university in Chattisgarh. The location of the university is very poor because a lot of pollution is there nearby.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA Dual Major Specialization) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, this is the best university I have ever seen for the MBA course.

review_content.Placements: The university placement situation is good. reviews_list.review_title: Faculty members and placement records are always impressive.

reviews.review_heading: Best place for growth and skill graduation.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities need to be upgraded a little. There is Wi-Fi available in rooms but room quality is low. Food is average and the canteen facilities are good. Medical facilities available on campus are available 24X7 but the sports and game facilities are average.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for learning.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good and lavish. The food provided is average. The college has a full-fledged library that consists of various informative books. Classrooms consist of E-boards which makes learning easy for students. Medical Facilities are provided 24x7 on campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best place for knowledge enhancement.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch, but the food provided is average. The college and the hostel have the necessary Wi-Fi facilities and a library with fully equipped e-classrooms. The medical and sports facilities are good, and it helps to make a full-fledged campus for students.

reviews.review_heading: A perfect college for your better education.
reviews.review_text: All kinds of facilities are available for better education and comfort. The food quality is average. Canteen and medical facilities are available 24/7. There is a basketball court and a cricket court to boost students.

reviews.review_heading: PIBM – An Ultimate Management College.
reviews.review_text: All over, the college infrastructure is pretty fine, not much good, and facilities are not much there. If I talk about the hostel, then there are many hostels associated with us, but if I talk about mine, it's a decent hostel named Dreams, and yes, there is an issue with electricity sometimes.

reviews.review_heading: College and faculty members give their 100% for students.
reviews.review_text: In PIBM, all facilities like Wi-Fi, e-classrooms, labs, and library are provided as mentioned in their brochure. This college will absolutely help one build their career as one want. Also, college invites various corporates for interactive sessions.

reviews.review_heading: I am so satisfied with my collage.
reviews.review_text: See, the campus isn't too good but the surrounding area of campus is very great. It's all green everywhere. The hostel is good but there are some restrictions for hostels that students must adhere. Wifi, labs, classroom, library are all good. Mess isn't too good and medical facilities, sports are also not up to mark.

reviews.review_heading: The college is value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average, and the hostels are not on campus. There is a small sports complex and gym. The food is average, and the hostel facilities are good enough for students. There is also a paid canteen available for food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Pune Institute of Business Management.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not up to the mark; just one big building, that's it but Wi-Fi and internet are available in the computer lab. The library has a sitting area but important books are fewer as the syllabus has changed but the library still has old books. The college does not have its own hostel but they provide society apartments for stay. Food hygiene is okay; the fee is 1.35 lacs per year. Food is more like survival food. Admission to the course is subject to the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria specified by the university. As per the specified eligibility criteria, candidates seeking admission to the BCom (Hons) programme at SBS Sharda University are required to have passed Class 12 with a minimum aggregate of 50% withCommerce or Mathematicsas a subject. Hence, Mathematics is not compulsory for BCom (Hons) admission at the university, provided that the applicants have passed Class 12 with Commerce.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is good here.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are okay and upto the mark. All the classrooms are fully air-conditioned and classes are tidy. The main attraction of the college is the library. Library is super, and it creates a workaholic environment. There are many canteens from which you can purchase healthy food.

reviews.review_heading: Sharda University the world is here where are you?
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are air-conditioned, and there are separate projected classrooms and a library with experienced teachers. The quality of the hostel is also quite good. The mess provides a very healthy breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The canteen is open 24/7, and there are good medical facilities provided by Sharda Hospital, including free check-ups for Sharda students.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best place for taking admission. We can enhance our knowledge, skills, and progress.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is amazing. It has centralised air-conditioned. There is 100% guaranteed security in the hostel and healthy food. There is a centralised library and well-organised labs. 24x7 Wi-Fi connection is available. Large and hygienic mess is available. Medical facilities are 24x7. There is a playground and affordable canteens.

reviews.review_heading: Strong placement opportunities for new skills activities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms were very good, and the library was also very nice. There was 24/7 Wi-Fi. Well-maintained hostels with AC and non-AC options, decent Wi-Fi, and 24/7 security. The mess food was average, but the canteen offered a better variety. Sharda Hospital provides 24/7 facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Sharda university is very good to pursue further studies .
reviews.review_text:
The facilities and infrastructure are very good, not only in our course but in every course. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, and classrooms are very furnished, and centralized AC is there in the whole building of the college library, which is very huge with AC and proper facilities. 
The hostel rooms are not that good, and mess food is also fine, and the hospital is there on the campus only, and both indoor and outdoor sports facilities are there in the university.

reviews.review_heading: BBA in Sharda University.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. Fully covered with centralized AC, with Wi-Fi, though sometimes Wi-Fi is working very slow. They have sports, but not everyone gets the opportunity to join. Canteens are there, and the food is also good. Messes are also good for those who want to opt for hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive learning and placement support with room
reviews.review_text: Sharda university offers modern infrastructure both for academic and hostel. Sharda university offers separate hostel for boys and girls and well maintain rooms and the hostel mess serves hygiene and nutrition meals and good food.

reviews.review_heading: College campus and placement statistics.
reviews.review_text: The campus life is good, with plenty of greenery and trees that provide nice places to sit and hang out with others. The labs are all air-conditioned and have computers with top-of-the-class specifications. The classrooms are modern, equipped with projectors and central air conditioning, and the seating is comfortable. The library is spacious. The canteen is relatively smaller, but the food is good. There are multiple sports facilities, including a cricket ground, nets, track and field ground, f...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the overall experience of the college.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have centralized AC. The campus is vast, including a basketball court, table tennis, volleyball court, cricket ground, football ground, squash, badminton court, foosball court, carrom, canteen, small food stalls, library, auditorium, hostel, studio and parking facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied by the facilities, placement and the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of the college are very good. The college provides Wi-Fi facilities, a large library with all the books needed for the courses, computer labs for practical experience, and classrooms with smart boards. The university also provides outdoor and indoor games for students to play and practice for tournaments.

reviews.review_heading: Average college life. You don't have to choose this college if you have better options.
reviews.review_text: The library at the university is very nice. It is the best area of the college and the content available in the library for the students is also really great. Students also have access to free college Wi-Fi and classes have smart boards with good internet connectivity. The college also has good eating joints and canteens.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the exposure is good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by Sharda University are good, but sometimes the Wi-Fi doesn't work properly, like "slow speed, difficult connection with Wi-Fi." Labs are good, classrooms are also good, and the library is also good (all books are available, which we need).

reviews.review_heading: Huge opportunities are there for development of oneself.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really huge; every place has centralized air conditioning, rooms are equipped nicely, and the college has 15 canteens to eat in, as well as subways, a parlor, a general store, a money exchange bank, etc. All of these are available, and the library is very huge.

reviews.review_heading: I would not recommend joining this college.
reviews.review_text: Our campus provides all the needed facilities like air-conditioned classrooms, sports grounds, very good classrooms, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good for students.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this college is very good and large. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus and size of classrooms is much bigger. It has a very big library which is common for all the courses. Hostel facilities are good.

Selection Rounds

Release of Merit List

Admission Confirmation

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure, faculty, and environment are good, but I am dissatisfied with the placements.

content.Placements: For the 2025 batch, the role of GET (Graduate Engineer Trainee) is offered to all, with two civil engineering students placed in L&T and NCC Limited with packages of 6.5 LPA and 3.2 LPA respectively, while 40% of ECE and CSE students are placed in companies like BEL, BHEL, TCS, and Accenture at an average of 5 LPA and a maximum of 11.5 LPA by BEL, and 40% of Mechanical and Electrical students are placed in companies such as Oil India, RDC Concrete, and L&T with an average package of 4 LPA and a maximum of 6.5 LPA from L&T.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, digital boards, a library, a computer center, and labs with a good quantity of instruments are all available, though not in great quantity. There is also a central library, a medical hospital, and grounds for basketball, football, hockey, and badminton. The sports facilities are good here. Regarding the food, more non-vegetarian options are available, and North Indian food is not. Roti is not served, and the price of fruits is very high.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Hindi - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is the best university for the M.A. in Hindi course.

content.Placements: Nearly 96% of the pupils feel at ease in my branch. The maximum salary offered is 30 LPA. At least 6 LPA is required. Packages range from 15 to 21 LPA on average. Students get placed at Randstad India, Monster India, Naukri.com, and others. Positions include roles such as government officer, literary critic, and more. College students receive good support for internships.
content.Infrastructure: The amenities are excellent, equipped with all the latest comforts. There is Wi-Fi on the campus and in the hostel rooms. The hostel offers great rooms with high-quality timber furnishings and beautiful paintings. There are also good computer labs. In Assam, having good transportation is essential, and the college provides that. Both North Indian and South Indian food at the canteen, and both are excellent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is not as bad as people might think.

content.Placements: While the placement cell itself might not be the best, it doesn't hold back students from landing great offers. This year (2025 batch), 8 students from the ECE branch land PSU placements of 12.5–13 LPA. Previously as well, CSE students land jobs up to 37 LPA, and many score well in GATE exams and go abroad for further studies.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are pretty good compared to other government institutions. Classrooms have the required facilities, although not all of them. The campus Wi-Fi works in certain areas but isn't very dependable. The mess food is also quite decent. Sports facilities are available and quite active.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Hindi - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the best university for M.A. in Hindi course.

content.Placements: Almost 95% of students got placed in our university. Very good bundles are available, all with the core firm. The maximum is 26 LPA, while the minimum is 6 LPA. The average compensation package is 17 LPA. Charishma, MM Enterprises, Michael Page, and other top recruiting companies are listed below. All students are assigned positions such as content writers, translator, etc. Approximately 92% of students receive internship opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Our university features modern labs, classrooms with Wi-Fi, and libraries that are well-stocked for every course. Large rooms, Wi-Fi, and recreational amenities are features of hotels. The mess food has a variety of options and is good. Munchies are served in our restaurants. There is a clinic that is open continuously. A gym, basketball, football, and cricket are among the sports facilities. All things considered, the buildings are kept up nicely and are convenient for students to access.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It has good return on investment but the facilities could be improved more.

content.Placements: 95% of students got placed for 2023-2025 batch. The highest package is 12 LPA. The lowest salary is 4.5 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA. Top recruiters are TVS Motors, IDBI Bank, HDFC Bank, ITC, Reliance Consumer Products, Dalmia Cements, and others. 100% of the batch got internships in companies like Marico, ITC, NRL Refinery, Oil India, Amul, Coca-Cola, Kantar, etc. Mostly only sales roles are offered, with only few finance and HR roles.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities are provided like Wi-Fi, classrooms, computer lab, and library. Hostel and mess facilities are also provided along with recreational activities like sports both indoor and outdoor, cafes, and restaurants. It also has medical center where check-ups and medicine are provided free of cost.

hostel.description:
Tezpur University has 5 boys hostel and 7 girls hostel.All the hostels have basic amenities like water purifiers, common room, recreation room, mess, TV, laundry services, security and surveillance system etc.

The University provides separate accommodation for men and women students and research scholars, having  more  than 3700 capacity. The University also has a married research scholar’s hostel with capacity of accommodating more than 30 married research scholars.

library.description:
Central Library is the focal point of all user community of Tezpur University. The Library caters to the educational and research needs of the academic community and its resources are consulted by scholars from all over the country. Central Library has been started functioning since 1994. At present, the library holds about 83200+ books, 10000+ journals (print + online),online databases, CDs and 7848 back volumes of journals.

Library is a member of e-ShodhSindhu Consortium, DeLCON consortium and DELNET. Library users can access book database, journal database, e-journals, institutional repository, electronic thesis & dissertations and other e-resources from any terminal within the University campus. Library provides reading facility for 365 days in the year.

The library is continuously striving at to adopt the best practices in all endeavours of its activities. The library has fully computerized with the help Libsys software which is an integrated multi-user library management system that supports all in-house operations of the Library.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure, faculty, and environment are good, but I am dissatisfied with the placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, digital boards, a library, a computer center, and labs with a good quantity of instruments are all available, though not in great quantity. There is also a central library, a medical hospital, and grounds for basketball, football, hockey, and badminton. The sports facilities are good here. Regarding the food, more non-vegetarian options are available, and North Indian food is not. Roti is not served, and the price of fruits is very high.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best university for the M.A. in Hindi course.
reviews.review_text: The amenities are excellent, equipped with all the latest comforts. There is Wi-Fi on the campus and in the hostel rooms. The hostel offers great rooms with high-quality timber furnishings and beautiful paintings. There are also good computer labs. In Assam, having good transportation is essential, and the college provides that. Both North Indian and South Indian food at the canteen, and both are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: It is not as bad as people might think.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are pretty good compared to other government institutions. Classrooms have the required facilities, although not all of them. The campus Wi-Fi works in certain areas but isn't very dependable. The mess food is also quite decent. Sports facilities are available and quite active.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best university for M.A. in Hindi course.
reviews.review_text: Our university features modern labs, classrooms with Wi-Fi, and libraries that are well-stocked for every course. Large rooms, Wi-Fi, and recreational amenities are features of hotels. The mess food has a variety of options and is good. Munchies are served in our restaurants. There is a clinic that is open continuously. A gym, basketball, football, and cricket are among the sports facilities. All things considered, the buildings are kept up nicely and are convenient for students to access.

reviews.review_heading: It has good return on investment but the facilities could be improved more.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are provided like Wi-Fi, classrooms, computer lab, and library. Hostel and mess facilities are also provided along with recreational activities like sports both indoor and outdoor, cafes, and restaurants. It also has medical center where check-ups and medicine are provided free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Tezpur University. Beautiful Campus, one of the best in India.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college and department is very good. Classrooms are well-built and structured. There are many labs with a maximum capacity of around 80 students at a time. AC rooms are also available, all around the university. Wi-Fi is available and with good connection, in every hostel, you will find Wi-Fi with good connectivity. reviews.review_heading: Well-Qualified Faculty, Industry-Relevant Curriculum, and Vibrant Campus Life.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available, like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library with good equipment, which enhances the academic environment. The quality of the facilities in my hostel and other hostels is good. Food is also nice, and all the facilities like medical, canteen, sports, and games are good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and best facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a private bank facility such as Wi-Fi on campus with high speed, and the classrooms are well maintained and clean. The hostel rooms are fine; they really adhere to protocols and rules, especially for girls. The food in the hostel is good, and there are many games we can play. The mess provides good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Exploring Tezpur University .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Tezpur University is by far the best in the way. It is the 3rd most ranked university in the Northeast. Of course it has good hostels and playgrounds, swimming pool, yoga center, computer center, gym, central library, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life is good, and you will have plenty of free time to prepare for any competitive exam.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are clean and well-ventilated. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary instruments for experiments. Hostels are also clean, and the rooms are pretty good. Each hostel has its own canteen, which stays open until 2 AM, and campus Wi-Fi is accessible.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, facilities etc.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department are very good there were smart classrooms where monitors are present and AC, fan, etc. The classroom also has AC, fan, etc. The library is very huge one of the largest libraries at Tezpur University.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best north-east college ever and the infrastructure and facilities are really good.
reviews.review_text: Tezpur University has well-developed hostel facilities for its students. There are a total of 11 hostels on campus, which provide accommodation for both undergraduate and postgraduate students. The hostels are divided into separate blocks for male and female students. Each hostel has its own mess facility, providing affordable and nutritious meals. The rooms are well-furnished with basic amenities like beds, study tables, and cupboards. The hostels also have common rooms with television sets, an...

reviews.review_heading: Tezpur University, The most peaceful place.
reviews.review_text: On campus, there are four schools included in TU: the School of Science, the School of Management, the School of Humanities and Social Science, and the School of Engineering. All schools share some common grounds, which have facilities for football, cricket, kabaddi, volleyball, and basketball courts, with engineering students dominating the area. The food quality in the canteen and hostel is a matter of concern. Wi-Fi connectivity is limited, with very low speeds, around 50 kbps. Monkeys on cam...

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good in infrastructure .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities in our area are good. Wi-Fi, lab equipment, classroom infrastructure and a library—all kinds of facilities in our college are of good quality. The food available in our hostel mess and canteen is really good. Other activities, like sports and games, are also encouraged in our college .

This fee, however, is sourced from the unofficial sources. Hence is indicative. For the exact fee, students are advised to visit the official website or visit the admission office of UoH. review_summary.college_name: University of Hyderabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Master in Optometry (M.OPT) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: The research scope is great here.

content.Placements: An optometrist role is offered at the initial average salary package that ranges from 4-5 LPA. Students generally get placed in hospitals. People do internships in a nearby hospital, which is linked to the university. Our university has 100% placements, and many of them opt to study abroad for better opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is top-notch, and we will get free Wi-Fi at every building with high-speed. Classrooms are also quite good with projectors. The library offers approximately 20,000 books 24x7. In hostels, rooms are average with good cleaning services. It also offers quite healthy and tasty food.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Health Psychology - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of my college.

content.Placements: We have a good placement cell on our campus. Every year, we use to invite them for the campus selection. We used to go for higher studies rather than going for a job, most of us are pursuing a Ph.D. now. Still, we have some opportunities to get a job. The list of companies includes Velammal Educational Institutions, DuPont, and some renowned IT companies. We can do an internship under a professor.
content.Infrastructure: The course is also vast, and the labs are so good. If anyone wants research, this is the best place to be. So, many labs and many research programs happen here. Seminars from international professors are also very frequent. Exams and labs make a hectic schedule. Exams are very frequent. There are 3 minor and 1 major happen for one subject, with lab exams. The hostel is so good here, and the infrastructure is also very good. Everything is good and clean. Each room has only 2 members, so not a problem at all. Playgrounds are available at hostels. The gym is also there for students, which is very nice. For every semester, the hostel fees are so feasible for everyone.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is the best university for the M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences course.

content.Placements: Almost 90% of students are successfully placed in our Hyderabad University. Our course has the highest package of 37 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3-7 LPA. Recruitment agencies include IMD, IIRS, MoES, and many others. Opportunities for internships are great, with more than 85% of students placed in good companies. The top roles offered are oceanographer, climate modeler, and more.
content.Infrastructure: It has very fast internet and the best library compared to all the colleges in India. Indira Gandhi Library is one of the best libraries with a lot of books and papers. The hotel quality and facilities are excellent. There are some of the best medical emergency centers on campus, and we also have excellent sports and games facilities.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Financial Economics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am fully satisfied with the course and dissatisfied with hostels.

content.Placements: Placement percentage is 12% - 15%. The highest package is 14 LPA. The lowest package is 5 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA. Recruiting companies are Federal Bank and Synchrony. Internship percentage is 20%. Roles and companies are research assistant in IITs, research institutes, RBI, and NABARD. Roles offered are research and data analysis.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good in the classroom. Toilets are neat and clean. Facilities available for PWD students. Wi-Fi is available. We don't have a library but a reading room. Hostel facility is not good. Food is not good and insects can be found in the food. We have many canteens on our campus and they are subsidized as well. Medical facilities are available all the time. Sports facilities are also provided.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Best affordable university with great amenities.

content.Placements: As far as I know, you will have a good placement percentage but don't expect a package like 20LPA. If you are well talented, you can surely get placements as many companies will come for placements. The eligibility criteria depend upon the company, and some companies have minimum CGPA but some consider an interview irrespective of your CGPA. As I am still in 2nd semester this much only I can provide information about this section.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is another thing I personally like about this university as everywhere can get ramps for disabled students. Well maintained hostels and different blocks for different branches are there. There is an open theatre for events and a beautiful auditorium for seminars. There will be 24/7 library. Wi-Fi facility is there everywhere. Hostels are also nice and spacious. The food is a bit average.

admission_overview.title: University of Hyderabad Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: University of Hyderabad admission to all the courses is based on the entrance exam. Hyderabad University, also known as the Central University of Hyderabad, presently offers PG, integrated and doctorate courses in the stream of Science, Management, Engineering and Law across its constituent schools or departments. All the PG and doctorate courses at the University campus are offered under its 12 schools and 41 departments. On the other hand, integrated MA and MSc programmes are offered via the College of Integrated Studies. The University conducts an entrance exam for admission to MSc, MA, MPA, MFA, MPH, Executive MBA, MBA and PhD programmes. However, it also accepts several national-level entrance exams for MTech, MBA and PhD admissions. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. University Library has rich collection of 4.53 lakh books, e-journals, e-books, reference books, serials, theses & dissertations, back volumes of journals, maps etc. The Library has a separate book bank for SC/ST students and 2500 braille books for visually challenged students. received 642 books as gift from various sources worth approximately Rs.3.4 lakhs. The Library had renewed subscriptions to 230 plus print journals and 48 plus databases covering more than 40,000 e-journals.

reviews.review_heading: The research scope is great here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is top-notch, and we will get free Wi-Fi at every building with high-speed. Classrooms are also quite good with projectors. The library offers approximately 20,000 books 24x7. In hostels, rooms are average with good cleaning services. It also offers quite healthy and tasty food.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The course is also vast, and the labs are so good. If anyone wants research, this is the best place to be. So, many labs and many research programs happen here. Seminars from international professors are also very frequent. Exams and labs make a hectic schedule. Exams are very frequent. There are 3 minor and 1 major happen for one subject, with lab exams. The hostel is so good here, and the infrastructure is also very good. Everything is good and clean. Each room has only 2 members, so not a pro...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best university for the M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences course.
reviews.review_text: It has very fast internet and the best library compared to all the colleges in India. Indira Gandhi Library is one of the best libraries with a lot of books and papers. The hotel quality and facilities are excellent. There are some of the best medical emergency centers on campus, and we also have excellent sports and games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the course and dissatisfied with hostels.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good in the classroom. Toilets are neat and clean. Facilities available for PWD students. Wi-Fi is available. We don't have a library but a reading room. Hostel facility is not good. Food is not good and insects can be found in the food. We have many canteens on our campus and they are subsidized as well. Medical facilities are available all the time. Sports facilities are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: Best affordable university with great amenities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is another thing I personally like about this university as everywhere can get ramps for disabled students. Well maintained hostels and different blocks for different branches are there. There is an open theatre for events and a beautiful auditorium for seminars. There will be 24/7 library. Wi-Fi facility is there everywhere. Hostels are also nice and spacious. The food is a bit average.

reviews.review_heading: If you're planning to come here for studying M.A. Economics, please don't.
reviews.review_text: The Infrastructure is very poorly planned and designed. Apart from old and depressing architecture, the locations of different buildings are also not well thought out. Some of the hostels are in the north campus and some are in the south, which are 3-4 km apart. Some departments are in the middle, some are in the east campus (3 km from the north campus), and some are in the south. There aren't enough buses to carry all the students to their respective classes. But, the library is in the middle, ...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied as they are very affordable, large campus area, and have a lot of greenery.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is up to the mark especially in south campus whereas it is not as much good in north as they all are so old. South campus hostels are well-equipped with geyser, RO, water cooler, and Wi-Fi both LAN and outer near to rooms. We need not worry about the classrooms as they are best in infrastructure wise with the modern equipment. Labs are also well maintained. Hostels need a little bit of maintenance but academic buildings are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and facilities. Everyone is friendly.
reviews.review_text: We have a big library where many books are available. We have playgrounds, a gym, and yoga. Many tournaments are held here. The food is good, and hostels are always clean. We have a separate medical center where people there take care of us. Wi-Fi is provided in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: UOH is one of the best universities if you are looking for research. Faculty members are really good
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is really good; some of the buildings of the college are really good. Wi-Fi, the library, and all are really good. In the hostel, we have to stay with 2 members in each room, and ethernet facilities are available in all hostels. The food quality is average.

reviews.review_heading: This institute has got the title of "Institute of Eminence."
reviews.review_text: This university has a library named Indira Gandhi Memorial. It has many books and journals for every respective field. The books here cover linguistics, such as Hindi and Urdu, and technology engineering. Many clubs are running here, such as the Arts, Dance, Science, and Junior Clubs, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied! It's really a great college.
reviews.review_text: Food quality is very good and offers many dishes in one place. There is a big library with seating arrangements, and we can also borrow books from the library for study. Computer labs and science labs are available. Our college has plenty of space with multiple washrooms and ample space with an auditorium and multiple computer labs. We have a huge cricket playground with turfs. Great Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science in University of Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text:
The hostel is good but not too clean, with corridors full of dogs but not much charm.
Labs are good except when it comes to computer labs. 
There are study rooms, reading rooms, and libraries open 24/7 except on some major holidays. 
Okay canteen, faculty members, and good medical facilities. Not much support in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Integrated economics at the University of Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: College campus is very big and full of greenery. Department buildings have good and advanced facilities. There is 24/7 library and reading room are avilable. Wi-Fi is enabled in hostels and all public places. Good indoor, outdoor sports facilities, and good gym facilities. Hostel rooms are decent with 2 students per room.

reviews.review_heading: Curriculum and campus environment are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is amazing. Over 2300 acres campus with good connectivity, free bus service, advanced department building, and classrooms. Big and decent library which is 24/7 open. Full-time Wi-Fi is available in all public areas, including the shopping complex, hostels, lecture halls, and departments. Hostel rooms are good we have to share a room with one of our roommates. All other basic facilities are available such as gym, stadium, and sports complex for almost all indoor and outdoor sports....

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty, but administration is poor.
reviews.review_text: Bad condition of infrastructure and technology, provided by the administration, buildings are in worse condition in my school, but the library is the finest place where students rush to. The mess condition is even worse, but the quality of food sanitation is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with the services that Vignan University offers.

content.Placements: 80 percent of the students got placed in construction companies. Some got placements in cement production companies as plant engineers and quality control engineers. The highest package is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies, I'm not really sure, since I'm yet to graduate.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi connection is top-notch, the Wi-Fi at the classroom, library, and the hostel is good, which means you can do your projects from anywhere on the campus. The mess is still in good structure, even the labs are up to standard, but there is room for improvement.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: We go on field visits to different companies and also do field projects.

content.Placements: 80% of the last batch got placement in construction companies, Ready-Mix Concrete Companies, and Infosys. Plant Engineer and Control Engineer roles are offered. 50% to 60% of civil students get internships through college, and some do research honours, which are funded by the university, and some participate in local government projects. The highest package is 6PA, the lowest package is 3 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: We have a software skills lab ( Autocad, Staad Pro, Revit, Primavera), a department library which has our books and also some ancient collections on the subject. We have a lab the size of a warehouse, which is divided into many sections to accommodate the equipment used in our practical subjects.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great academics and infra, average placements, supportive faculty, vibrant campus life.

content.Placements: 90 percent of students are placed. The packages offered are 3.6 LPA, 2.4 LPA, and 1.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Sun Pharma, Dr. Reddy's, Pfizer, Aurobindo, Hetero, and Novartis. It is not an internship but 100 percent placement. Roles offered include direct patient care, industry roles such as R&D scientist, QA/QC officer, medical writers, regulatory affairs, sales/marketing, and government roles like drug inspector and jhospital pharmacist, focusing on drug development, safety, quality, and patient counseling.
content.Infrastructure: Modern, air-conditioned smart classrooms, advanced tech-enabled labs, and a library with digital access are available, supported by 24/7 Wi-Fi and sports facilities. Now, the quality of the hostel facilities is better compared to before. The facilities now serve good food with good-quality mess and canteen. Medical facilities are available 24/7 with an ambulance. All sports are conducted, and all games competitions are held.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Vignan the great college, which is on 650 acres of land.

content.Placements: I am currently studying in 1 year of CSM totally 29% of students have been selected for our course. 19 LPA is the highest in our college till now. I heard there are companies like Infosys, TCS, and Amazon that are coming for the hiring, and mostly all of the members got the internship.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is good, it was built on 650 acres. We don't get a signal since it is in the forest. We had a library whose infrastructure is awesome, and it has lots of book which helps to improve our knowledge. The food available in the hostel is quite good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Everything is acceptable.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed in my course. The highest package is 12 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average package offered is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course are TCS, Wipro, etc. Around 70% of students get internships in TCS, and the remaining get internships in Wipro. Top roles offered in my course are Web Development, Hackathons, and Coding Competitions.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Wi-Fi is available 24/7. Classrooms are clean, and labs are available for individual subjects. The library is open all seven days of the week. The hostel is clean, with single, double, triple, four, and seven bed rooms available. Canteens are available both in the campus and hostel. Medical facilities are available. Many types of sports are available, such as basketball and volleyball.

faqs.question: Can I get free seat in Vignan University?
faqs.answer: The scholarship seats are alloted in all programmees on the basis of merit, number of seats and first come first served basis at Vignan University. The scholarship is applicable for four years of study subject to maintaining a minimum of 70% aggregate in the preceding year (s) without any backlogs.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in Vignan University for B.Tech with 60% in Class 12th?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can get admission to B.Tech at Vignan University with 60% in Class 12th. The eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission at Vignan University require candidates to have scored more than 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA in 10+2 in Telangana and other South Indian States. For candidates in North, North East, and other states of India, the minimum eligibility is 50% marks in the 10+2 exam.Since, you have meeted the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission at Vignan University with 60% in Class 12th.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the services that Vignan University offers.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connection is top-notch, the Wi-Fi at the classroom, library, and the hostel is good, which means you can do your projects from anywhere on the campus. The mess is still in good structure, even the labs are up to standard, but there is room for improvement.

reviews.review_heading: We go on field visits to different companies and also do field projects.
reviews.review_text: We have a software skills lab ( Autocad, Staad Pro, Revit, Primavera), a department library which has our books and also some ancient collections on the subject. We have a lab the size of a warehouse, which is divided into many sections to accommodate the equipment used in our practical subjects.

reviews.review_heading: Great academics and infra, average placements, supportive faculty, vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: Modern, air-conditioned smart classrooms, advanced tech-enabled labs, and a library with digital access are available, supported by 24/7 Wi-Fi and sports facilities. Now, the quality of the hostel facilities is better compared to before. The facilities now serve good food with good-quality mess and canteen. Medical facilities are available 24/7 with an ambulance. All sports are conducted, and all games competitions are held.
